articleTitle: Opened-type magnetic shielding
abstract: In this paper, we describe the efficiency of magnetic shielding doesn't become worse at the area of 1m far from magnetic shielding wall in the case that there are some opening space between the magnetic materials ( "opened-type" ). Also we report the basic charecteristics about this opened-type magnetic shielding on the basis of two-dimensional experiment result.

articleTitle: Turbo like decoding of LDPC codes
abstract: In this paper developed a new coding scheme for LDPC codes that effectively reduces the decoding complexity. The paper explained the advantages of turbo-like decoding algorithm and BER performance and computational cost.

articleTitle: Reduction of cogging torque in interior-magnet brushless machines
abstract: This paper describes an investigation into the cogging torque in 4-pole interior-magnet brushless machines, having either 6 slots and a short-pitched non-overlapping winding (i.e. concentrated coils), or 12 slots and a full-pitched overlapping winding, the inner and outer diameters and the slot openings being identical.

articleTitle: High efficiency DC-DC converter chip size module with integrated soft ferrite
abstract: In this paper, we present the performance of the micro DC-DC convertor CSM. We have developed this convertor with the configuration of Chip Size Module, consisting of a high speed PWM controller IC and an integrated soft ferrite as a solenoid type thin micro inductor.

articleTitle: Measurement of core losses with 3D magnetic fluxes
abstract: In this paper we study the measurement of magnetic properties of 3D fluxes and the tester has been constructed. The magnetic flux is three dimensional due to the rotation of magnetic domains.

articleTitle: Design optimization of switched reluctance motor by electromagnetic and thermal finite element analysis
abstract: In this article, we discuss the design optimisation of reluctance motor by using a combination of 2D electromagnetic (EM) and thermal finite analysis (FEA), 3D correction factors, experience from previous designs, and computer search techniques.

articleTitle: A novel stator doubly fed doubly salient permanent magnet brushless machine
abstract: In this paper, a novel stator doubly fed doubly salient-permanent magnet (SDFDS-PM) brushless machine topology is proposed, which not only reduces both PM material and field winding MMF significantly, but also offers the distinct advantage of wide constant-power operation range (namely, 4 times the base speed) which is essential for electric vehicle application.

articleTitle: Fabrication of magnetic actuator for use in capsule endoscope
abstract: In this paper, a magnetic actuator composed of a magnet and a spiral structure could move wirelessly in phantom of silicone tube by applying a rotational magnetic field. The actuator needs neither battery nor wire for power supply. In addition, the possibility of the breakdown of the actuator is very weak because of its simple structure. The actuator has great potential for wireless operation of the capsule endoscope.

articleTitle: Adjacent multi-channel head in helical-scan tape systems
abstract: In this paper, we reports both a high transfer rate and a high track density in helical-scan tape systems was made possible by using a multi-channel writing head and a multi-channel reading GMR head. Using these heads we confirmed the feasibility of high transfer-rate tape system with track density over 10 KTPI.

articleTitle: Efficiency evaluations of synchronous reluctance motor using coupled FEM & Preisach modelling
abstract: This paper deals with the efficiency evaluations in a synchronous reluctance motor (SynRM) using a coupled finite element method (FEM) and Preisach's modeling, which is presented to analyse the characteristics under the effect of saturation and hysteresis loss. The focus of this paper is the efficiency relative to hysteresis loss on the basis of maximum efficiency condition in a SynRM. Computer simulation and experimental result for the efficiency using dynamometer show the property of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Model of an approach to targeted drug delivery based on uniform magnetic fields
abstract: In this paper, a method for inducing highly localised phase transformations at defined locations in the vascular system by applying uniform magnetic fields to an injected superparamagnetic colloidal fluid was investigated. The proposed design involves seeding magnetic particles on to blood vessel walls at designated sites though specific receptor-legend recognition, followed by the use of the anchored particles as magnetic traps for the injected magnetic colloid.

articleTitle: Ferromagnetic resonance study on magnetic homogeneity in spin-sprayed NiZn ferrite films highly permeable at GHz frequencies
abstract: In this paper we report a ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) study which gives a direct proof that the excellent films prepared utilizing the NH/sub 3/-added oxidizing solution (called hereafter NH/sub 3/-added films) are magnetically more homogeneous than the prepared without adding NH/sub 3/OH (called conventional films).

articleTitle: Magnetic micro-actuators & systems (MAGMAS)
abstract: In this paper, the magnetic interaction, scale reduction laws and the implication of scale reduction on magnetic interactions are described. The role of micro-magnets and micro-coils was presented. Finally, panorama of today's MAGMAS and their potential applications were presented.

articleTitle: Det performance of narrow track CPP-GMR heads
abstract: The objective of the present paper is to explore the capability and challenges of CPP-GMR heads by fabricating narrow track heads using common materials such as CoFe, NiFe, and Cu etc. currently used for CIP-GMR heads and by investigating bias current effect etc. on DET and QST performance at small sensor size.

articleTitle: Comparison of three types of permanent magnet linear eddy current brake according to magnetization pattern
abstract: In this paper, three types of permanent magnet linear eddy current brake according to magnetization patterns were compared.

articleTitle: Fuzzy approach to modeling scalar hysteresis
abstract: The aim of this paper was to discuss a new approach based on fuzzy logic able to model hysteresis loop of soft materials. In the fuzzy approach the five regions of magnetic field H and of magnetization M are described by membership functions.

articleTitle: A new 1 MHz-9 GHz thin-film permeameter
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new permeameter utilizing travelling electromagnetic field mode and a shielded-loop type planar pickup coil. We report RF packing technique to ensure measurements up to 9GHz, improved S/N ratio by 30dB.

articleTitle: Optimizing the bit aspect ratio of a recording system using an information-theoretic criterion
abstract: The objective of this work is to find the optimal symbol separation T and track width TW so as to maximize the inlormation density D in bits/inch'. Here D is defined as the information density per unit area of the recording medium where Cid is the i.u.d. channel capacity, i.e., the information rate (in bitslchannel-use) between the channel input and the channel output, assuming that the channel input is a sequence of independent and uniformly distributed (i.u.d.) binary random variables, We fit the datadependent autoregressive (AR) noise model in [I] to the recording channel, and then estimate the i.u.d. channel capacity C,u by computing the i.u.d. capacity ofthe model. The method used to compute the i.u.d. capacity of the data-dependent AR noise model was proposed in.

articleTitle: Core losses in claw pole permanent magnet machines with soft magnetic composite stators
abstract: In this paper, out line the core loss calculation in a claw pole permanent magnet soft magnetic composite (SMC) machine by using a finite element analysis of magnetic field. The total core loss is computed by separating the hysteresis, eddy current, and anomalous losses in each element, when the rotor rotates.

articleTitle: Time stepping finite element analysis for the dynamic performance of a permanent magnet synchronous motor
abstract: In this paper, the dynamics of a self-starting PMSM is studied by using coupled time-stepping FEM method. Magnetic circuits and the computational procedures are further complicated by necessity of modeling a rotor cage winding also for self-starting.

articleTitle: Dynamic hysteresis in Finemet thin films
abstract: In this paper, we present a series of dynamic measurements on a set of Finemet thin films, having thickness ranging from 200 /spl Aring/ to 5 /spl mu/m, by using both magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) and the fluxmetric inductive method. Unexpectedly, the data show two completely different hysteresis behavior, showing relevant differences in their frequency dependences. In particular, optical hysteresis is easily explained by a simple depinning model which can be solved analytically.

articleTitle: Oversampled timing recovery for magnetic recording channels
abstract: In this paper, oversampled timing recovery for magnetic recording channels. Performance comparison using PLL gain parameters were designed. We consider normalized recording density for both longitudinal and perpendicular recording channels with media jitter noise, clock jitter noise, and frequency offset were modelled.

articleTitle: Performance of low density parity check (LDPC) codes on high-density magnetic tape recording signals
abstract: In this paper investigated the performance of LDPC codes with real high-density magnetic tape recording signals from metal particle media. It is believed that Low Density Parity Check (LDFC) codes may be more appropriate for tape recording systems where the per-channel data rate requirement is significantly lower than that of hard disk drives.

articleTitle: Structure and phase transformation of ferromagnetic shape memory alloy Ni/sub 49/Mn/sub 30/Ga/sub 21/ fine particles prepared by spark erosion
abstract: In this paper explained about the structure and martensitic transformation of Ni-Mn-Ga alloys. Temperature dependence of the magnetization curves are obtained. XRD was studied for sparked powder and annealed powder. SEM results are also discussed.

articleTitle: Semi analytical study of ironless permanent magnet devices being both a coupling and an axial bearing for naval propulsion
abstract: In this paper, two kinds of cylindrical air gap devices are studied. These devices consists of parallelepipedical magnets stuck in ironless cores, the first one is the classical structure of PM coupling where alternated (north and south) magnets with radial magnetizations are used. The second one is an original structure of PM coupling where two rings of magnets with axial magnetizations are stacked.

articleTitle: Optimal torque control of fault-tolerant permanent magnet brushless machines
abstract: In this paper, optimal torque control of fault-tolerant permanent magnet brushless machines was investigated. It was assumed that such fault-tolerant machines have a sinusoidal back-emf waveform, so that the controller was required to track a set of sinusoidal current commands proportional to a given torque demand. The potential power capability of the machine was significantly compromised.

articleTitle: Modeling of magnetic hysteresis using counter propagation neural network
abstract: In this paper, we describe the comparison between C.P.N and B.P.N, for magnetic hysteresis modeling.

articleTitle: Ultra-low-profile micromachined power inductors with highly laminated NiFe cores: application to low MHz DC-DC converters
abstract: Micromachined inductors with sub-mm profiles and comparable electrical performance to thicker, commercially-available surface-mount devices, have been fabricated and characterized for low MHz DC-DC converters. The fabrication approach involves micron-scale lamination of nickel-iron cores, combined with 3D-micromachined copper windings. The dimensions of the fabricated inductor are 11.5 mm/spl times/5.7 mm/spl times/0.65 mm, and the DC resistance is 190 m/spl Omega/. Use of this inductor in a prototype DC-DC boost converter circuit (6 V-9 V) yielded 1.6 W power output at 84% efficiency.

articleTitle: Flying-height adjustment of a magnetic head slider with a piezoelectric micro-actuator
abstract: In this paper, flying-height adjustment of a magnetic head slider with a piezoelectric micro-actuator is developed.

articleTitle: High-frequency magnetoelastic multilayer thin films and applications
abstract: For the realization of new applications in the field of high-frequency devices with incorporated magnetic layers, like for example coils, transformers, transmission-line structures and especially non-contacting stress sensors, the necessary thin film materials have to be tailored in order to satisfy simultaneously a broad set of materials requirements. These are: a high ferromagnetic resonance frequency, a high magnetic permeability in combination with low losses at the working frequency (0.1 up to 2.45 GHz), a controllable magnetic anisotropy and domain structure, in case of films for mechanical sensors a high change of permeability when stress is applied. Furthermore these materials have to be compatible to the surrounding materials and process steps, which are needed to fabricate the devices.

articleTitle: A research in the application of permanent magnets and solenoids to the planar Maglev system design
abstract: This article brings up a new design of a single-deck planar motion Maglev system. The proposed system differs from the conventional double-deck system by not using linear Maglev slideways. It is also simpler in the construction compared to the other single-deck planar Maglev systems. The new planar Maglev system is consisted of an array of solenoid electromagnets and a permanent magnet carrier stage. The system uses the excited solenoids to drive and to position the permanent magnet carrier (Figure 1 is a conceptual draw of the novel single-deck planar Maglev system). The analysis in this research is based on the ANSOFT finite element analysis software that is employed to simulate and to analyze electromagnetic effects between permanent magnets and solenoids. According to the results from the two-dimensional and three-dimensional simulations, this paper analyzed the effects of solenoid forces on the carrier magnet. The different magnet dimensions and different solenoid arrangements result in slightly different force variations. With the ability to calculate the force distribution history, the paper then study the effects of various solenoid excitation manners. This research will move on to build a prototype model for experimental verification.

articleTitle: Inducing in-plane magnetic anisotropy in spin-sprayed Ni-Zn-Co ferrite films exhibiting strong magnetic loss at GHz range
abstract: In this paper we report a definite in-plane magnetic anisotropy is induced in the spin-sprayed Ni-Zn-Co ferrite films by applying external magnetic field during deposition. This anisotropy causes a large magnetic absorption in GHz range, advantageous for applying to conduction noise suppressors.

articleTitle: Bridge optimization of interior permanent magnet motor for hybrid electric vehicle
abstract: In this paper, the authors analyse mechanical stresses of bridges and design optimal bridge geometry using finite element method when IPM motor runs at maximum speed.

articleTitle: Design study for ultra-flat, PCB integrated inductors for low power conversion applications
abstract: In this paper the effectiveness of integrated cores is investigated as a function of various core parameters. This is a step towards optimised magnetic structures for this novel type of component.

articleTitle: Contact burnishing for head wear reduction
abstract: In this paper, it tells us that if we could effectively burnish a disk surface before sliding a new head, the wear volume of the head must be smaller than that without burnishing. This led us a concept of burnishing a disk surface by a contact slider of a hard material that does not fly like conventional burnishing sliders. We called this "Contact Burnishing".

articleTitle: Back iron design for high speed PM axial flux generators
abstract: In this paper, we reports an integrated design approach for high speed PM generators based on vigorous magnetic and stress analysis using efficient finite element method (FEM), and focuses on the optimization of the back-iron to meet the magnetic and mechanical requirements.

articleTitle: Fast impedance formulation and numerical computation associated with ratios of confluent hypergeometric functions
abstract: In this paper, fast and accurate impedances of interconnects via Pade approximations associated with ratios of confluent hyper-geometric functions was evaluated.

articleTitle: Magnetorefractive effect in nanogranular films (CoFe)-(Mg-F)
abstract: In this paper, we describe the magnetorefractive effect in nanocomposites (CoFe)-(Mg-F) in the infrared wavelength range 5-20 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of interior permanent magnet motor based on a magnetic circuit model
abstract: In this paper, we presents a calculation method of the dynamic characteristics of the IPM motor based on the magnetic circuit model.

articleTitle: Design of permanent magnets to avoid chaos in PM synchronous machines
abstract: In this paper, the relationship between the sizing of PMs and the chaos in PMSMs will be revealed. Both computer simulation and experimental results will be given to support the design criteria.

articleTitle: Effect of post deposition annealing on the hysteresis loops of sputtered NdFeB film
abstract: The authors explain the effect of post deposition annealing on sputtered NdFeB permanent magnets. Magnetisation, hysteresis loops and XRD patterns are obtained.

articleTitle: Development of NdFeB anisotropic bonded magnet with 27MGOe
abstract: In this paper we present the development of the world's highest energy bonded magnet with 27MGOe (213Jm/sup -3/) by the improvement of the AAM process.

articleTitle: An optimization method for design of PM motor by coupling voltage driven finite element method with genetic algorithm
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method proportional to the supply voltage of the PM motor at the optimal design stage.

articleTitle: Spin dependent transport phenomena in the NiFe/AlO/Cu/AlO/NiFe double tunnel junctions
abstract: In this study, in order to develop the highly performable spintronics devices such as three terminal spin devices, we first began to examine the fundamental spin transport properties in the spin-valve type NiFe/AlO/Cu/NiFe/MnIr double junctions, which has never been studied experimentally so far. The samples were grown on SiO/sub 2/ substrate by magnetron sputtering method. Magnetoresistance effects in the NiFe/AlO/Cu/NiFe/MnIr double junctions was studied at 4.2 K and room temperature.

articleTitle: Langevin micromagnetic simulation and MOKE measurements of vortex formation as a function of thickness in submicron patterned permalloy thin films
abstract: In this paper, Langevin micromagnetic simulation and MOKE measurements of vortex formation as a function of thickness in submicron patterned permalloy thin films have been investigated.

articleTitle: Mg AlO/sub x/ barriers for low-resistance tunnel-valve sensors
abstract: In this work, to achieve practical tunnel-valve sensors for recording, the specific junction resistance of the tunnel barrier must be reduced.

articleTitle: A study on post-processing for PRML system with AR channel model in perpendicular magnetic recording
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new post-processing for PRML-AR system, and experimentally show that our proposed system shows a good BER performance in the perpendicular magnetic recording channel. RLL codes and 4-interleaved parity check codes are analyzed in this study.

articleTitle: Forces in magnetic fluids subject to stationary magnetic fields
abstract: In this paper, we study the stationary magnetic field effect of linear magnetic fluid. The fluid mechanical stress are taken into account by a properly defined fluid pressure. The expression of pressure is not unique and depends on which expression of the electromagnetic force density is considered.

articleTitle: Determining a magnetic percolation threshold
abstract: In this paper, the threshold is defined as the volume/surface fraction at which the DC magnetic susceptibility increases dramatically and is studied using micromagnetics and experimental measurements.

articleTitle: The switching characteristics of sub-micron memory elements with synthetic anti-ferromagnetic (SAF) free-layers
abstract: In this paper, we have studied the switching characteristics of patterned synthetic anti-ferromagnetic (SAF) element for application as a free layer in magnetic random access memory (MRAM).

articleTitle: Investigation of perpendicular write head with side shields using a hybrid recording system model
abstract: In this work the write head fields are generated by three dimensional finite element modeling and then supplied to the recording model. The dynamic write process is simulated by using the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation of motion for each magnetic grain within the media.

articleTitle: High frequency magnetic properties of FeCoBSi/SiO/sub 2/ and (FeCo/CoB)/SiO/sub 2/ multilayer thin films
abstract: Soft magnetic, magnetostrictive (Fe/sub 90/Co/sub 10/)/sub 78/Si/sub 12/B/sub 10/ thin films and Fe/sub 50/Co/sub 50//Co/sub 80/B/sub 20/ multilayers are used in high frequency applications like stress sensors or transmission-line structures. The devices are based on strip-lines with incorporated magnetic thin films, in order to increase the inductance of the strip. However, relatively thick (/spl ap/1 /spl mu/m) magnetic layers are necessary to reach a high inductance. In both investigated applications high losses (imaginary part of permeability /spl mu//sub ac/") are deteriorating the high frequency properties and thus applicability of the devices. One source of losses are eddy currents in the magnetic layers. A possible way to reduce these eddy currents is to fabricate magnetic/dielectric multilayers. Theory predicts important changes in permeability, when comparing the multilayers with a corresponding single layer magnetic film. Fig.1. shows a calculation for a 2/spl mu/m FeCoSiB and a 25/spl times/80 nm/50 nm FeCoSiB/SiO/sub 2/ multilayer. /spl mu/' is reduced by a factor of 1.6 whereas /spl mu/" is decreased by a factor of 6.2 at 0.1 GHz. The resonance peak in /spl mu/" is shifted to higher frequencies.

articleTitle: Preparation and characterization of thin film fluxgate sensors
abstract: In this paper, we describe the fabrication of micro fluxgate magnetic field sensors in thin film technology.

articleTitle: Measurement of visually evoked magnetic fields associated with pattern recognition
abstract: In this paper, we recorded the visual NA magnetic field with a 204-channel whole-scalp SQUID gradiometer and estimated the equivalent current dipoles (ECD) to clarify the source localization of NA.

articleTitle: Optimum pole arcs for a switched reluctance motor for higher torque with reduced ripple
abstract: In this article, the result of 2D finite element analysis (FE) carried out on a 8/6 switched reluctance motor (SRM) with the view to arrive at the optimum pole arcs for the stator and rotor are presented.

articleTitle: Magnet topology optimization to reduce harmonics in high speed axial flux generators
abstract: Despite the wide-ranging application potentials high-speed permanent magnet generators can offer the literature reveals a scarcity of design studies on these machines. This paper, we concerns with the configuration of PM on the quality of induced voltage in an ironless high-speed Axial Flux PM generator (AFPMG). The generator is a 240V eight-pole disc type machine with rated output of 18kVA at 50,000 rpm. It comprises of two rotor discs, each with eight embedded PM poles, and an ironless stator winding positioned between the rotors. A semi-circular shape is chosen for PM rotor poles, due to the ease of machining and assembly over other possible alternatives, and also their ability to produce near sinusoidal waveforms with various stator-winding shapes relatively easily. The investigation focuses on the effects on the harmonic content of the induced voltage due to varying distance between adjacent magnets. An efficient 3D finite element model (FE) that exploits the symmetry of machine is constructed for the proposed generator. The model then generates the predicted induced back emf over a range of distance between adjacent magnets, while maintaining the volume of the magnets constant. A prototype with the semi-circular magnets was constructed to provide experimental validation to the FE model. The validated model forms the basis for further formulation of design rules, and in particular, on the study of harmonics minimization.

articleTitle: Magneto-optical properties of Bi-YIG nanoparticle with polymethacrylate matrix materials
abstract: In this paper, we will introduce hybridized materials constructed by the Bi-YIG nanoparticle and methacrylate (MA) monomer. We estimated the Bi-YIG nanoparticles dispersed properties with some derived MA materials used for plastic optical fiber. The magneto-optical properties of them are measured.

articleTitle: Analytical expression for readback signal produced by a GMR read sensor passing over a slanted magnetic transition
abstract: This paper presents an analytical expression for the readback signal produced by a GMR read head passing over a slanted magnetic transition. The expression. derived from the Karlqvist head-field approximation, provides a computationally efficient method for calculating the readback signal that is ideally suited for developing computer simulations.

articleTitle: Computer aided design of a hysteresis motor used in space application
abstract: This paper presents the computer-aided design and test results of a compact hysteresis synchronous motor used as the drive motor of a gyroscope.

articleTitle: Modified law of approach for the magnetomechanical model: application of the Rayleigh law to the stress domain
abstract: In this paper, a new model equation for interpreting the magnetomechanical effect has been developed based on the Rayleigh law. The refined model shows that the modified theory provides a better description of the magnetisation changes under stress, particularly at small applied stress amplitudes and when the stress changes sign.

articleTitle: Annealing effect on the magnetic inhomogeneities distribution in magnetic amorphous wires and microwires
abstract: In this paper, we report on the effect of the annealing at temperatures around crystallisation temperature on the magnetic properties of Fe-Si-B metallic glasses. In particular, we want to show the correlation between the degree of crystallisation and the characteristics of the hysteresis loop.

articleTitle: Nano-processing and properties of spin transfer device structures
abstract: In this paper, we discuss several nanoprocessing procedures and their respective merits and challenges for the successful fabrication of effective spin transfer devices. Recent results of spin transfer studies that have been made with these magnetic nanopillars will also be summarised. These includes several critical tests of current theoretical models of the spin transfer effect, as well as studies of the effect of thermal fluctuations of spin transfer switching.

articleTitle: High frequency measurements of spin valve recording heads
abstract: The high frequency response of a spin valve read head was characterized using noise spectroscopy and direct excitation from a co-planar waveguide. The magnetic noise spectrum which is proportional to the imaginary part of the device susceptibility, was measured using a low noise preamplifier and a spectrum analyzer. The response of the read head to electric and magnetic fields excitations was measured by connecting the CPW drive to port 1 of a 40 GHz network analyzer and the read head output to port2.

articleTitle: The effect of oxygen as a surfactant on thermal stability in CoFe/Cu multilayers
abstract: In this paper, the effect of annealing on the films grown with and without oxygen is likely to be related to the way in which the oxygen acts as a surfactant, which by reducing surface diffusion, leads to layers that are further from equilibrium before annealing. The films deposited in Ar+O/sub 2/ have an enhanced MR ratio. GMR curves for the films after annealing at 300/spl deg/C for 0.5 hours. The annealing has led to a decrease in the GMR ratio, with the decrease being greater for the Ar+O/sub 2/ and b) Ar. For the Ar+O/sub 2/ film, annealing has reduced the saturation magnetisation and increased the proportion of ferromagnetic coupling, which will lead to decrease in MR ratio. The changes to the transport and magnetic properties can be explained by changes to the microstructure during annealing.

articleTitle: Application of GMR line sensor to eddy current testing
abstract: In this paper, a [NiFeCo/Cu] multilayer type giant magnetoresistive (GMR) element with the shape of a multi-arc is used. This GMR element has an omni-directional magnetic sensitivity in plane (x-y plane). Magnetic field from all directions in plane can be detected with equal sensitivity using this GMR line sensor. In the leakage flux magnetic testing, this sensor can visualize simultaneously a shape of the defect by single scanning.

articleTitle: Roll control of a flight projectile using a switched reluctance motor
abstract: In this paper, we have discussed the roll control of a flight projectile using a switched reluctance motor.

articleTitle: The surface coverage effect on the frictional properties of patterned PFPE nanolubricant films in HDI
abstract: In this article we report the optimum surface coverage ratio of the bonded and mobile phases in the 1 nm height ultrathin PFPE lubricant film for future HDD technology. The lubricant layers were prepared by the dip coating and washing process. Patterning of lubricant was verified by scanning Reflectance Analyzer (SRA) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Optimization of permanent magnet stabilization for balanced sensitivities and variations of spin valve heads
abstract: In this paper, we present micromagnetic modelling work for synthetic anti-ferromagnetic (SAF) spin valve heads with permanent magnet (PM) stabilization. It is known that the PM stabilization in a spin valve head has to be strong enough so that the free layer magnetisation is in single domain state during head operation.

articleTitle: Development of a portable spot-welding machine
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the behavior of the equivalent weld resistance and operation when two steel plates are in contact with each other, to evaluate the efficiency of the flux control method.

articleTitle: Design of EMS-magnetically levitated vehicle with several modules based on genetic algorithm
abstract: In order to achieve design optimization of the electromagnetic suspension system (EMS) for magnetically levitated vehicle on static and dynamic performances, a design scheme based on genetic algorithm is proposed. Better coordination between component design and vehicle dynamics is obtained on the HSST-type system operating in the medium velocity around 200 km/h.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic dynamic computations including eddy currents
abstract: In this paper we present a 3D dynamic micromagnetic model which includes the effect of eddy currents and its application to magnetization reversal processes in permalloy nanocubes.

articleTitle: ABS design and fly height modulation of femto sliders
abstract: This paper presents authors efforts on air-bearing design of femto sliders for further reduction of FHM caused by disk waviness.

articleTitle: Optimization of inductively coupled power transfer system with flat pickups
abstract: Brushless DC Motor(BLDCM) have been adopted iit various applications. Especially. the use of this motor is increasing for the purpose of energy saving in home appliances such ils a washing machine. BLDCM far this application iq designed to have high phase inductance iind input current to generate sufficient lorque at low speed. So, the Commutntioii period hecomes long and a Io1 of DC link voltage ripples are generated. which have a bad cffec1 an the performance of motor such as a torque ripple.

articleTitle: The analysis of magnetic disturbance due to buildings
abstract: In this paper, we describe 3-D magnetic field computations which were carried out by using finite element method to analyze the spatial distribution of magnetic disturbance due to buildings. For verification, the magnetic disturbance computed was compared with that measured. Then the magnetic disturbance due to the planed tall building was estimated.

articleTitle: Energy barriers in magnetic random access memory elements
abstract: In this paper, energy barriers in magnetic random access memory elements were calculated. Three minimum energy paths for the thermal reversal of a thin NiFeCo MRAM element were found between the two stable states.

articleTitle: Fast boundary methods for magnetostatic interactions in micromagnetics
abstract: In this paper, we compare a treecode-method as used for particle simulations, hierarchical matrices or so called supermatrices, and the fully populated boundary element matrix.

articleTitle: Temperature and bias voltage dependence of CoFe/AlO/sub x//Py/AlO/sub x//CoFe double barrier junctions
abstract: In this paper, we compare the transport properties and temperature dependence of DBJs and single barrier junctions (SBJ). The results are discussed within a serial resistor model of the two single junctions. Ballistic and diffusive contributions to the tunneling current can be estimated, then.

articleTitle: Measurement of the anisotropy field dispersion in perpendicular media using complex transverse AC susceptibility
abstract: In this paper, easy-axis and hard-axis hysteresis loops to measure magnetic anisotropy. In the isothermal remanent magnetisation and DC demagnetization measurement, the thermal relaxation effect was corrected in order to extract H/spl kappa/ dispersion. However the grain volumes were assumed to be monodispersed for simplification, hence the extracted H/spl kappa/ dispersions are convoluted with volume dispersions. In the hard-axis hysteresis loop measurements, Papusoi et.al fitted the hard-axis curves to extract the H/spl kappa/ dispersion by taking into account the angular dispersion, which needs to be determined from separate measurements. We note that this method is also affected by the presence of high order anisotropy constants.

articleTitle: Room temperature scanning micro-Hall probe microscopy under extremely large pulsed magnetic fields
abstract: In this paper, we describe the use of pulsed magnetic field as a well established method for producing extremely large fields but the integration of pulse coils and peripheral instrumentation with the RT-SHPM necessitates extreme care due to the adverse effects of external vibrations during continuous magnetic imaging measurements.

articleTitle: Spin-valve and pseudo-spin-valve device switching for giant magnetoresistive random access memory applications
abstract: In this paper we reports results of switching characteristics and resistance properties of current- in-plane spin-valve (SV) and PSV devices that in particular can be applied to GMRAM two-resistor/two-transistor (2R2T) latch memory architectures.

articleTitle: Three dimensional atom probe and field ion microscopy analysis of Co/Pd multilayers for perpendicular media applications
abstract: Perpendicular magnetic recording is being considered as an important candidate for achieving extremely high density magnetic recording with high thermal stability. One set of materials being most widely studied for this application are Co/Pd and Co/Pt multilayer films. A series of Co/Pd multilayer films, seeded with a Ti-based bilayer seed, were deposited on Si wafers that had been patterned into posts of about 3 micron diameter. Following deposition the posts were patterned using a focus ion beam (FIB) system to form the needle-shaped samples required for 3DAP analysis. The atomic scale composition distribution was characterised using 3DAP, and HREM was used to characterise the atomic scale structure of the films.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of recording system with tilted head field and perpendicular media
abstract: In this article, we systematically studied the performance of recording system with tilted head field and perpendicular media without soft underlayer. The dependence of recording performance on different exchange couplings are also discussed.

articleTitle: The spatial harmonic analysis of FEM results in magnetostatics
abstract: We discuss spherical harmonic analysis (SHA) - frequently quoted as a key method for the substitution of a magnetic source by its multipole image and to combine flexibility of commercial FEM package with numerical procedure for SHA.

articleTitle: Material efficiency in magnetic field shielding at low and intermediate frequency
abstract: In this article, the shielding efficiency of low-cost soft magnetic materials, which can be employed as a competitive solution to high permeability alloys, such as Mumetal and Permalloy. To this end low- carbon steel (LCS), non-oriented (NO) Fe-Si and grain oriented (GO) Fe-Si have been considered.

articleTitle: GMR head side-reading and bit aspect ratio
abstract: In this paper, we have derived approximate solutions for intermediate cases of side-shielding, and have employed a simple model to see if this suggests a practical lower limit to BAR.

articleTitle: Thin film inductor for GHz band with CoFeSiO/SiO/sub 2/ multi-layer granular films and its application for power amplifier module
abstract: In this article, we report that multilayer nanogranular thin film and its application for power amplifier (PA) module.

articleTitle: Understanding thermal magnetic noise spectra of spin valve heads
abstract: In this paper, we present a combined experimental and micromagnetic modeling study to investigate the correlation between mug-noise spectral characteristics and the micromagnetic state of the PM layer at the abutted junction.

articleTitle: Thermal displacement characteristics of a chip on suspension
abstract: In this paper, we determine the amplitude and maximum time that power can be supplied to the IC chip in order to keep the temperature below a specified value. As a result, it will be possible to control the temperature and slider displacement of a COS by controlling the amplitude and duration of power supplied to the chip.

articleTitle: Timing acquisition for low-SNR data storage channels
abstract: In this paper, motivated by digital zero phase start (DZPS) method, a new digital zero frequency/phase start (DZFS/PS) technique is proposed for initial joint phase and frequency estimation. DZFS/PS is followed by a Kalman filter with delay to fine-tune frequency acquisition based on the buffered preamble signal.

articleTitle: CoFeB/Cu layered film with crossed anisotropy for asymmetrical magneto-impedance
abstract: In this paper, we describe the experimental results on sensitive (up to 20%/e) asymmetric MI in 1.5 micron thick overall CoFeB/Cu/CoFeB multilayers with crossed anisotropy, excited by a sinusoidal current (1-100 MHz) biased with a dc current. Furthermore, no hysteresis is observed.

articleTitle: Effects of Co substitution on the magnetic and microstructural properties of melt-spun Pr/sub 7/Tb/sub 1/Fe/sub 87-x/Co/sub x/Nb/sub 0.5/Zr/sub 0.5/B/sub 4/ nanocomposites
abstract: In this paper, we have investigated the magnetic and microstructural properties of melt-spun Pr/sub 7/Tb/sub 1/Fe/sub 87-x/Co/sub x/Nb/sub 0.5/Zr/sub 0.5/B/sub 4/ (x=0, 10, 20, 30) nanocomposites with the aim to perform magnetic annealing experiments in fully amorphous samples.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of Sm-Fe-N thick film magnets prepared by aerosol deposition method
abstract: In this paper, magnetic properties of Sm-Fe-N thick film magnets prepared by aerosol deposition method were investigated. The demagnetisation curve of an isotropic Sm-Fe-N films deposited for 4 min on a SiO/sub 2/ substrate was studied. The magnetic properties were measured by VSM after applying a pulsed field around 4T, and microstructures were observed by XRD, SEM and TEM.

articleTitle: Time-resolved wide-field Kerr microscopy
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a wide-field approach to the time-resolved imaging of magnetization processes with a temporal resolution of 200 Psec, based on a conventional Kerr microscope and a gated CCD camera.

articleTitle: High resolution measurement of temperature distribution of head coil and air bearing surface
abstract: In this paper, we focused on the detail distribution of the temperature and investigated the temperature increase when applying a current to the head coil.

articleTitle: Current-perpendicular spin-valves with partially oxidized magnetic layers for ultrahigh-density magnetic recording
abstract: In this paper, by sputter deposition we have prepared single-type CPP spin valves, whose basic structure was buffer/PdPtMn/CoFeB/Ru/CoFeB/Cu/CuFeB/Cu/Cap; the MR ratio of the basic one is 0.6%. The NOLs inserted in the spin valves were formed by the natural oxidization. The resistance was measured using standard four-point probe method at room temperature. Our result show that the GMR enhancement by the NOL strongly depends on the material used, the position, and the thickness. It is also found that the GMR enhancement by the NOL is remarkably material dependent. From the magnetization measurements of the naturally-oxidized thick magnetic layers, we deduced that the oxidized-layer thickness is about 1 mm. These properties of the CPP spin valves with the POML are in an applicable level for the read sensor over 150 Gbit/in/sup 2/ recording density.

articleTitle: Development of solenoid type vibrator used for mobile phones
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a simpler solenoid type vibrator and enhanced manufacturing productivity and reduced manufacturing cost. For the electromagnetic field analysis, 3D FEM is utilized with Maxwell stress tensor, structural analysis is also followed to determine the resonant frequency of the system.

articleTitle: Spin modes in a tangentially magnetized elliptical dot
abstract: In this paper, we propose a theoretical model for the calculation of spin modes frequency for a saturated thin dot of elliptical cross section under an external field H.

articleTitle: Reduction of flow induced suspension vibrations in a hard disk drive by dual-stage suspension control
abstract: In this paper, reduction of flow induced suspension vibrations in a hard disk drive by dual-stage suspension control has been investigated. The design of the servo controller uses both a dynamical model of the suspension and a model for the stochastic dynamic behaviour of the wintage design a 3/sup rd/ order discrete time controller that reduces non-repeatable run-out errors.

articleTitle: Carbon overlayer for 3-D pole metrology
abstract: In this paper, W overlayer, in addition to protecting the pole during milling, is to provide the contrast necessary for pole edge recognition. The cross section with W overlayer frequently suffers from the "curtaining" problem, where visible black lines at the W/NiFe interface cause the pole metrology software.

articleTitle: Current distribution in spinvalve multilayer films determined from in-situ conductance measurements
abstract: In this paper, the conductance of top pinned spinvalves was measured during deposition using a four point Van Der Pauw geometry. This measurement has submonolayer resolution. The layers in the spinvalve were Ta (5 nm)/NiFe(5 nm)/CoFe(1 nm)/Ru(0.6 nm)/CoFe(1.5 nm)/IrMn(8 nm)/Ta(5 nm). The thickness of the Cu layers were 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 nm thick. The in-situ conductance data is given. The bulk conductivity of each layer in the spin valve was measured by growing a film where the layer was 30 nm thick and measuring the asymptotic conductivity.

articleTitle: Influence of oxygen content on the reduction of the ordering temperature of L1/sub 0/FePtCu alloy
abstract: FePt ordered alloy has been studied extensively for use as a high-density magnetic recording medium because of its large magnetic anisotropy energy. In this paper, we have found that the reduction of the ordering temperature still depends on the content of residual oxygen in the FePtCu film. Change in the coercivity by the sputtering target as well as the base pressure of the sputtering chamber is discussed from the viewpoint of the oxygen content.

articleTitle: A model for lubricant flow from disk to slider
abstract: As head/media magnetic spacing in disk drives is fast approaching the 10 nm mark, the need to understand the spacing contribution of the disk lubricant becomes more pressing. In this paper, a model of lubricant transfer between disk and slider surface is presented that takes into account evaporation/condensation driven by thin film vapour pressure, as well as shear of the film towards the back of the slider.

articleTitle: Tunable RF noise suppressor modeling using soft magnetic film on coplanar transmission line
abstract: In this paper, we estimated the tunable rf electromagnetic noise attenuation by ferromagnetic resonance on transmission line without the external magnetic fields, which is analyzed by the finite element method a commercial simulation package.

articleTitle: Modeling microstructural effects on hysteresis loops with the same maximum magnetic flux density
abstract: In this paper, we describe the modelling of microstructure on hysteresis loop with the same magnetic flux density B/sub max/. Indeed the anticipated relationships are found for coercive field H/sub c/ and hysteresis loss W/sub H/.

articleTitle: Domain observation of Ni-Fe dots in external field by using Kerr microscopy
abstract: In this article, we present the results of Kerr microscopy observation of circular and square dots of Ni/sub 80/Fe/sub 20/ with microscale in an external field for the first time.

articleTitle: Time evolution of lubricant-slider dynamic interactions
abstract: In this paper, we report slider dynamics changes as a result of lube-slider interactions. Lubricant moguls as well as ripples are observed, and they change in amplitude and in frequency, following the slider dynamics.

articleTitle: The effect of hybrid media to achieve both good thermal stability and excellent read/write performance
abstract: In this paper, hybrid media to achieve both good thermal stability and excellent read/write performance were analyzed. Hybrid media consist of 1/sup st/ recording layer having low noise properties and 2 /sup nd/ recording layer having high anisotropy energy.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic design and fabrication of low hysteresis linear spin-valve sensors
abstract: In this paper, we have developed a novel technique to effectively reduce the hysteresis by employing double free layers in the spin-valve structure.

articleTitle: Frequency output type magnetic sensor using amorphous wire CMOS multivibrator
abstract: In this paper, we describe a new FM type MI sensor using a two-CMOS inverter RC multivibrator, in which an amorphous wire is inserted in series with the resistor (R/sub o/) utilizing the MI effect due to a diode-capacitance charging mode. The oscillation frequency f directly increases with H/sub ex/with the rate of 34% Oe. Because of its simple design of circuit this kind of square-wave frequency change type MI sensor can be directly connected to microprocessors without A/D converters. The mechanism for the change of frequency is also discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of reactive linear synchronous motor transient performance
abstract: In this article we present a procedure for numerical calculation of elements of nonlinear inductance matrix in the RLSMR and to determine its starting performance on the basis of the nonlinear inductance matrix calculated by FEM.

articleTitle: A mechanism of magnetic properties change due to neutron irradiation in the Ni-Cr-Mo steel
abstract: In this paper, currently on the unclear character of saturation magnetisation in the neutron irradiated RPV steel was examined using FMR experiment. Since FMR is very powerful technique in the study of ultra thin magnetic structure, it gives important information about the sample, such as intrinsic damping and structural and magnetic quality.

articleTitle: The dynamic magnetic field analysis of the "V" type NdFeB permanent magnetic synchronous motor
abstract: In this paper, the dynamic magnetic field analysis of the "V" type NdFeB permanent magnetic synchronous motor was studied. The method being used to analyze the LS-PMSM starting process usually concludes: the state equation combined method, the finite difference method and the finite element method.

articleTitle: Classical spin as a nonlinear damped oscillator
abstract: In this paper, the aim of our article is to describe an exact transformation of the nonlinear damped Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation written in the most general form to a system of nonlinear damped oscillators. We demonstrate that the micromagnetic and oscillatory approaches are completely equivalent. We also show how the transformed LLG equation can be applied to find the energy barrier for thermally induced magnetization reversal in two cases: an anisotropic magnetic particle in an arbitrary magnetic field and two classical anisotropic exchange-coupled spins.

articleTitle: Directional solidification studies on Sm/sub 2/(Co,Cu,Fe,Zr)/sub 17/ magnets
abstract: In this paper, directional solidification in the presence of a magnetic field to fabricate anisotropic Sm/sub 2/(Co,Cu,Fe,Zr)/sub 17/ magnets was investigated. TEM images and hysteresis loops of directionally solidified bulk magnet were showed.

articleTitle: Increasing of output power capability in a six-phase flux-weakened permanent magnet synchronous motor with a third harmonic current injection
abstract: This paper presents a FEM based analysis of output power capability improvement (OPC) in a six-phase flux-weakened permanent magnet synchronous motor with a harmonic current injection. It is shown that the flux-weakened permanent magnet synchronous motor with the third harmonic current injection is capable of producing more output torque per RMS current flowing through the windings than the same motor supplied with sinusoidal currents. The results of the analysis are partially verified with the measurements.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of hard FePt prepared by cold deformation
abstract: In this paper, we present a magnetic analysis of the obtained foils. Hysteresis cycles, measured with the field applied in the foil plane and at temperatures between 5 K and 700 K . At 300 K, the coercive field amounts to /spl mu//sub 0/H/sub c//spl sim/ 0.5 T. The e higher magnetic remanence in the PP measurement indicates that the foil has partial [001]texture.

articleTitle: Optical stability of citrate-coated magnetite and cobalt-ferrite nanoparticles: a Raman spectroscopy investigation
abstract: In this paper, we report on investigations of chemical and structural properties of citrate-coated magnetic nanoparticles using micron-Raman spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Study of exchance bias field variation in ferrimagneticiferrimagnetic bilayer system
abstract: During the last ten years, a lot of work have ken devoted to the understanding of the magnetisatiun reversal processes involve in exchange coupled bilayers. In such system B shift of the hysteresis loop (toward an exchange bias field HE) may be observed fur a temperature lower than a blocking temperature Tb. We present the study of an amorphous bilayer GdmFeul(lOOnm) ,TbliFegx(50nm) lor which both positive and negative exchange bias is observed depending on the cooling field procedure. A uni-dimensional micro-magnetic model permils to reproduce the various measured hysteresis loop and give a full understanding 01 the magnclimlion reversal proccsscs involvcd.

articleTitle: Stability of magnetic properties of 2:17-type SmCo magnets at operating temperatures larger than 400/spl deg/C
abstract: In this paper discussed about the recent development of high temperature Sm(CoFeCuZr) sintered magnets. Demagnetization curves was obtained from 400 /spl deg/C to 550 /spl deg/ C.

articleTitle: Analyses of a bearingless three phase induction machine
abstract: This paper presents experimental results from a tri-phase bearingless induction machine.

articleTitle: Preparation of high quality hexaferrite thick films by an improved LPE deposition technique
abstract: In this paper, we report on the deposition of thick and high quality films of barium hexaferrite on (111) gadolinium gallium garnet (GGG) and m-plane ([1100] or [1010]) sapphire (Al/sub 2/O/sub 3/) substrates.

articleTitle: A new kind of NdFeB magnet prepared by spark plasma sintering
abstract: In this paper, anisotropy NdFeB magnets were prepared using SPS technique. Meanwhile, the microstructures, magnetic properties, dimensional precision and corrosion resistance of the magnets were investigated.

articleTitle: Effect of oxidation process on the grain size reduction for longitudinal media using Ni-based amorphous seedlayer
abstract: In this paper, we report the effect of oxidation process on the grain size reduction for media using Ni-based amorphous seedlayer with different affinity for oxygen. Furthermore, the underlying physics has been examined.

articleTitle: Phase distribution and magnetic properties of mechanically alloyed Fe/sub x/B/sub (1-x)/ (25/spl les/x/spl les/75)
abstract: In this paper, our aim is to explore the potential as soft materials of mechanically alloyed samples of the FeB system. To that purpose we have followed the evolution with the milling time of their phase distribution and examined the magnetic properties of the final products of the milling process. The phase distributions of samples milled for different times were analyzed using wide angle X-ray scattering (WAXS) and their thermal stability was investigated from calorimetric results. The study of the hysteretic properties was carried out by using a vibrating sample magnetometer working in the temperature range from 4.2 up to 300 K under applied fields of up to 2 T.

articleTitle: Experimental study of asymmetry effects in perpendicular recording
abstract: In this paper, we write/read asymmetry and its effects in channel performance was experimentally studied. The asymmetries arising from the media magnetization background were studied.

articleTitle: Nanoscale processing for thin film recording heads
abstract: In this article, we present an overview of recording head processing, highlighting work being done to extend these techniques to the dimensions that will be required for areal densities greater than 200 Gbit/in/sup 2/.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of nano-scale FePtCr-SiN thin films
abstract: In this paper explained the addition of Cr into the FePt-SiN nanocomposite film to reduce its grain size and investigate the influences of Cr and SiN contents on the magnetic properties of the FePtCr-SiN thin film.

articleTitle: Intrinsic properties and coercivity mechanism of epitaxial Nd/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B films
abstract: In this paper, we deposited epitaxial Nd/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B films on a Ta [001] on Al/sub 2/O/sub 3/ substrates using the pulsed laser deposition technique from elemental targets. Films with almost perfect perpendicular magnetic anisotropy and out-of-plane coercivity up to 2 T can be achieved by deposition of surplus Nd, which decouples the Nd/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B grains. Aside from the epitaxy and the intrinsic properties, we also investigated the coercivity mechanism of these samples using a phenomenological theory of Kronmuller et. al.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of the Preisach distribution for magnetic recording media
abstract: In this paper, we describe the evaluation of the Preisach distribution for magnetic recording media on the basis of FORC diagrams.

articleTitle: Direct observation of a stripe chopping process in garnet films
abstract: In this article, the formation process of the anomalous bubbles is studied using a time resolved Faraday observation system for a single chopping pulse.

articleTitle: Spacing loss induced by disk flutter and clamping distortion
abstract: In this paper, the head-disk spacing loss induced by the disk flutter and clamping distortion was investigated by experimental approach. Different disk clamping distortion and two types of sliders with different ABS designs were used in the investigation. The effect of the suspension loading force on the induced spacing loss was also studied.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties, magnetic cluster size and read-write performance of CoPtCr-SiO/sub 2/ perpendicular recording media
abstract: In this study, we investigated magnetic properties, magnetic cluster size of CoPtCr-SiO/sub 2/ media and its read-write performance.

articleTitle: A study on hysteresis analysis of line start permanent magnet motor using Preisach modeling
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the SPLSSM by using FEM combined with Preisach modeling to improve the analysis and design accuracy. From this work, the hysteresis effects on loss and torque performance can be quantitatively evaluated.

articleTitle: Nonuniform micromagnetic states in thin elliptical particle
abstract: In this article , we describe a new stable state which explains naturally the evolution from quasi uniform to vortex state with increasing of dimension.

articleTitle: Water molecule self-organization and proton transport triggered with milli-gauss, ULF AM magnetic field cyclotron resonance
abstract: In this paper, a new magnetic field waveform for reliable water self-organisation is presented using an over amplitude modulated (OAM) magnetic field H with the amplitude of several mG and two kinds of hydromolecular cluster cyclotron frequencies f/sub c1/ and f/sub c2/ as expressed.

articleTitle: Single domain observation and spin switching behavior of microfabricated synthetic antiferromagnets with low aspect ratios
abstract: In this paper, we report the experimental results for investigation of both switching fields and magnetic domain structure for micron to submicron size SyAF elements.

articleTitle: Micro inductor for flip chip micro power source
abstract: In this paper, we describe the high quality, superior dc-biased properties of the proposed low height micro inductors for flip chip size micro power sources.

articleTitle: Fabrication of micropump with spiral-type magnetic micro-machine
abstract: In this paper, we propose a micropump using a magnetic micro-machine. Magnetic micro-machines require no power supply cables, no controlling systems on the machine body. So this micropump works without wire and is suitable for the miniaturization. We fabricated the micropump and examined its properties.

articleTitle: Phase detection of high frequency carrier type thin film sensor
abstract: In this paper we fabricated a phase detection circuit using a printed circuit board. The phase of the carrier signal was dramatically changed about 180 degrees around carrier suppression. This technique can be applied for very high sensitive magnetic field measurements.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimized design of magnet for micro SMES with multiple parallel solenoids
abstract: In this paper, the features of actively shielding systems, the multiple parallel solenoid configurations, for superconducting magnets are analyzed and the results of their corresponding stray fields are compared. Two optimization strategies are briefly presented. The results using the proposed optimization strategies are given.

articleTitle: Induced Ge spin polarization at the Fe/Ge interface
abstract: In this paper, we present direct evidence for induced spin on Ge at the Fe/Ge interface in an Fe/amorphous Ge multilayer. X-ray magnetic circular dichroism at the Ge L edge accesses the spin polarization of 4sp and 3d unoccupied density of states both showing antiparallel alignment to the adjacent Fe.

articleTitle: Bulk SmCo/sub 5///spl alpha/-Fe composites by plasma pressure compaction
abstract: In this paper, the preparation of bulk SmCo5/a-Fe nanocomposites magnets by plasma pressure compaction was presented. Magnetic properties on consolidated samples were made using SQUID and VSM. Microstructural characterization was performed with SEM and XRD.

articleTitle: Nondestructive detection of cracks in a distribution line by evaluating magnetic field distribution
abstract: In this paper, the magnetic field distribution around a conducting wire by considering the current density distribution using circuit analysis simulator was calculated. The feasibility of the nondestructive detection of cracks in a distribution line through variations in the magnetic field was confirmed.

articleTitle: Magnetic resonance and light microscopy investigation in magnetoliposome treated mice
abstract: In this paper, we report on light microscopy (LM) and magnetic resonance (MR) investigations carried out with the DMPC-ML sample.

articleTitle: Computational study of low-field domain wall mobility in nanowires rectangular cross section
abstract: In this paper we use micromagnetic simulations to investigate domain wall propagation in nanowires of rectangular cross section with w=100 nm in width and variable thickness h. The dynamic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation is solved using 2D and 3D finite difference micromagnetic solvers with cell size /spl Delta/=5 nm and variable time steps.

articleTitle: In-situ Lorentz microscopy of magnetic nanostructures
abstract: In this paper, we describe results from a newly developed stage which comprises two wires situated close to the sample which give a field parallel to the thin film plane and which in principle should give no net deflection of the electron beam. This stage can be used for steady or pulsed fields and is specifically designed for use with TEM silicon nitride membrane substrates.

articleTitle: Directional dependence of magnetization and minor loops of Ba- and Sr-ferrites
abstract: In this paper, the modeling of the hysteresis loop can be used to improve the understanding of the magnetization process.

articleTitle: Transition and DC noise characteristics of high or media
abstract: In this paper, we experimentally investigated DC and transition noise characteristics of media with various OR values. OR was controlled by adjusting the textured NiP surface morphology resulting in different "line density" prior to depositing the same magnetic layered films. The observed results suggested that with increasing OR, DC noise is significantly reduced, while the media transition noise gradually increases. As a result of significant DC noise contribution to the total media noise, the normalized total media noise power of higher OR media is lower over a wide range of recording densities. For high density low M/sup r/t designs, reducing DC noise by increasing OR, inspite of a gain in transition noise, becomes an effective means to increasing areal density.

articleTitle: Properties of magnetically soft amorphous Nd-Fe-B nanoparticles synthesized by chemical reduction
abstract: In this paper, FeNdB nanoparticles were synthesized through the chemical reduction of aqueous metal salt solutions. X-ray diffraction scans performed on a Rikagu Rotaflex Ru-200B diffractometer revealed that the product powders are amorphous. A Leica 360 field emission scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analysis indicated that average particle sizes for these amorphous powders were around 100 nm. Room temperature magnetic measurements on a Lake Shore Model 735 vibrating sample magnetometer (VSM) showed that as produced amorphous powders were ferromagnetic with an average saturation magnetization of 30 emu/g and a coercivity of 20 Oe.

articleTitle: Effects of bottom layer on recording performance and thermal stability for AFC media
abstract: In this paper, the composition and thickness of the bottom layer made up of CoCrPt alloys were varied and effects on recording performance and thermal stability were investigated.

articleTitle: Permeability spectra of amorphous ferromagnetic glass-coated microwires from 150 K up to 450 K
abstract: In this article, we give the first measurement of permeability spectra on ferromagnetic AGCW with negative magnetostriction on the 150K-450K temperature range.

articleTitle: Nano processing for thin film disc applications
abstract: In this paper, we will discuss several of these nano-processing procedures and their merits and challenges for the fabrication of effective spin-transfer devices. Results of spin-transfer studies that have been made with these magnetic nanopillars.

articleTitle: SNR and KuV/kT improvement using CoCrTa/Ru/CoCrPtTaB/CoCrTaB AFC media
abstract: In this paper studied an new antiferromagnetic coupling (AFC) structure, one magnetic layer (M1) below Ru and two layers (M2, M3) above Ru. TEM images of films with and without M2 layer reported.

articleTitle: Ballistic magnetoresistance in atomic and nanometer size contacts
abstract: In this talk we will report the latest results in experimental and theory, obtained for ballistic magnetoresistance (BMR) in atomic and nanometer size contacts between Ni, CrO/sub 2/, Fe/sub 3/O/sub 4/ and permalloy electrodes. These contacts have been built between wires or thin films by mechanical contact or by electrodeposition.

articleTitle: Antiferromagnetic exchange coupling in epitaxial Fe/Si/Ge/Si/Fe structures
abstract: In this paper, we grow nominally pure Ge spacers by electron-beam evaporation in order to obtain epitaxial growth of the whole structure, a necessary condition for strong AFC.

articleTitle: A new vector model of magnetic hysteresis based on a novel class of play hysterons
abstract: In this paper, we describe modelling of scalar hysteresis which has been certainly dominated by the Preisach approach consists of representing systems with hysteresis by the superposition of a set of two positions relays.

articleTitle: Focused ion-beam fabrication of nanoscale magnetic structures
abstract: In this article, the direct FIB etching of magnetic thin films to form nanostructures is explored. The effect of Ga+ ion implantation on magnetic properties as well as possibility of using thin capping layers to reduce Ga+ implantation are studied. The shape and size dependence of magnetic domain patterns in FIB- fabricated nanostructures are investigated.

articleTitle: Slider-lubricant interactions for low flying sliders
abstract: In this paper, slider-lubricant interactions for low flying sliders are discussed. The time-frequency analysis of the LDV velocity signal along with its power spectrum is shown.

articleTitle: Role of exchange break layer and soft underlayer in multilayer perpendicular recording system
abstract: In this study, the magnetic layer was nominally the same, only the thickness of SUL, and EBL were varied. The EBL should be thin to minimize the write gap but thick enough to break the direct exchange coupling between the SUL and the recording layer. We explored the thickness effects of EBL and SUL on recording using multilayer structures.

articleTitle: Bose-Einstein condensation of magnons in slow dynamics
abstract: In this paper, decay coefficient vs. temperature for chemical potential variation is calculated using table curve. The finite temperature at which the chemical potential is zero represents a Bose-Einstein condensation of magnons.

articleTitle: Microstructure and magnetic properties of nanoscale FeOOH particles assemblies
abstract: In this paper, nanoscale /spl alpha/-FeOOH particles are successfully synthesized. Microstructure analysis was conducted using XRD, TEM and Mossbauer spectroscopy. Magnetic measurement had been carried out. The relation between microstructure and magnetization was also discussed.

articleTitle: Magnetic domain structure of TbFe/sub 12-x/Ti/sub x/ single crystals
abstract: In this paper, the various domain patterns of TbFe/sub 12-x/Ti/sub x/ single crystals in main crystal planes with increase of Ti content, detected by Nanoscope IIIa-D3000 MFM, are presented and explained in detail.

articleTitle: Nanoscale CoCrPt/Ti dots with out-of-plane magnetization fabricated by electron beam lithography
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate out-of-plane magnetization in disk-like structures by introducing a suitable underlayer with tailored deposition conditions.

articleTitle: New expressions for calculating the magnetic force of the system: filament coil-disk coil
abstract: In this paper, the calculation of the magnetic attraction between two coils, carrying current, is carried out which is closely related to the calculation of their mutual inductance.

articleTitle: 3D magnetic tracking of a single subminiature coil with a large 2D-array of uniaxial transmitters
abstract: In this paper, we describe a novel system and method for magnetic tracking of a single subminiature coil, which can be used, for example for intrabody navigation of flexible medical instruments.

articleTitle: The weighted wavelet-based multiresolution time-domain analysis in the MoM for transient eddy current problems
abstract: In this paper, we use a new biorthogonal wavelet system as basis and weighting functions in the method of moments (MoM) for transients eddy current problems.

articleTitle: Highly-dense anisotropic Sm-Fe-N-based bonded magnets including unsaturated polyester prepared by powder compacting press
abstract: In this paper, the method for preparing highly-dense bonded magnets made from anisotropic Sm-Fe-N and anisotropic Nd-Fe-B hybrid powders, and compare their magnetic properties with an conventional Sm-Fe-N bonded magnets prepared from injection molding were described.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic systems based upon ferro-refraction concept
abstract: In this paper, ferro-refraction is the utilization of materials of high magnetic permeability to achieve magnetic field magnification. The ferro-refraction concept has been investigated for magnet designs for MRI applications.

articleTitle: Applicability of the ferromagnetic resonance for the neutron irradiated degradation in the reactor pressure vessel
abstract: In this paper, to explore the applicability of nondestructive test to detect radiation embrittlement in reactor pressure vessel, we investigate ferromagnetic resonance supplemented by vibrating sample magnetometer. Specimens used in this investigation were SA508-3 low alloy steels with different refining process. Magnetization as a function of the applied field was measured.

articleTitle: Domain wall propagation in patterned Ni/sub 80/Fe/sub 20/ zigzag wires
abstract: In this study, the zigzag configuration is used to generate a domain wall at corner and the number of zigzag unit is proportional to the domain wall resistance. In addition, the anisotropic magnetoresistance ratio (AMR) decreases as the number of zigzag unit increases.

articleTitle: Characterization of magnetic nanostructures using synchrotron based techniques
abstract: In this paper, a brief overview of the latest developments in synchrotron techniques and their application to magnetic nanostructures will be given. Selected examples will be used to illustrate the use of these techniques for magnetic nanostructures.

articleTitle: Thermal analysis of induction heating roll with heat pipes
abstract: In this paper, we analyze thermal characteristic of induction heating roll with heat pipes using FEA first. And we make a comparative study about effect on heat pipes to a thermal characteristic. Lastly, we will make a study about the effect on the position and a number of the heat pipes after.

articleTitle: High-frequency characteristics of metal/native oxide multilayers
abstract: In this paper, we examine the high-frequency characteristics of the MNOM structure. We find that there are no excessive damping mechanisms in the intrinsic high-frequency response, and that the native oxide layers successfully inhibit eddy currents up to several GHz.

articleTitle: The effect of naturally adsorbed gas on the substrate surface on the growth of island-like WCR seedlayer
abstract: In this paper, the effect of naturally adsorbed gas on the substrate surface on the growth of very thin WCr seedlayer has been examined using an in-situ Auger electron spectroscopy method.

articleTitle: Stress dependence of saturation magnetostriction for glass-covered amorphous wires
abstract: In this paper, the aim is to analyse the influence of tensile stress (applied during treatment as well as during measurements) on /spl lambda/s value, for positive, negative and nearly zero magnetostrictive Fe/sub 72.5-x/Co/sub x/Si/sub 12.5/B/sub 15/ glass-covered amorphous wires. During treatments, the current density, tensile stress and annealing time values were varied up to 250 X 10/sup 6/A/m/sup 2/, 500 MPa and 250 minutes respectively. The amorphous state was examined by X-ray diffraction.

articleTitle: Magnetic printing technique for perpendicular thin films media with high coercivity of up to 10000 oersted
abstract: In this paper, we addresses the issues of whether the magnetic printing designed for perpendicular media can be satisfactorily carried out using the media with high coercivity of up to 10000 Oe.

articleTitle: R/W properties and thermal stability of SF-media
abstract: In this paper, we compare the thermal stability and read-write (R/W) properties of SFM with conventional media (CM) of the same stability factor KuV/kT and tBr.The overwrite properties (OW) and nonlinear transition shift (NLTS) are compared for CM.

articleTitle: About the dipolar approach in magnetostatically coupled bistable magnetic micro and nanowires
abstract: In this paper, we have analyzed about the dipolar approach in magnetostatically coupled bistable magnetic micro and nanowires and shown the experimental hysteresis loop for two parallel interacting Fe base microwires 130 /spl mu/m in diameter and 11.7 cm in length, placed in contact.

articleTitle: Nano processing for magnetic logic applications
abstract: In this paper, we made a ferromagnetic device which is able to process magnetic information as well as store it. As in MRAM, we represent information by the ferromagnetic magnetisation direction. Information is transported from one point to another by the motion of a domain wall through a nanoscale track of ferromagnetic material. In order to process information, 4 different circuit architecture elements are required: a NOT gate, a comparison gate (e.g. AND or OR), a fan-out element and a track-crossing element.

articleTitle: Lattice matching consideration in pseudo-AFC structure
abstract: In this paper, we describe the lattice constant of a and c are 2.506 /spl Aring/ for pure Co and are 2.706 /spl Aring/ and 4.28 for pure Ru. Lattice mismatch between Co alloy layer and Ru layer are expected to be high in AFC media, which can cause poor Cr(100)//Co(1120) epitaxy, resulting in SNR degradation.

articleTitle: Magnetization reversal due to spin injection in magnetic junction
abstract: In this paper, we present a new model of current induced magnetization reversal in magnetic junctions. our model includes three layers: two metallic ferromagnetic layers, 1 and 2, and ultra-thin nonmagnetic layer in between. We justify this proposition theoretically and by comparing the results with the experimental data.

articleTitle: A study of the lubricant displacement under a flying head slider caused by slider-disk interaction
abstract: In this paper, we study the lubricant displacement under a flying slider caused by slider-disk interaction, especially effects of air bearing pressure and disk surface topography, which we detected by executing long-term flyability tests using an Optical Surface Analyser (OSA).

articleTitle: Recording performance of double-layered perpendicular recording media with antiferromagnetic layer
abstract: In this study, we have investigated the layer structure and the materials of AFML to obtain high exchange bias field H/sub ex/, and also discussed the influence of the H/sub ex/ to the recording performance for double-layered perpendicular media.

articleTitle: A GMR head for helical-scan recording with a 5000 hour head life
abstract: In this paper, we describe a GMR head for helical-scan recording that overcomes the problems of wear, corrosion and thermal spikes.

articleTitle: Structural, magnetic and Mossbauer characterization of controlled-size iron-iron oxide nanoparticles obtained by chemical methods
abstract: In this paper, structural, magnetic and Mossbauer characterization of controlled-size iron-iron oxide nanoparticles obtained by chemical methods.

articleTitle: A study of friction properties of Zdol on magnetic disk surface
abstract: In this paper, the friction properties of each layer by ball on disk test. Zdol fractionated Zdol (MW=2000/spl sim/6000) and Z03 (MW=3840) are used in this study.

articleTitle: New preparation method of Nd/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B-based bonded magnets for efficient small motors
abstract: A new preparation method of magnets for high efficient small motors using the new materials other than melt-spinning Nd/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B flakes is studied. The proposed isotropic and anisotropic magnetic powder has (BH)/sub max/ values of 40-14- kJ/m/sup 3/, and had a good corrosion resistance compared with the conventional melt-spun Nd/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B flakes.

articleTitle: Magnetization reversal in sub-micron nanoring arrays
abstract: In this paper, we report on the magnetization reversal exhibited by arrays of sub-micron ring-shaped nanomagnets (nanoings). The nanoring arrays were characterized by scanning electron microscopy and atomic force microscopy.

articleTitle: Precise multipole magnetization of disc magnet for sensor application
abstract: In this paper, the solution based on the coupled problem the angular distances between the slots of the magnetizing fixture were determined. A prototype fixture was built and tested. The output from the Hall sensor placed at 1 mm from the disc magnet. The magnetic fields was sensed with the resolution of 1000 points per one degree, Based on the magnetization was detected as +/- 0.5 degree per pole.

articleTitle: Memory of texture during HDDR processing of NdFeB
abstract: In this paper, we describes the mechanism of texture generation in the recombined powder. Here Nd/sub 12.5/Fe/sub bal/B/sub 6.3/ and Nd/sub 12.5/Fe/sub bal/Ga/sub 0.3/Nb/sub 0.3/B/sub 6.3/ alloys have been HDDR processed and hydrogen partial pressures and dwell times during disproportionation and recombination have been varied systematically. The effect of these processing parameters on the microstructural and magnetic properties is described. Intermediate processing stages were characterized by XRD employing Rietveld analysis, field emission gun scanning electron microscopy, transmission electron microscopy using EDX and selected area diffraction.
