The degree of texture in aligned recombined powders has been characterized by magnetic measurements using a VSM and qualitatively by Kerr microscopy. Crystallographic relationships between parent, disproportionated and recombined phases are described.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional FE analysis of disc type high-speed PM generators
abstract: In this paper, we discussed three-dimensional FE analysis of disc type high-speed PM generators.

articleTitle: Author index
abstract: The author index contains an entry for each author and coauthor included in the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Intermag 2003 Program Of The 2003 IEEE International Magnetics Conference
abstract: Presents the front cover, front matter, and table of contents from the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: The annealing temperature dependence of magnetic properties in Sr-ferrite nanoparticles
abstract: In this paper, we have analyzed the dependence of magnetic properties on annealing temperature in Sr-ferrite nanoparticles were prepared by sol-gel method. Magnetic and structural properties of the powders were characterized with a Mossbauer spectroscopy , vibrating sample magnetometer (VSM), X-ray diffractometer (XRD), scanning electron spectroscopy (SEM), thermogravimetry (TG), and differential thermal analysis (DTA).

articleTitle: Spin wave wells with multiple states created in small magnetic elements
abstract: In this paper, we report the first observation of several localised spin wave modes corresponding to multiple quantized states in a SWW. We formulate a phase quantization condition that takes into account the phase jumps at the turning points and these conditions are confirmed by the experimental data.

articleTitle: Topology of Nd-Fe-B magnets with a high energy density
abstract: In this paper, the dependence of the microstructural topology of sintered Nd-Fe-B magnets on the Nd-rich constituents and on the B-content has been investigated under different sintering conditions. The impact of the microstructure on the magnetic properties of the sintered magnets is reported.

articleTitle: Semi-analytical method with cylindrical elements in electromagnetic field visualization
abstract: In this paper, we discussing about proposes a semi-analytical method, which is one of the equivalent circuit approaches.

articleTitle: Position detection of brushless DC motor using inductance bridge system
abstract: In this paper, enhanced systems are developed for detecting the position of rotor based on the inductance variation of phase coils. The inactive or un-energized phase coils can be used as a sensor to detect the magnet rotor position by applying known reference signals and measuring the amplitudes of the returned responses.

articleTitle: Intergrain interactions in nanocrystalline isotropic PrFeB-based magnets
abstract: In this paper, Pr/sub 9/Nd/sub 3.0/Dy/sub 1/Fe/sub 72/Co/sub 8/B/sub 6.9/Zr/sub 0.1/ alloy has been used to prepare a series of nanocomposites by intensive milling with various amounts of Fe. Exchange-coupling phenomena have been studied by analyzing the evolution of the corresponding /spl delta/J values when varying the i) Fe content, ii) annealing temperature, i.e. grain size, and iii) measurement temperature, i.e. variation of the exchange length.

articleTitle: Magnetic switching of Nb/Ni multilayers near the superconducting critical temperature
abstract: In this paper explained the magnetic switching of Nb/Ni multilayers. The films were prepared by DC magnetron sputtering on Si substrate. Isothermal magnetisation curves were obtained.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic analysis of bit decay in perpendicular recording media
abstract: In this paper, realistic grain configurations were used to seek the critical grain magnetization and anisotropy field of magnetic media that are thermally stable for ultra high density recording.

articleTitle: Magnetic entropy change in the Ge-rich alloys Gd5(SixGe/sub 1-x/)4
abstract: In this paper, magnetic entropy change in the Ge-rich alloys Gd/sub 5/(Si/sub x/Ge/sub 1-x/)/sub 4/ was measured. These alloys holds the higher magnetic anisotropy change of all known magnetic refrigerants in their respective temperature range. The isothermal magnetization measurements in the temperature range of T/sub c/ and T/sub N/ were performed.

articleTitle: MEMS technology for the fabrication of RF magnetic components
abstract: MEMS technology can be utilized for the fabrication of magnetic structures in multiple frequency ranges, ranging from low-MHz metal-core devices for DC-DC converters to high-frequency dielectric or air core devices for RF application. They can also be fabricated in multiple locations: integral with silicon chips; in the interconnect layer between chip and board; and directly on the printed wiring board, in order to yield ultracompact magnetic microsystems. This payer describes examples of each of these fabrication approaches: high frequency dielectric-core inductors for CMOS power amplifiers integrated on chip; high-frequency air-core inductors fabricated within the interconnected layer between chip and board; and low-frequency metal-core inductors for DC-DC power conversion.

articleTitle: Flat-surface magneto-optic spatial light modulator
abstract: In this paper, for the first time, we report the flat-surface magneto-optic spatial light modulators without the artificially isolation of pixels and external bias coil.

articleTitle: Synthetic antiferromagnetic exchange tab GMR heads with PtMn tab recessed from the track edges
abstract: In this paper, a synthetic antiferromagnetic exchange tab with recessed antiferromagnet layer was proposed by modeling. We have fabricated actual heads with this synthetic exchange tab design and tested at a spin stand level.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation model of switched reluctance generator
abstract: In this paper, we present a simulation model useful for dynamic analysis of the SRG.

articleTitle: Observation and simulation study of dynamic load process
abstract: In this paper, dynamic load processes were studied with the 3D system and also by simulation. Some details of load process unseen in either experimental or simulation studies before are observed.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of CoCrPt thin films on self-assembled PS-PVP diblock copolymer template
abstract: In this paper, we have investigated magnetic properties of Co/sub 68/Cr/sub 18/Pt/sub 14/ thin films deposited on nanopatterned polystyrene (PS) -polyvinylpyridine (PVP) diblock copolymer.

articleTitle: Magnetic moment of the 4f/sup n/ and 4f/sup n-1/5d electronic configurations of Tb/sup 3+/ ions in wide band gap fluoride dielectric crystals
abstract: In this paper we investigate the fundamental electronic, electron-phonon, spin-orbit and spin-spin interaction of the 4f/sup n/ and 4f/sup n-1/5d electronic configurations of trivalent rare earth ions in wide band gap fluoride dielectric crystals and magnetic properties are studied.

articleTitle: Thermal and Mn diffusion behaviors of CoNbZr based spin valves with nano-oxide layers
abstract: In this paper, we investigated specularity and thermal characteristics of the CoNbZr based spinvalves with and without employing nano-oxide layers (NOL). In addition we attempted to explain Mn diffusion behaviors with respect to the difference in oxygen potentials.

articleTitle: Indirect identification of magnetostriction properties of SiFe alloys
abstract: In this paper, it deals with the identification of the magnetostrictive properties of nonoriented (NO) and grain oriented (GO) materials using the variation of the magnetization characteristics when considering different values of the applied mechanical stress.

articleTitle: Spin injection from a ferromagnetic metal into a semiconductor without a tunneling barrier
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate that spin injection in an Fe/p-InAs heterostructure without a tunnelling barrier. The external magnetic impedance of circularly polarization of the luminescence from the Fe/p-InAs heterostructure at 6.5, 50 and 70 k are shown.

articleTitle: Read channels for pre-patterned media, with trench playback
abstract: In this paper, the trench media can produce significant playback signals, since the maximum trench depth is comparable to the bit size a lithographic minimum feature size requirement. By DC magnetizing the trenches, their signal is a repeatable signal polarity pulse (bit writing must not switch the trench media).

articleTitle: Numerical switching experiments for perpendicular recording
abstract: In this work, we numerically investigate the effect of intergranular exchange, media texture, easy axes distribution, and the field profile on the switching speed.

articleTitle: Applying amorphous CoNbZr shield to improve the dielectric-breakdown voltages of the gap layers of narrow-gap read heads
abstract: In this paper, the effect of the lower shield materials on the breakdown voltage of the lower insulating gap layer has been investigated. A hybrid shield CoNbZr layer on NiFe shield was applied ton the read , and the resulting narrow gap head's performance in reading was observed.

articleTitle: Kerr microscopy study of polycrystalline thin film stripes
abstract: In this article, we observed strong dipolar coupling between magnetic strips influencing the resulting magnetisation patterns. The resulting domain structures depend not only on the magnetic anisotropy, but also strongly on the magnetic history of the samples.

articleTitle: Effects of electron doping on the magnetic properties of double pervoskites A/sub 2/FeMoO/sub 6/ (A=Ca and Ba)
abstract: In this paper, in order to figure out some defects of the substitution of A/sup 2+/ by La/sup 3+/, magnetic properties of A/sub 2-x/La/sub x/FeMo/sub 6/O/sub 6/ have been investigated.

articleTitle: Performance of Halbach magnetised brushless ac motor
abstract: In this paper, an anisotropic bonded NdFeB Halbach magnetised ring magnet, which is oriented in powder alignment system during injection moulding and subsequently impulse magnetised, is employed. The features of such a Halbach magnetised machine, in terms of the airgap field distribution, and the back-emf and cogging torque waveforms, etc. have been compared with those which result with a Halbach magnet having discrete magnet segments have previously been compared.

articleTitle: Room temperature ferromagnetism of manganese doped rutile titanium dioxide thin films
abstract: In this paper, the magnetic properties of Mn/sub x/Ti/sub 1-x/O/sub 2/ thin films were reported. The M-H curve of Mn/sub 0.15/Ti/sub 0.85/O/sub 2/ films was measured at 300K. The hysteresis with the coercive force (Hc) about 22 Oe was showed. The films exhibit ferromagnetic behaviors at room temperature.

articleTitle: Magnetotransport in an n-type diluted magnetic semiconductor: (Ga,Mn)N
abstract: In this paper, magnetotransport in the ferromagnetic epitaxial (Ga,Mn)N films grown by plasma-enhanced molecular beam epitaxy (PEMBE) was reported. The variation of magnetoresistance (/spl Delta/R/R) with magnetic fields applied perpendicular to the sample was reported.

articleTitle: Formation of metastable Pr/sub 2/Fe/sub 23/B/sub 3/ phase and its effect on magnetic properties in rapidly quenched Pr/sub 9/Fe/sub 91-x/B/sub x/ (x=4-12) magnets
abstract: In this paper, a series of rapidly quenched nanocomposites with the composition of Pr/sub 9/Fe/sub 91-x/B/sub x/ (x=4-12) were studied. Our studies were focused on the formation of the metastable Pr/sub 2/Fe/sub 23/B/sub 3/ phase and its effect on hard magnetic properties.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of thermally annealed (Ni/sub 80/Fe/sub 20/)/sub 1-x/Mnx thin films
abstract: We describe the magnetic properties of thermally annealed (Ni/sub 80/Fe/sub 20/)/sub 1-x/Mn/sub x/ thin films and their inverse magnetoresistance.

articleTitle: Growth and stability of highly coercive, highly textured NdFeB films
abstract: In this paper, for the thin film growth, we first examine the conditions necessary to obtain highly coercive, highly textured NdFeB films and then examine the stability of these films as this will be a crucial feature for the application of rare-earth magnets as thin films. Under optimal conditions, films having almost perfect magnetic texture and coercivities above 1.5 T can be prepared.

articleTitle: Electrodeposited FePt films
abstract: In this paper we reported the preparation of continuous FePt films by electrodeposition from a different bath and present their structural and magnetic characterization. SEM was studied for as deposited and annealed films.

articleTitle: Synthesis, self-assembly, and magnetic properties of [FePt]/sub 1-x/Au/sub x/ nanoparticles
abstract: In this paper, we report on the synthesis of self-assembled [FePt]/sub 1-x/Au/sub x/ nanoparticles and the even greater beneficial effect of the added gold on the phase transformation. The particles were prepared using a modification of the procedure reported by Sun et.al. The synthesis involved the thermal decomposition of iron pentacarbonyl and the reduction of platinum acetylacetone and gold acetate with 1,2- hexadecanediol in phenyl ether.

articleTitle: Laser pumped readout technology applied to the CAD type MSR disk
abstract: In this paper, the effect of the laser pumped readout method on the characteristics of the iD PHOTO system.

articleTitle: Head-disk interface instability due to intermolecular forces
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the effects of intermolecular forces on the dynamic stability of the HDI.

articleTitle: Extendability of CIP spin-valve sensors to narrow dimensions
abstract: In this paper, we study the recording head, the parasitic lead resistance makes the spin-valve performance and its properties.

articleTitle: 2D FE Analysis of hybrid stepping motor(HSM) using virtual magnetic barrier
abstract: In this paper, we describe the 2D finite element analysis of hybrid step motor (HSM) using virtual magnetic barrier.

articleTitle: Thermally activated switching of small magnetic tunnel junctions
abstract: Small magnetic tunnel junctions were prepared and the magnetization reversal of their free layers was studied by applying high-speed reversal fields driven by pulsed currents. From the decay of the switching field with the number of pulses or the pulse length the thermal activation energy was deduced. Large cells (width>150 nm) showed a significant lower activation energy than expected from single-domain-theory, indicating non-uniform switching. Small cells (width /spl sim/ 90 nm and length 150 to 200 nm) could be well described by Stoner-Wohlfarth single domain model and single step switching with Arrhenius activation energy. For scaling of magnetic random access memories down to 100 nm this would indicate that a smaller free layer volume is to a large degree compensated by higher relative activation energy due to more uniform switching.

articleTitle: A comparison of genetic algorithm and subregion approach in the optimization of slider air bearing for sub-7 nm flying height
abstract: This paper presents the design of a sub-7nm air bearing slider using both the genetic algorithm and the subregion method, and compares the results obtained with each approach.

articleTitle: Characterization of soft magnetic thin film by means of single sheet testing
abstract: In this paper, a miniature single sheet tester, was used to characterize soft magnetic thin film with a thickness of 1 /spl mu/m. Experiments were performed on Atalante, an amorphous soft magnetic cobalt-alloy thin film on a flexible PET substrate. The magnetic thin film thickness is 1 /spl mu/m and the substrate thickness is typically 23 /spl mu/m. The magnetic coating is applied by dc-magnetron sputtering in a web coater.

articleTitle: Planar hall effects and magnetoresistance in Co/Cu/Ni/sub 80/Fe/sub 20/ multilayers
abstract: In this paper, we have investigated the magnetisation reversal process in [Co (10nm)/Cu (t/sub Cu/)/Ni/sub 80/Fe/sub 20/ (10nm)]/sub 2/ multilayers using a combination of planar Hall effects (PHE) and anisotropic magnetoresistance (AMR) measurements. Planar Hall devices were fabricated on Si(100) substrates using conventional shadow mask technique. Firstly, Co/Cu/Ni/sub 80/Fe/sub 20/ multilayers were prepared by DC sputtering at 10mTorr Ar gas pressure onto a six terminal device shadow mask placed on top of a Si(100) substrate.

articleTitle: Microstructural study of dependence of magnetic properties of nonoriented electrical steel on applied mechanical load
abstract: In this paper, the dependence of the magnetic properties of electrical steel on the applied mechanical load is investigated on basis of the microstructural analysis. The special setup was used in the current investigation that allows carrying out the magnetic measurements under applied tensile stress up to destruction of the sample.

articleTitle: Spin-polarized nanodevice for future information technologies
abstract: In this paper, an experimental and theoretical study of a continuous magnetic junction of the nanoscale size is presented. Such nanosize junction was created in a thin film Permalloy (Ni/Fe 80/20) layer via focused ion beam etching (FIB) etching. The specially developed FIB process allows for creating continuous magnetic bridges with dimensions in the nanoscale range. The geometry of the structure is chosen with the purpose to create a condition for triggering a magnetic wall, as the external magnetic field is applied.

articleTitle: A novel high gain silicon based spin transistor
abstract: In this paper, we fabricate a novel high gain silicon based spin transistor and measured the minority carrier transport in the silicon. When measured with a magnetic field applied in the plane of the transistor and perpendicular to the direction of the current flow, the I-V characteristics show a variation in the collector current causing the transistor to behave as a magnetically tunable device with a field dependent gain.

articleTitle: A systematic construction of capacity-achieving irregular low-density parity-check codes
abstract: In this paper, we propose symmetric method to split column and rows of parity-check matrix (H/sup reg/) of regular LDPC code in order to construct capacity-achieving irregular LDPC code with a given distribution (/spl Lambda//sup req/, /spl Omega//sup req/).

articleTitle: Influence of magnetic properties to the magnetization dynamics of high resistivity magnetic films
abstract: In this paper, magnetic properties of amorphous CoZrTa films and the magnetization dynamics of high resistivity magnetic films was demonstrated. The magnetic properties of the films were characterized by inductive BH-looper measurement at 10 Hz.

articleTitle: A study of turbo coding and decoding using AR channel model
abstract: In this paper proposed the posteriori probability (APP) decoder which obtains the estimated values for the respective state transitions by using an autoregressive (AR) channel model. This paper also explained the BER performance in the perpendicular magnetic recording channel.

articleTitle: Low temperature annealing effect on plasma sprayed MnZn ferrite for planar transformers of high frequency applications
abstract: In this paper, low temperature annealing effect on plasma sprayed MnZn ferrite for planar transformers of high frequency applications was investigated.

articleTitle: Modelling and optimization of the magnetic circuit of a mobile nuclear magnetic resonance device for magnetic resonance imaging
abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging, commonly known as MRI. is a powerful noninvasive imaging technique in clinical practice and material science. Unlike x-ray based computed tomography (CT) MRI doesn't use ionising radiation and hence is considered safe. The resolution of MRI basically depends on the homogeneity and field strength of the primary magnetic field B/sub 0/ over the volume of interest. In clinical tomographs homogeneous fields are produced by solenoid coil windings with high current excitation. Those high currents require active shielding of the stray fields and helium cooling of the equipment. These solutions are unsuitable for mobile usage because of costs and especially weight. The digest introduces an optimized magnetic circuit for a Mobile Universal Surface Explorer called MOUSE which meets the requirements of sufficient homogeneity and low weight and costs.

articleTitle: FEM analysis of single pole type head for 1 TBPSI recording
abstract: In this paper, FEM simulation was carries out to obtain an SPT head with large recording field, small stray and skew-effect-free field distribution.

articleTitle: NiZn ferrite thick film with nano scale crystallite formed by aerosol deposition method
abstract: The purpose of this investigation is to apply the ADM to the fabrication of ferrite films and to investigate their magnetic properties.

articleTitle: Magnetic equivalent circuit of PM hysteresis synchronous motor
abstract: This paper presents the magnetic equivalent circuit of a permanent magnet hysteresis synchronous (PMHS) motor. The hybrid synchronous motor consists of 30% Cobalt-steel hysteresis alloys Neodymium Iron Boron (NdFeB) permanent magnets to improve the overall performances of motors.

articleTitle: Mossbauer studies of /sup 57/Fe-doped anatase TiO/sub 2/
abstract: In this paper, the magnetic properties of /sup 57/Fe-doped TiO/sub 2/ with varying /sup 57/Fe contents were studied. In order to determine magnetic behavior and ion state of doped transition metal (/sup 57/Fe) in TiO/sub 2/, Mossbauer studies were carried out.

articleTitle: Epitaxial growth of the diluted magnetic semiconductors CryGe/sub 1-y/, (Cr,Mn):Ge, and Fe/sub z/Ge/sub 1-x/
abstract: The molecular beam epitaxial growth of the diluted magnetic semiconductors Cr/sub y/Ge/sub 1-y/, (Cr,Mn):Ge, and Fe/sub z/Ge/sub 1-x/ was reported and the structural, magnetic and transport properties of the samples were described.

articleTitle: Lamination material anisotropy and its influence on the operation of inverter-fed induction machines
abstract: In modern inverter-fed machines the exploitation of the transient electrical behavior becomes of increasing interest to obtain additional information on the machine state with speed sensorless flux/rotor position detection schemes or fault condition methods. In the application of these methods it turned out that the anisotropy of the lamination material, which is usually negligible in the fundamental wave behavior of the machines influences the transient control signals and may act as a disturbance during operation. In this paper the anisotropy is determined by hysteresis and torque measurements of lamination sheet as well as by the evaluation of the transient electrical behavior of industrially manufactured inverter fed induction machines.

articleTitle: Fabrication of a repulsive type magnetic bearing using a novel arrangement of permanent magnets for rotor suspension
abstract: In repulsive type magnetic bearing system usually the rotor is levitated by the repulsive forces between stator and rotor permanent magnets. The system is unstable in nature. The controlled electromagnet is used to keep the rotor in the desired position. The repulsive magnetic bearing system has the advantages of using a smaller number of electromagnets and simplified control scheme compared to active magnetic bearing system. The advantages of using magnetic bearing system compared to mechanical bearing in high speed motors are long life, frictionless and lubrication free operation, feasible operation at high speed etc. Two repulsive magnetic bearing systems using permanent magnets for the levitation were fabricated a few years back and their levitation and control performance were compared. Material characteristics and configuration of permanent magnets are the central component for this type of bearing system. Due to aging and/or as both the magnets are repelling each other, there will be demagnetization of the permanent magnet, resulting the field distribution along the magnet's periphery non-uniform and this will affect the performance of the bearing system.

articleTitle: The effect of Pr and Zr substitutions on the disproportionation reaction in NdFeB-based materials
abstract: In this paper, we have looked at the influence of praseodymium and zirconium on the disproportion stage of the HDDR process in order to explain the observed variations in magnetic properties.

articleTitle: The magnetic and structural properties of pulsed laser deposited epitaxial CoFe/sub 2/O/sub 4/ and CoFe/sub 2/O/sub 4//CoFe/sub 2/ bilayer films
abstract: In this paper reported the results of our investigation of the temperature dependence of magnetization and magnetic anisotropy of single crystalline CoFe/sub 2/O/sub 4/ films and CoFe/sub 2/O/sub 4//CoFe/sub 2/ bilayers, determined by vibrating sample magnetometry and torque magnetometry, respectively; and the related structure and microstructure as determined by X-ray diffraction and atomic force microscopy.

articleTitle: Critical fields and critical angles for pulse precessional switchings of thin magnetic films
abstract: In this paper, the analytical of this problem is undertaken with the purpose to find the explicit expressions for the critical fields and critical angles for precessional switchings.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of a real FePt nanoparticle system
abstract: In this paper, we report a chemically ordered and agglomeration-free FePt nanoparticles system, which is enabled by adding an agglomeration inhibitor. The inhibitor is so effective that gives agglomeration-free status after post-anneal under vacuum, even if it is carried out at 800/spl deg/C. This method therefore revealed magnetic properties of FePt as isolated nanoparticles.

articleTitle: The microstructure due to RE-TM underlayer in a TbFeCo memory layer for high-density magneto-optical recording
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the seeding effect of an RE-TM amorphous magnetic multilayer for growing a TbFeCo memory layer and also discusses the feasibility of high-density recording on an MO medium. The saturation magnetization and coercivity of sample layers were analyzed.

articleTitle: Study of exchange bias field variation in ferrimagnetic/ferrimagnetic bilayer system
abstract: In this paper, amorphous bilayer Gd/sub 40/Fe/sub 60/(100 nm)/Tb/sub 12/Fe/sub 88/(50 nm) the cooling field procedure. A uni-directional micro-magnetic model permits to reproduce the various measured hysteresis loop and give a full understanding of the magnetization reversal processes involved.

articleTitle: Dynamics of textured pico-sliders during contact start/stop
abstract: In this paper, we study the effect of slider texture on the start/stop characteristics of a "pico" slider flying at a flying height of 7 nm at a disk velocity of 20 m/s.

articleTitle: Influence of weak magnetic out-of-plane anisotropy in magnetic shields on recording head instability parameters
abstract: In this paper, we report on the origin and the influence of small changes in magnetic properties of magnetically soft Sendust films, used as a bottom shield, on instability parameters derived from quasi-static measurements.

articleTitle: A non-contact charge system of an electric vehicle in the next generation
abstract: In this paper, we describe the complete operating principle and theoretical analysis of non-contact charge system of an inductive coupler transformer.

articleTitle: Proposal and analysis of a ferromagnetic triple-barrier resonant-tunneling spin filter
abstract: In this paper, a new type of spin filter that uses a triple-barrier structure was proposed. The proposed device consists of a non-magnetic and a ferromagnet QW. The inherent peaked I-V characteristics in the triple barrier resonant structure result in a distinct peak separation of the up-spin and the down-spin components regarding the bias voltage, which leads to an exceedingly high spin polarization. The spin dependent tunneling current and the tunnel-barrier-width dependence of both the spin polarization and the current density were theoretically calculated.

articleTitle: Microstructure and segregation effect of Co/Pd multilayer perpendicular magnetic recording media
abstract: In this report, we have investigated addition of boron with modulated contents in depth profile and microstructure by a transmission electron microscopy (TEM) with high annular angle dark field (HAADF) detector to evaluate segregation effect.

articleTitle: Non-contact GMR measurements of synthetic spin valves using infrared reflection spectroscopy
abstract: In this paper, the sputtered synthetic spin valve samples studied consisted of a pinned layer of an antiferromagnetically coupled CoFe/Ru/CoFe trilayer in direct contact with a layer of the antiferromagnet PtMn. The pinned layer is separated from the free CoFe/NiFe bilayer by a layer of Cu. Two variations of this structure were studied. A top spin valve (TSV) with the pinned layer at the top of the stack and a bottom spin valve (BSV) with the pinned layer at the bottom of the stack. The samples were magnetically characterized using a VSM and dc magnetotransport measurements were made using a four-point probe in a maximum applied magnetic field of /spl plusmn/9 kOe. IR spectra were acquired between 2.5 and 20 /spl mu/m using a Nicolet Fourier transform IR reflection spectrometer. The optimum MRE was obtained for s polarised light using a KRS-5 grid polariser and for an incidence angle of 65/sup o/ with respect to the surface normal.

articleTitle: A study of ACSN comparison between spin-stand and magnet force microscopy
abstract: In this work, the measurements of the autocorrelation signal to noise (ASCN) have been made using bot standard testing and magnetic force microscopy methods (MFM).

articleTitle: Rashba effect in a FM/I/2DEG/I/FM structure
abstract: In this paper, we consider the ballistic charge transport across a ferromagnet(FM)/tunnel barrier(I)/two dimensional electron gas (2DEG)/I/FM structure, where a thin insulating (I) barrier has been interested to overcome the conductivity mismatch problem at the FM-2DEG interface. The Rashba spin-orbit interaction which arises due to a gate-induced structural inversion asymmetry. The combined Rashba interaction and spin-dependent transmission across the barriers give rise to a high degree of spin polarization of current within the 2DEG. The device also exhibits a strong magnetoconductance (Mc) behavior when the relative magnetisation of the FM contacts is switched.

articleTitle: Spin injection, spin transport, and electrical detection of spin precession in mesoscopic spin valves
abstract: In this paper, we have studied spin transport, spin injection and electrical detection in multiterminal mesoscopic spin-valve structures based on Cu and Al as the non-magnetic media, connected to ferromagnetic (Py,Ni and Co) electrodes, with transport contacts.

articleTitle: Effect of lattice strain on soft magnetic properties in FeCo/NiFe(Cr) thin films with 2.4 T
abstract: In this paper, soft magnetism of FeCo/NiFe(Cr) films is discussed relating to lattice strain of the FeCo layer. Films were deposited by ultra high vacuum (UHV) dc magnetron sputtering onto glass substrates (Corning 7059). Ta films of 5 nm thickness was used as seed and protective layers, respectively. Fe-25%Co and Fe-30%Co alloy targets were subjected to the study. Ni/sub 79/Fe/sub 21/ or (Ni/sub 79/Fe/sub 21/)/sub 73/Cr/sub 27/targets were used for the deposition of NiFe or NiFeCr layers.

articleTitle: On the performance of soft Reed-Solomon decoding for magnetic recording channels with erasures
abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the performance of soft decoded RS codes in the prescence of erasures, and compare it with LDPC codes. We present realistic simulation results on the magnetic recording channel.

articleTitle: Iron nanoparticles coated with boron nitride nanolayers synthesized by a solid phase reaction
abstract: In this paper, we have developed a new technique which uses Fe/sub 2/O/sub 3/ and B powders as a raw material, and synthesized Fe nanoparticles of around 200nm in diameter coated with BN nanolayers of 5nm in thickness under a solid phase reaction. Saturation magnetization showed that Fe/sub 2/O/sub 3/ were reduced to Fe almost completely.

articleTitle: Analysis of a shielded writer for perpendicular recording
abstract: In this paper, we analyzed the properties of shielded writers, including both theoretical and experiment analysis. It is shown for example, that thinner pole tips can be used, thus reducing non-zero skew-angle sensitivity as compared to the regular SPH structure.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of Cu/sub 1+x/M/sub x/Fe/sub 2-2x/O/sub 4/ mixed ferrites (M=Ti, Ge, 0/spl les/x/spl les/0.4)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the magnetic properties of Cu/sub 1+x/M/sub x/Fe/sub 2-2x/O/sub 4/ mixed ferrites (M=Ti, Ge, 0/spl les/x/spl les/0.4) using X-ray diffraction, Mossbauer spectroscopy and magnetic susceptibility measurements.

articleTitle: Writing process on a permeable recording layer: a fundamental issue in perpendicular recording
abstract: In this paper, we describe the writing process on a perpendicular recording medium from both a simple reluctance analysis and complete micromagnetics simulations. The pertinent discussion is given on the correlation between the deep gap field and the magnetisation state of a recording medium.

articleTitle: New ferromagnetic Heusler alloys
abstract: In this paper described about the synthesis of the magnetic shape memory alloys Ni/sub 2/FeGa, Mn/sub 2/FeSn and Co/sub 50/Ni/sub 30/Ga/sub 20/ and their characterization magnetic susceptibility, martensitic transformation, XRD, TEM were studied.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of bio-magnetic sensors and magnetic nanobead labels for DNA detection and identification
abstract: In this paper, the main challenges in developing a magnetic DNA microarray include: 1) The spin valve sensors must be sensitive to as few as 1-10 nanobeads to be useful for applications such as biological pathogen detection; to achieve this, the distance between the sensor and magnetic labels must be minimized. 2) The nanobeads must be monodisperse, water soluble, chemically and magnetically stable, and functionalized to attach to a DNA fragment; the nanobeads should also be superparamagnetic so that they will not agglomerate in the absence of applied fields. 3) The bio-magnetic DNA microarrays need to be designed to maximise the active sensing surface area.

articleTitle: Ta doping effect on Co/sub 60/C/sub 40/ thin films
abstract: In this paper, Ta doping effect on microstructure and magnetic properties of Co/sub 60/C/sub 40/ was detailed studied. Its characterization analyzed by XRD, VSM, TEM and MFM.

articleTitle: Modeling of exchange constants and electronic structure of manganese ferrite (MnFe/sub 2/O/sub 4/)
abstract: In this paper we study about the electronic structure and magnetic properties of the manganese ferrite (MnFe/sub 2/O/sub 4/). Electronic calculations of exchange constants and the calculated total energies of assumed magnetic structures are substituted into the Heisenberg model.

articleTitle: Levitation and recovery force analysis of controlled linear synchronous motor by using 3-D EMCN
abstract: In this paper, 3-D Equivalent Magnetic Circuit Network (EMCN) is used to solve detailed field computation considering asymmetric lateral displacement. The purpose of this paper is to analyze lateral and levitation characteristics of permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (PMLSM) by using 3-D EMCN and propose an optimal control scheme in controlled magnetic levitation stage considering the asymmetrical state.

articleTitle: Dynamic single magnetic bead detection using GMR sensor: experimental verification of simulated behavior
abstract: In this paper, we describe a chip capable of giving position-time information of the magnetic behaviour of one single bead and we will compare the detected single bead signature with simulated data. The magnetoresistance of the spin-value sensor was measured to be 3% for an integrated device of 1.4x6 /spl mu/m/sup 2/. The sensitivity reaches 0.10 %/Oe.

articleTitle: Development of high resolution SQUID magnetometer for biomagnetic measurement
abstract: In this paper, we developed a super high resolution SQUID magnetometer for biomagnetics measurements having higher spatial resolution than previous systems. We discuss the spatial resolution of this SQUID system obtained from a current source model.

articleTitle: Thermal magnetization rotation of small nanoparticles
abstract: In this paper, thermal magnetization rotation of small Co nanoparticles was investigated. We test the performance and validity of a semi-implicit time integration scheme.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic study of magnetic domain structures in submicron Cu/Ni/Cu(001) discs
abstract: In this paper, we present our micromagnetic results on domain structures in Cu/Ni/Cu(001) thin nanodiscs. The investigations are performed by means of numerical simulations based on Brown's static micromagnetic principles.

articleTitle: Effect of deposition parameters on exchange bias studied using Lorentz and high resolution electron microscopy
abstract: Current theories for exchange bias (EB) do not satisfactorily predict the EB shift and enhanced coercivity prompting further experimental investigations. In previous studies, the effects of deposition parameters have been studied individually. In this work, the effects of four key parameters have been investigated: (a) type of antiferromagnetic (AFM) material (NiO and NiMn); (b) effect of annealing (No annealing and at 300 /spl deg/C); (c) partial pressure of N/sub 2/ during permalloy (Py) deposition (0% and 7%s of total chamber gas pressure); and (d) presence or absence of Ta buffer layer. A 2/sup n-1/-factorial design of experiments, where n is the number of variables, has been used to optimize the set of experiments. A total of 8 samples (=2/sup 4-1/ samples according to the design of experiments principles) were deposited in a magnetron sputtering chamber in a vacuum of 5 /spl times/ 10-8 Torr. These were later field-cooled in a field of 150 Oe from a temperature of 300 /spl deg/C to induce uniaxial magnetic anisotropy. Vibrating sample magnetometry (VSM) was used to plot the B-H curves of the samples. Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS) was used to confirm the thickness of the deposited bilayers. X-ray diffraction (XRD) /spl theta/-2/spl theta/ scans were used to study the preferred orientation of growth. High-resolution electron microscopy and Lorentz microscopy have been used to correlate the microstructure and the micromagnetic behavior with the deposition parameters.

articleTitle: Top exchange biasing enhancement in X/IrMn/Py and X/IrMn/Co multilayers
abstract: In this paper, we show that in the F/AF/F trilayers this effect is independent on the crystallographic quality or roughness of the antiferromagnetic layer or on magnetic interactions between the two ferromagnetic layers. On the contrary, this effect is found to be reminiscent of a domain structure induced in the antiferromagnetic layer by the underlying ferromagnetic layer during the multilayer growth.

articleTitle: Antiferromagnetically coupled perpendicular recording media
abstract: In this paper, we will analyse the stabilization mechanism of antiferromagnetically coupled perpendicular (AFCP) media by calculating the effective energy barrier for the magnetization reversal of pair of antiferromagnetically coupled single domain magnetic grains.

articleTitle: FE analysis for optimum pole arcs for a switched reluctance motor
abstract: In this paper, the results of a 2-D finite element (FE) analysis carried out on a 8/6 switched reluctance motor (SRM) with a view to arrive at the optimum pole areas for the stator and rotor are presented.

articleTitle: Spin-polarized tunneling in ultrasmall vertical ferromagnetic tunnel junctions: effect of Coulomb blockade
abstract: In this paper, spin polarised electron tunneling in ultrasmall FIF tunnel junctions at relatively high temperatures was studied. The magnetoresistance of ultrasmall FIF junctions was strongly enhanced in the Coulomb blockade regime by reduction of the higher-order tunneling process.

articleTitle: The role of interstitial manganese in manganese-doped ferromagnetic semiconductors
abstract: We present a theory of interstitial Mn in Mn-doped ferromagnetic semiconductors. Using density-functional theory, we show that under the non-equilibrium conditions of growth, interstitial Mn is easily formed near the surface by a simple low-energy adsorption pathway. In GaAs, isolated interstitial Mn is an electron donor, each compensating two substitutional Mn acceptors. Within an impurity-band model, partial compensation promotes ferromagnetic order below the metal-insulator transition, with the high Curie temperature occurring for 0.5 holes per substitutional Mn.

articleTitle: High perpendicular magnetic anisotropy of FePt-Ag composite film onto amorphous substrate
abstract: In this paper, an Ag layer was deposited on the MgO underlayer prior to the FePt/Ag multilayer. Crystal structure and magnetic properties of a FePt/Ag film with the Ag underlayer were a FePt/Ag multilayer film without the Ag layer.

articleTitle: Effect of surface resistance of metal evaporated tape on discharging current
abstract: In this paper, we obtain higher recording density, a GMR head would be used. This head is more sensitive to ESD current than the AMR head. We found that the higher surface resistance of ME tape was effective in reducing the discharging current through the MR head.

articleTitle: Magnetoresistance modulation in single-electron transistors
abstract: In this paper, we model the current and magnetoresistance of a single electron transistor (SET), consisting of an island, separated by thin tunnel barriers from two ferromagnetic electrodes. By using the gate V/sub g/ or source-drain V/sub ds/ bias, the MR of the SET can be modulated externally, the degree of which depends on junction symmetry, non-equilibrium spin accumulation and higher order cotunneling.

articleTitle: Noncontact atomic force microscopy imaging of antiferromagnetic NiO(001) surface using ferromagnetic Fe-coated Si tip
abstract: In this article, we performed an NC-AFM imaging of an antiferromagnetic NiO(001) surface with a ferromagnetic Fe-coated Si tip in order to explore the possibility of detecting short-range magnetic interactions.

articleTitle: Design and pressure control of high pressure differential magnetic fluid seals
abstract: In this paper, the design methods and pressure control for this kind of magnetic fluid seal are presented and a seal device is designed and tested.

articleTitle: Write frequency dependence of power loss in inductive heads
abstract: In this paper, the AC power loss due to joule heating from the write coil is calculated using Fourier series approach. This calculation is to predict TPTP as functions of write current, write frequency (up to 1 GHz), current rise time, and overshoot. After deriving the Fourier series for a periodic current waveform at harmonic frequencies (I/sub n/), we compute the power loss (I/sub n//sup 2/ Rac) at each harmonic. Sum of power loss of each harmonic will give the total AC power loss of inductive head. A GMR head for 60 Gb/in/sup 2/ areal density is used for this study.

articleTitle: Array codes for magnetic recording channels with erasures
abstract: In this paper, we use ALDPC codes on magnetic recording systems for both random error and erasure correction. The codes are compared with random binary codes.

articleTitle: A simple method to prepare uniform Co nanoparticles
abstract: We report a novel and simple chemical reaction design by which we successfully eliminated both the continuing growth and possible oxidation of the formed particles and hence fabricated uniform shape and narrow-size distribution Co nanoparticles of 5nm.

articleTitle: Effects of spike noise on read/write performance of double layered perpendicular media
abstract: In this paper, we analyzed the spike noise observed on media with FeTaC under layer generally have smaller amplitudes. Both amplitude and the amount of spike noise have been reduced by laminating the FeTaC underlayer.

articleTitle: Optimization of inductively coupled power transfer system with flat pickups
abstract: In this paper, the number and layout of required pickup elements to limit power fluctuation during driving is investigated and optimized.

articleTitle: Effect of surface roughness on plasma oxidation behavior of Al layer and tunneling magnetoresistance
abstract: In this paper, we evaluated the variation of magnetic properties and junction resistance R/sub j/. And the oxidation behavior was analyzed by a high resolution transmission microscopy (HR-TEM) study.

articleTitle: Electric-field dependent spin diffusion and spin injection into semiconductors
abstract: In this paper, the consequences of using a drift diffusion equation for spin polarization in the semiconductors that consistently takes into account electric field effects and electron statistics is described.

articleTitle: Carbon doped FePt perpendicular thin-film for ultra-high density magnetic recording media
abstract: In this paper, we present a simplification process, direct synthesis of c-axis oriented FePt:C by cosputtering both C and Fe with Pt chips, which provides properties that are suitable for ultra-high density magnetic recording media.

articleTitle: RF magneto-impedance effect of spin tunneling junctions
abstract: In this paper, RF magneto-impedance effect of spin tunneling junctions has been investigated.

articleTitle: Magnetic domain configuration in microstructured Fe/sub 3/O/sub 4/ film grown by molecular beam epitaxy
abstract: In this article, we present a study on the magnetic domain structures on Fe/sub 3/O/sub 4/ film. The Fe/sub 3/O/sub 4/ films were grown by molecular beam epitaxy. MFM is used to analyse the magnetic domain structure.

articleTitle: Photoacoustic spectroscopy: a promising technique to investigate magnetic fluids
abstract: In the present study, we investigate biocompatible magnetic fluids (BMFs) by photoacoustic spectroscopy and the investigation are based on magnetic nanoparticles surface-coated with citric acid and dispersed in physiological media (pH8 and 0.9 salinity).

articleTitle: Yield stress in a fluidized bed stabilized with a compound magnetic field
abstract: In this paper, we observed that the yield stress in a magnetically stabilized fluidized bed (MSFB) with a compound magnetic field.

articleTitle: Inductive write heads using high moment pole materials for ultrahigh areal density demonstrations
abstract: In this paper, the high moment materials and their applications in the write heads for these areal density demonstrations will be discussed. Due to high intrinsic magnetic anisotropy and magnetostriction, which is typically about 4.5x10/sup 5/, FeCoN films exhibit typical coercivity in excess of 50 Oe, and isotropic in-plane magnetic properties, under un-optimised process conditions. A typical hysteresis loop of the film is shown.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of cobalt nanoparticles by IBICVD
abstract: The focus of this study is to explore the size limitation and to study the morphology and the structure of cobalt particles by a novel technique.

articleTitle: Front return yoke type cusp field single-pole writing head
abstract: In this report, the new head structure and its writing performance are discussed based on fabricated real single-pole heads.

articleTitle: Switching dynamics of tilted media
abstract: In this paper, we employ a micromagnetic model to study of perpendicular and tilted media.

articleTitle: Imaging sub-ns spin dynamics with transmission X-ray microscopy
abstract: In this paper, we have studied spin dynamics by X-ray microscopy using the inherent pulsed time structure of 3/sup rd/ generation synchrotrons in a stroboscopic pump-probe experiment. The results obtained with patterned permalloy elements were consistent with micromagnetic simulations.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of helical motion permanent magnet motor with cylindrical Halbach array
abstract: In this paper, it deals with the application of two types of cylindrical Halbach array to permanent magnet motor. Halbach arrays have been used for permanent magnet arrays of planar linear, cylindrical rotary, and cylindrical linear motor, etc. In particular, their self-shielding property has been highlighted as a desirable feature for electrical machines and makes them eminently appropriate for use in linear and rotary machines.

articleTitle: Formation of magnetic cluster and remanence coercivity in granular-type perpendicular recording media
abstract: In this paper, magnetic cluster size D/sub cluster/ of perpendicular recording media was discussed relating to remanence coercivity by taking account of demagnetizing field magnetic cluster.

articleTitle: A novel point-dipole MFM tip obtained from an antiferromagnetically coupled synthetic coating
abstract: In this paper, we show experimentally that this type of a novel point-dipole MFM tip can have a superior resolution and a point dipole like magnetic response when the tip geometry is optimized.

articleTitle: Transition percolation and medium noise for perpendicular double layered media
abstract: In this paper, dependence of the noise upon linear density is discussed for various perpendicular magnetic recording.

articleTitle: Magnetically-soft higher-order harmonic stress and temperature sensors
abstract: In this paper explained the higher order harmonics of magnetically soft magnetoelastic ribbons with application to stress and temperature monitoring. The measured amplitude of the 2/sup nd/ harmonic as a function of temperature for two magnetoelastic ribbons, FeBSiC and FeNiMoB are compared.

articleTitle: High resolution MFM observation of recorded patterns of perpendicular magnetic recording media in ultra high density
abstract: In this paper we analyzed a recording resolution and noise of perpendicular magnetic recording media with various layer thickness by MFM measurement of recording pattern with various linear recording densities.

articleTitle: Sub-milli-Torr magnetron sputter deposition of magnetic thin films
abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the single films stress of various component layers in spin-valve or magnetic tunnel junction multilayers and the magnetic thickness loss due to interlayer atomic mixing in the magnetic thin films deposited by sub-milli-Torr magnetron sputtering with that from ion beam sputtering.

articleTitle: Microstructure and magnetic property of nanostructured NiZnCu ferrites powder synthesized by sol-gel process
abstract: In this paper we study the microstructures and magnetic properties of nanosized ferromagnetic NiZnCu ferrites powders prepared by sol-gel process at a low temperature with no annealing.

articleTitle: Kink-free design of submicron MRAM cell
abstract: In this work, full micromagnetic simulations with comparing experimental measurements have been performed for broad range of Ms (400/spl sim/1600 emu/cm/sup 3/), thickness of free layer (1/spl sim/5 nm) and aspect ratio of MRAM cell (1.5/spl sim/3). We used cell with round edge, since perfect rectangular or elliptical shape is hardly obtained from conventional lithography technology. For the round cell, edge radius was 80 nm and short width was 0.2 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Rejection of stimulus-related artifacts from electro-gustatory magnetoencephalographic signals using independent component analysis
abstract: In this article, we used electro-gustatory (EG) stimuli, in which weak anodal currents were applied to subjects' anterior torque tip, to ensure control of stimulus location and timing. We introduced independent component analysis (ICA) to separate stimulus-related artifacts from EG MEG signals.

articleTitle: Effect of Ge substitution on the magnetic properties of MnFe(P, As)
abstract: In this paper, we report on the effects of Ge substitution on the magnetic properties of MnFe(P,As). The temperature dependence of the magnetization is also measured.

articleTitle: Application of fast multipole method to micromagnetic simulation of periodic systems
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a new iterative method for calculating the fields of the periodic images, which is simpler and more in the spirit of the FMM.

articleTitle: Microwave properties of diluted composites made of magnetic wires with giant magneto impedance effect
abstract: In this paper, the theoretical description of wire media made of magnetic wires. We show that there is a close link between the Giant Magneto Impedence effect (GMI) in individual wires, and free-space microwave properties of the composite wire media. The demonstration with tunable dielectric constant under a static magnetic field.

articleTitle: Thickness dependence of rotatable anisotropy in exchange-biased NiFe/FeMn bilayers
abstract: In this paper, we improved the AMR model to determinate the quantity and direction of rotatable anisotropy in the FeMn/NiFe with a thickness of AF and FM layers.

articleTitle: Dependence of exchange bias on various annealing conditions in Mn-Ir-Pt based spin valves
abstract: In this paper, we have investigated the annealing conditions for a Mn-Ir-Pt based top and bottom conventional SVs and have evaluated the blocking temperature and the thermal stability of H/sub ex/ at the ramped temperature. The change of an interface was confirmed from a RBS study.

articleTitle: Injection and detection of spin-polarized currents at ferromagnet/semiconductor Schottky contacts
abstract: In this paper, we present a more complete picture of the Schottky barrier useful for both injection and detection. The transport properties of the interface are described using a spin-dependent interface resistance, resulting for example from an interfacial-tunneling region.

articleTitle: Ordering intermetallic alloys by ion irradiation: a new way to tailor magnetic media
abstract: In this paper, we describe ordering mechanism under irradiation by combining experiments and Kinetic Lattice Monte Carlo (KLMC) simulations on the FePt and FePd equiatomic systems. Both experiments and simulations confirm that our irradiation conditions (small energy transfer, low collision cross section, irradiation temperature under 550K) specifically affect DSRO.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of dynamic conductance a step beyond Julliere model for Magnetic Tunnel Junctions
abstract: In this paper, to evaluate the quality of MTJ temperature dependence of transport should be examined. For example, for 7.5 /spl Aring/ thick Al tunnel barrier, 37% of the total current is ohmic in nature and still junction can have MR=17% at room temperature.

articleTitle: Spin-resolved photoemission through an oxide barrier: the polarization of NiMnSb/MgO(001) and Fe/MgO(001) interfaces
abstract: In this paper, spin-resolved photoemission through an oxide barrier, the polarization of NiMnSb/MgO(001) and Fe/MgO(001) interfaces are studied.

articleTitle: Thermal dependence of magnetic properties in Fe-Co and Fe-Cr base nanocrystalline alloys
abstract: In this paper, the main aim is to analyze through the thermal dependence of basic magnetic parameters (i.e. coercivity, magnetic permeability,magnetocrystalline anisotropy) the basic magnetic characteristics of the magnetic interactions in Fe-Co and Fe-Cr nanocrystalline alloys.

articleTitle: Influence of gyromagnetic term and temperature on switching time of a single-domain particle
abstract: In this paper, we describe switching time of a single-domain particle with uniaxial anisotropy in an applied field at an oblique angle, a few degrees, to the easy axis were calculated by solving numerically Brown's Fokker-Planck equation, which describe thermal behavior of the particle.

articleTitle: Real-time current density imaging of electromigration processes using scanning magnetoresistive microscopy
abstract: Recently, we have successfully demonstrated the use of scanning magnetoresistance microscopy (SMRM) to directly image electrical current densities at sub-micron length scales. One promising application of this technique is the imaging of electro migration (EM) failure modes in current-carrying interconnects at elevated temperatures. We have designed and demonstrated a technique capable of real-time observation of current flow in passivated conductors undergoing EM processes at length scales <100 nm. In this presentation, we will explain the details of the technique and present results from relevant physical systems.

articleTitle: Study of Curie temperature of cobalt ferrite based composites for stress sensor applications
abstract: In this paper, we investigate whether this temperature can be decreased by composition changes that decrease the Curie temperature of the ferrite, thus enabling operation within the temperature range of reversible magnetomechanical response.

articleTitle: Single-pole writer instabilities dependent on the pole-tip geometry
abstract: In this paper, we describe our experimental demonstration that the single-pole writer instabilities dependent on the pole-tip geometry. The instability of these writers is strongly dependent upon the throat height, which is defined as the distance between the flared point of pole tip and the air-bearing surface.

articleTitle: Reduced-complexity turbo equalizer for high-density magnetic recording channels
abstract: In this paper, we propose a soft out put BAD(S-BAD) which takes advantage of the original structure. The new equalizer produces soft information interms of extrinsic information suitable for iterative decoding when used with outer codes such as turbo/ turbo-like codes.

articleTitle: Model and design of PCB winding parallel for planar transformer
abstract: In this article, the effect of different paralleling strategies, 1D field has been adopted, and a software has been developed to calculate the AC loss and leakage inductance. The problem and causes for unequal current sharing among parallel layers are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Servo detection based on coding and noise prediction
abstract: In this work, we present simulation results demonstrating the coding gains calculation and the performance can be further increased by incorporating noise prediction.

articleTitle: Low noise mechanism in exchange coupled perpendicular magnetic recording media
abstract: In this paper, we describe the medium noise in exchanged coupled perpendicular recording media using simulation technique.

articleTitle: Design of a compact hysteresis motor used in a gyroscope
abstract: In this paper, it presents the computer-aided design and test results of a compact hysteresis synchronous motor used as the drive motor of a gyroscope. Hysteresis motor is the best choice for this application because of its compactness and reliability. Also it has self-starting capability and it does not require any position sensor and communication circuits.

articleTitle: Exchange coupling optimization on CoPtCrO perpendicular media
abstract: In this paper, medium noise and exchange coupling correlation have been investigated by changing the oxygen ratio in the sputter gas. To determine the amount of intergranular exchange coupling in this media, the experimental results were modeled using numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Scanning tunneling spectroscopy of individual iron atoms in a Permalloy surface
abstract: In this paper, we study the scanning tunnelling spectroscopy of individual iron atoms in a permalloy surface and their related analysis.

articleTitle: Adjacent track erasure analysis and modeling at high track density
abstract: There is a pressing need to solve a number of major issues related to high TPI drive integration. One of the relevant issues is adjacent track encroachment. In this paper, we studied the side-erasure problem using isolated track without background information and DC erase on the adjacent tracks to minimize the effect of adjacent track interference.

articleTitle: Magnetomechanical damping capacity of Tb/sub x/Dy/sub 1-x/Fe/sub 1.92/ alloys (0.33<x<0.50)
abstract: In this paper explained about the damping capacity of the Tb-rich Terfenol-D alloys. Stress-strain hysteresis loops of these magnetoelastic alloys were discussed.

articleTitle: Structure and magnetic properties of Sm(Co/sub BAL/Fe/sub 1-X/Zr/sub 0.05/Cu/sub 0.08/Ga/sub Y/B/sub Z/)/sub 12/ alloys and their melt-spun material (X=0.1-0.4, Y=0-0.01, Z=0.01-0.02)
abstract: In this paper explained the new group of potential permanent magnetic materials with nominal composition of Sm(Co/sub BAL/Fe/sub 1-X/Zr/sub 0.05/Cu/sub 0.08/Ga/sub Y/B/sub Z/)/sub 12/ have been synthesized and characterized in this study. Structure, phase formation, and magnetic properties were presented. The effect of different magnetic element additions namely, Ga, B, and Fe, on the magnetic properties will also be discussed.

articleTitle: High resolution MFM: simulation of tip sharpening
abstract: In this paper, we calculate MFM signals for tips with various tip-end shapes and discuss the effect of tip sharpening of MFM sensitivity and resolution.

articleTitle: Mossbauer and magnetic aftereffect studies of exchange coupled PrFeB-type nanocomposites
abstract: In this paper, B-content and Pr-content effect on the magnetic properties, phase evolution and aftereffect of Pr/sub 10/Fe/sub 90-x/B/sub x/ (x = 11.5-5.88) and Pr/sub y/Fe/sub 90-y/B10 (y = 11.76-8) using the conventional melt spun ribbons were studied.

articleTitle: Separation of overlapping activity in first and second somatosensory evoked fields with 3-D MEG measurement
abstract: In this article, we conclude that singular value decomposition (SVD) analysis, having different frequency ranges, is useful for separating the secondary somatosensory activity from the primary somatosensory activity overlapping in time. We carried out 3D MEG measurement of somatosensory evoked field (SEF) with the electric stimulus to the right thumb.

articleTitle: Statistical distribution of the internal field in planar ferrites
abstract: In this paper, statistical distribution of the internal field in planar ferrites are discussed. The Landau-Lifshitz equation is solved iteratively by the Finite Difference Method to obtain the equilibrium internal field (and magnetization) distribution for the dc bias field, applied perpendicular to the plane of the ferrite. Calculations are performed for YIG (Y/sub 3/Fe/sub 5/O/sub 12/) as a model material.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of nanostructured TbMn/sub 6/Sn/sub 6/ melt spun ribbons
abstract: In this paper mainly deals with the nanostructured TbMn/sub 6/Sn/sub 6/ ribbons prepared by melt spinning method and investigates the influences of the cooling rate on the magnetic properties of nanostructured TbMn/sub 6/Sn/sub 6/ ribbons.

articleTitle: Empty square as a hard-layer for MRAM
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new design , which utilizes "empty squares" or narrow squares or narrow rings as the basic element for the fabrication of hard layer of MRAM. At remanence a stable bi-domain state called the "onion" state is observed. The onion state corresponds to each half of the square ring, on either side of the diagonal, having the same magnetization orientation and forming head-to-head and tail-to-tail domain walls.

articleTitle: Ferromagnetic resonance in granular soft magnetic films
abstract: In this paper, the investigation into the validity of the Snock limit in such random anisotropy composite materials requires knowledge of the local magnetization values. In plane Ferromagnetic Resonance was used to probe the local magnetization (M/sub s/) and in plane anisotropy profiles. The resonance fields were used to obtain the local values of M/sub s/ by employing the Kittel formula.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of NiFe/(IrMn/CoFe)/sub 3//IrMn multilayer thin films-a novel type of exchange-spring system
abstract: In this paper, magnetic properties of NiFe/(IrMn/CoFe)/sub 3//IrMn multilayer thin films, a novel type of exchange-spring system, have been investigated. The coupling between NiFe and IrMn at the interface is believed to be the exchange biased coupling.

articleTitle: Evaluation of magnetic interaction in [Co/Pd]/sub n/ multilayered thin film for perpendicular magnetic recording media under the tilted magnetic field
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method of evaluating magnetic interactions among magnetic particles simultaneously along the perpendicular and in-plane direction in such media.

articleTitle: Novel tin-added bulk amorphous Fe-based alloys
abstract: In this paper, we discuss tin added bulk Fe based amorphous magnetic alloys properties and preparation by the melt spinning method. It was characterized by XRD. Magnetic properties and its structure are discussed.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic modeling of discrete patterned perpendicular media
abstract: In this paper, the benefit to separate each track and the feasibility to increase track density are investigated by using Landau-Lifshits-Gilbert micromagnetic model. A MFM image of the discrete patterned media recorded at 50 kFCL is shown. In the recording process, the single pole write head with a width, Pw, of 200 nm and a thickness, Pt, of 300 nm is used.

articleTitle: Magnetotransport of semimetallic Bi thin films grown by electroplating and sputtering
abstract: In this paper, we present the magnetotransport properties of the electroplated and sputtered Bi thin film in the temperature range 4-300 K.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo simulation of film morphology of carbon overcoat
abstract: In this paper, we describe carbon film morphology under different deposition conditions using Monte Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Effect of evaporative deposition angle on anisotropy in Co-MgF2 nanocomposite soft magnetic materials
abstract: In this paper, we report strong anisotropy found in films deposited by co-evaporation of Co and MgF/sub 2/ with no magnetic field applied during deposition. M-H loop was measured in perpendicular direction of the sample, deposited without a magnetic field applied during deposition and TEM image of the sample also obtained.

articleTitle: Switching mechanism in ring-shaped pseudo-spin valves
abstract: In this paper, we look at magnetisation reversal as functions of the ratio of the inner to the outer diameter of the ring and the outer diameters when that ratio is constant.

articleTitle: Volume effect on magnetic transitions in Pr/sub 1-x/Sr/sub x/MnO/sub 3/ pervoskites
abstract: In this paper, the CMR effects in RE/sub 1-x/AE/sub x/MnO/sub 3/ based pervoskites which is attractive for potential applications, is defined by the interplay between lattice, electronic and magnetic subsystems. The CMR effects is pronounced in particular for the compounds where an antiferromagnetic insulating state transforms to a paramagnetic insulating state via an intermediate ferromagnetic metallic state, as it takes place in the Pr/sub 0.5/Sr/sub 0.5/MnO/sub 3/ perovskite.

articleTitle: Toward an understanding of overcoat corrosion protection
abstract: In this paper, we performed electrochemical studies on head-media corrosion protections and galvanic coupling between the overcoat and the metal layer.

articleTitle: Integrated servo/mechanical design of HDD actuators and estimation of the achievable bandwidth
abstract: In this paper, integrated servo/mechanical design of HDD actuators and estimation of the achievable bandwidth have been discussed.

articleTitle: Dynamic switching in magnetic recording
abstract: In this paper, we discuss consequences for a variety of recording configurations such as CP recording, TP recording, longitudinal recording in case of dynamic switching in magnetic recording.

articleTitle: Effect of grain size on domain structure of thin non-oriented Si-Fe electrical sheets
abstract: In this article, we explored the effect of grain size on the domain structure of thin non-oriented Si-Fe sheets with different grain size.

articleTitle: Comparison and design of servo controllers for dual-stage actuators in hard disk drives
abstract: In this paper, comparison and design of servo controllers for dual-stage actuators in hard disk drives were discussed. The SISO and SIMO controller configurations will be analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: Measurement and analysis of transition noise in perpendicular media
abstract: In this paper, the transition noise can be analyzed in terms of the transition parameter "a" and the cross-track correlation length "s" assuming a certain transition shape.

articleTitle: Determination of activation volumes in perpendicular media
abstract: In this paper, we show that a more simple strategy of determining the fluctuation field and hence the activation volume at a constant value of M can be used. The magnetic thin film having perpendicular anisotropy are being considered for application as perpendicular media.

articleTitle: Thermal proximity sensing for hard disks
abstract: In this paper, we have demonstrated a new technique to detect and image defects on a disk surface using product data heads.

articleTitle: Atom probe study of the microstructure of sintered Sm(Co/sub 0.72/Fe/sub 0.20/Cu/sub 0.055/Zr/sub 0.025/)/sub 7.5/ permanent magnet
abstract: In this paper reported 3DAP analysis of the Sm(CoFeCuZr) alloy, combined with TEM observations. The relationship between the magnetic properties and the microstructure were discussed.

articleTitle: Magnetic resonance study of zero-field-frozen magnetite-based biocompatible magnetic fluid
abstract: In this paper, a biocompatible MF sample was investigated using X-band MR. The resonance linewidth broadening (/spl Delta/H/sub R/) and the resonance field (H/sub R/) was investigated as a function of temperature (T), at different nonparticle concentration. The biocompatible MF sample used in this study is based on magnetic nanoparticle (9.4 nm is average diameter) coated with dextran. After precipitation in alkaline medium, magnetite nanoparticles were surface coated to produce stable biocompatible MF samples at physiological pH and salinity.

articleTitle: Nanostructured melt-spun Sm(Co-Fe-Zr-B)/sub 7.5/ alloys for high temperature magnets
abstract: In this paper, we report high coercivity in as spun and annealed ribbons of Cu free Sm(Co/sub bal/Fe/sub z/Zr/sub y/B/sub x/)/sub 7.5/ samples, with varying B, Zr and Fe content (x-0.005-0.06, y=0.02-0.16, z=0.08-0.3) were studied. Also TEM studies have been used to investigate microstructure and grain size distribution. Average grain size is 30-50 nm is as spun ribbons and 70 to 100 nm for annealed ribbons. The grain distribution is very uniform in the scale of nanometers for the samples with square loop. Very good loop squareness and a maximum energy product of (BH)/sub max/=10.7 MGOe has been obtained at RT for sample with composition Sm(Co/sub bal/Fe/sub 0.3/Zr/sub 0.02/B/sub 0.04/)/sub 7.5/ after annealing at 600/spl deg/C for 75 min.

articleTitle: A process integration of high performance 64 Kb MRAM
abstract: In this paper, magnetic and electrical properties of the MTJs have been investigated at each fabrication step of the full integration with carefully designed parameters of M-H and I-V properties and TMR properties of 64Kb MRAM with minimal process induced damages have been achieved.

articleTitle: The effect of transcranial magnetic stimulation on long-term potentiation in rat hippocampus
abstract: In this paper, investigated the safety aspects of TMS by focusing on long term potentiation (LTP) in the rat hippocampus. LTPs were observed in both the sham and stimulated groups and the results were compared.

articleTitle: Some quirks in precession dynamics-the antiLarmor response
abstract: In this paper, some quirks in precession dynamics-the antiLarmor response were investigated. The processing magnetic magnetic moment in an applied static field H is driven by a transverse circularly polarized anti-Larmor high frequency excitation field.

articleTitle: Local cooling rate dependence of magnetic properties in melt-spun Nd/sub 60/Fe/sub 30/Al/sub 10/ alloy
abstract: In this paper, in order to show the influence of the local cooling rate on the magnetic properties, the temperature dependence of the AC-susceptibility and hysteresis loops were measured on the annealed sample of Nd/sub 60/Fe/sub 30/Al/sub 10/ with different thickness (removing the surface). Additionally, /sup 57/Fe Mossbauer spectra were recorded.

articleTitle: Thermal stability dependence on states for multi-state MRAM
abstract: In this paper, the thermal stability dependence on the states for multistate magnetic random access memory (MRAM) was investigated.

articleTitle: Study on the magnetic properties of nano size ni particles synthesized by pulsed wire evaporation (pwe) method
abstract: Recently, the nano wald magnetic particles which have their potential application in magnetic storage device and sensor have been studies widely. and exciting resultx on ahnormal Behavior of magnelic properties of lerrumagnetic n ~ n osc aled parliclcs such as Ni. Tu-Co. Cu-Fc. have txrn reported.[ 1.21 The magnetization curves outwardly follow Langevin function for the superparainagnelic particles. In this work, we synthesi7r nmo size of Si hy pulsed wire evaporation (PWE) method, which is one of the promising method to obtain nanoscaled particle with homogeneous quality. and analyst the magnetic properties.

articleTitle: Internal magnetoimpedance of amorphous wires
abstract: In this paper, the internal impedance, that is, the impedance without consideration of any external induction or parasite capacity, provides clearly more valuable information about the physics inside the amorphous wire although for applications the total impedance is easier to measure.

articleTitle: Depth profile of transverse permeability spectrum in an annealed Co-based amorphous ribbon
abstract: In this article, we investigate the depth profile of transverse permeability spectra extracted from MI spectra in annealed ribbons under weak magnetic field in order to clarify the effect of crystalline layer on the magnetisation process.

articleTitle: Analysis of side writing asymmetry
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the side writing asymmetry of Helical Scan Silicon (HSS) heads and introduce a profiling method for studying the write process across the track width.

articleTitle: Crystallographic orientation control in L1/sub 0/ FePt films on CrRu underlayer
abstract: The intermetallic FePt alloy film with Ll/sub 0/ ordered structure (fct-phase) has gained considerable attention due to its potential for ultra-high density recording media. For the perpendicular recording application fct-FePt films with c axis normal to the film have been prepared by various methods. Though the growth of fct-FePt film with c axis parallel to the film plane was reported, complex MBE technology and MgO or ScTiO/sub 3/ single crystal substrate were required. In this work, fct-FePt films with both [200] and [001] preferred orientation on the CrRu[002]/glass was prepared by introducing some impurity such as air during the deposition and doping Ag in FePt films. Its mechanism was discussed.

articleTitle: Magnetic measurements in double pervoskite Ca/sub 2/FeMoO/sub 6/
abstract: In this paper, the systematic study of the FMR linewidth of Ca/sub 2/FeMoO/sub 6/ were investigated.

articleTitle: Development of the mixed nanolubricant system by the FDTS islands and PFPE mobile phase
abstract: In this paper, we have developed a mixed lubricant system which has strong bonded phase. Also we introduced a self-assembled monolayer (SAM) to HDI as a bonded lubricant phase.

articleTitle: Remarks about the Lorentzan function approximation in hysteresis modelling of not oriented grain steels
abstract: In this paper, Lorentzan function approximation in hysteresis modelling of not oriented grain steels was discussed.

articleTitle: Effects of element dimension and grain number on micromagnetic simulation for nanocrystalline Nd-Fe-B magnet
abstract: In this paper, we analyzed the effects of elements dimension and grain number of coercivity /spl mu//sub oi/H/sub c/ and remanence J/sub r//J/sub s/ calculated for single-phase nanocrystalline Nd/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B magnets by using micromagnetic finite element analysis. The dependence of /spl mu//sub oi/H/sub c/ and J/sub r//J/sub s/ on the grain size for Nd/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B was simulated and compared with the experimental data.

articleTitle: Structural characterization and magnetization reversal of 0.1 /spl mu/m scale antidot-type arrays patterned by Ga/sup +/ irradiation
abstract: In this article, we present conventional transmission electron microscopy (TEM), Lorentz TEM and micromagnetic simulation, the relation between the structural changes accompanying the irradiation process and the magnetisation reversal of magnetic films patterned with arrays of 0.1/spl mu/m scale square antidots. The arrays have been fabricated in Co thin film as well as NiFe thin film using a focused ion beam system.

articleTitle: Surface roughness and fluid bridge formation of ultrathin liquid films of perfluoropolyethers on solid surfaces-effect of polar interaction
abstract: In this article, ultrathin films are expanded in vacuum from bottom to top surface that corresponds to the situation under a negative pressure i.e not chemically detailed. Moreover, it is not possible to simulate a truly finite or semi-finite system.

articleTitle: Magnetic cores usable in GHz range made by compressing NiFe microspheres encapsulated with NiZn ferrite by wet process
abstract: In this paper, it presents a novel type of magnetic cores usable up to GHz frequencies. Soft magnetic metal microspheres were encapsulated by ferrite films by the wet process, which were compressed to form the composite magnetic cores.

articleTitle: Magnetic film thickness effects on the recording performance of perpendicular media
abstract: This paper systematically examines the effects caused by the magnetic thin film thickness on the recording performance, especially on SNR.

articleTitle: Humidity effect for the magnetic woody characteristics of powder type magnetic wood
abstract: In this paper, we focused on the relationship between humidity and magnetic characteristics of powder type magnetic wood. The magnetic powder ratio, wood powder density and magnetic binder density were all examined as parameters for AC permeability /spl mu//sub iac/. The experimental results demonstrated the humidity effect for magnetic characteristics of the powder type magnetic wood.

articleTitle: Thickness and oxidation dependence of magnetic properties of ultra-thin obliquely evaporated Co-CoO media
abstract: In this paper magnetic properties of thickness and oxidation dependence of Co-CoO media particularly targeted for the application to GMR heads are reported. Furthermore, the effect of SiO/sub 2/ underlayer was also investigated for the enhancement of magnetic properties.

articleTitle: Strong magnetic field gradients in layered structures
abstract: In this paper, we discusses novel structures that provide strong magnetic fields unhampered by either the field strength or the complexity of prior high field configurations.
