articleTitle: Experimental study of reader nonlinearity in perpendicular recording using pseudorandom sequences
abstract: In this study, we investigate the reader asymmetry and saturation effects as a function of linear density in perpendicular recording.

articleTitle: Hysteresis model and magnetization of a radially anisotropic magnet ring
abstract: In this paper, prediction from this model was compared with test results for the radially oriented magnet ring. The further improvements like consideration of recall portions of the hysteresis in the model were discussed.

articleTitle: Rare earth substitutions in M-type ferrites
abstract: In this paper, the effects of a partial substitution of Sr by either Sm or Nd but also by La in SrFe/sub 12/O/sub 19/ on the fundamental magnetic properties is investigated. Hysteresis loop measurements were performed using a pulsed field magnetometer. The anisotropy fields of the samples was measured using the SPD method.

articleTitle: Spatially resolved ultrafast precessional magnetic switching
abstract: In this paper, using time resolved Kerr microscopy, we present spatially resolved observations of precessional magnetic switching and precessional switching with coincident orthogonal pulses.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic simulation of pinning and depinning processes in permanent magnets
abstract: In this paper, we study the cellular structure of Sm(Co,Fe,Cu,Zr)/sub z/, magnets reduces the pinning field depending on the ratio between the cells and the intercellular phase linearly, depending on the cell size and the thickness of the intercellular phase using three-dimensional static and dynamic micromagnetic simulation and analytical models.

articleTitle: Soft X-ray diffraction: an element sensitive tool to characterize patterned arrays of nanomagnets
abstract: In this paper, we show that diffraction experiments, performed using elliptically polarized soft X-rays, can be used to characterize the structure as well as the magnetic behavior of these lithographically-defined arrays of nanomagnets.

articleTitle: Characterization of effective anisotropy angular dispersion in perpendicular media
abstract: In this paper, micromagnetic simulations have been performed to examine the effect of internal demagnetization field. The effective dispersion is then extracted from the measurements compared to simulation.

articleTitle: A magnetic imaging system for evaluation of material conditions using magnetoresistive devices
abstract: In this paper, we develop a new magnetic imaging system for non-destructive evaluation of structural and mechanical conditions of materials. This produces a multi-parameter contour plot of the spatial variations of variety of magnetic properties such as coercivity, remanence, permeability and Barkhausen effect signal. Also we have developed an integrated sensor probe capable of measuring both magnetic hysteresis and BE signals using magnetoresistive devices.

articleTitle: Development of permanent magnet systems for magnetic resonance imaging
abstract: In this paper, we present the development of 0.15-0.35 Tesla permanent magnet systems for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), which include main magnets and gradient coils. The main magnets are manufactured by using high-energy NdFeB magnet materials.

articleTitle: Superelastic response of Ni-Mn-Ga martensite in magnetic field and simple model
abstract: In this paper focused to a possibility of using magnetic shape memory Ni-Mn-Ga alloys cut along {100} faces as a magnetically controlled superelastic element and proposed a simple model of the phenomena. Stress-strain curves and magnetization curves are obtained.

articleTitle: Strain-induced resistance changes in CoFe/Cu GMR multilayers
abstract: In this paper discussed about the elastoresistance of CoFe/Cu GMR films. Samples were fabricated by multi-target DC magnetron sputtering system. Strain-induced resistance changes were explained.

articleTitle: A practical and theoretical study of the formation of CaCO/sub 3/ in the presence of a magnetic field
abstract: In this paper, we focus our study to follow systematically the influence of the magnetic field on the crystal form of calcium carbonate precipitated from low-concentration water solutions. By changing the strength of the field and the flow rate of the water through the system the calcite/aragonite/vaterite ratio varied. The crystal form and the particle size distribution of the precipitated calcium carbonate were determined by using X-ray analysis and HREM. The theoretical part of the work was to study the mechanism of the influence of magnetic field on the nucleation and further crystallisation of calcium carbonate. Starting from ab-initio calculations scaling can be explained easily on the basis of shape and energy position of the ground electronic states of calcite and aragonite.

articleTitle: In-situ Brillouin scattering investigation of spin-waves during the fcc to bcc transition of Fe/Cu(100) films
abstract: We present an in-situ study of both the structural and magnetic properties of epitaxial iron films grown by e-beam evaporation on a Cu(100) single crystal substrate, using low-energy electron diffraction and Brillouin light scattering (BLS).

articleTitle: The electric and dielectric properties of the ZnNi-ferrite plated NiFe microspheres synthesized from aqueous solution
abstract: The frequency behavior of impedance and dielectrics of the composites is studied, to explore the mechanism underlying high frequency transport properties essential for device applications.

articleTitle: Destruction force assessment of multipoles flat brushless DC machine for distributed power generation system
abstract: In this paper, valid quantized factors including destructive energy and destructive force are indirectly described by tangential flux simulation derived from finite element analysis. Through the investigation, a suitable machine design scheme related to the force assessment can be provided for the associated application on the distributed wind power generation system.

articleTitle: S/N improvement of signal transmission coil in transcutaneous magnetic telemetry system for artificial heart
abstract: In this article, we have studied magnetic telemetry system of power and signal transmission using electromagnetic coupling for implanted medical devices driven electromagnetically.

articleTitle: Consolidation and magnetic properties of nanostructured Ni/sub 75/Fe/sub 25/
abstract: In this paper, we synthesized Ni-Fe nanoparticles, consolidated them into different packing densities and studied the dependence of their magnetic properties on consolidation status.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic modeling of pseudo spin valve elements
abstract: In this paper, we discuss a magnetoresistance random access memory (MRAM) made of pseudo spin valve (PSV) devices. The dependence of these fields on the shape of PSV and the residual domain are studied. Micromagnetic modelling is used to investigate the effect of magnetostatic coupling and its properties are analyzed.

articleTitle: Determination of uncompensated magnetic moment in antiferromagnetic layer in spin valve system
abstract: In this paper, the value of the exchange bias oscillates with increasing of the metal thickness. This oscillatory exchange bias means there is an uncompensated magnetic moment in the AFM layer at the interfaces.

articleTitle: Current induced switching of magnetic tunnel junctions
abstract: In this paper, we fabricated and tested Co/Al/sub 2/O/sub 3//Co magnetic tunnel junctions embedded in coplanar strip transmission lines designed for high-frequency device measurements. The device bottom wiring was patterned using photolithography and Ar ion beam etching. Relative tunneling magnetoresistance of the magnetic tunnel junction fabricated from as-deposited thin film multilayer was measured as a function of external magnetic fields at 295 K.

articleTitle: Efficient spin injection in metal-insulator-semiconductor (MIS) light emitting diodes (invited)
abstract: In this paper, we review our results on the MIS (Metal- InsulatorSemiconductor) spin-source approach including some results on a NiMnSb/Schottky barrier spin-source.

articleTitle: Preparation of nanostructured L1/sub 0/ Fe-Pt based perpendicular recording media
abstract: In this paper, microstructures of Fe-Pt based perpendicular double-layered media and its recording properties are discussed.

articleTitle: Microfabrication of magnetic tunnel junctions using Al as bottom conduction electrode
abstract: In this paper, the MTJs with high magnetoresistance and low resistance were fabricated with the layer structures of Ta/Al (5 nm/20 nm)/Ni/sub 79/Fe/sub 21//Ir/sub 22/Mn/sub 78/(10 nm)/Co/sub 75/Fe/sub 25/(4 nm)/Al(0.8 nm)-oxide/Co/sub 75/Fe/sub 25/(4 nm)/Ni/sub 79/Fe/sub 21/(20 nm)/Ta(5 nm) by using lithography method and Al as conduction electrode.

articleTitle: Microstructure and magnetic properties of (Fe/sub 1-x/Co/sub x/)/sub 81/Nb/sub 7/B/sub 12/ (x=0, 0.25, 0.33, 0.5) nanocrystalline alloys
abstract: In this paper, the formation of a nanocrystalline structure and its influence on magnetic properties in series of (Fe/sub 1-x/Co/sub x/)/sub 81/Nb/sub 7/B/sub 12/ (x=0, 0.25, 0.33, 0.5) alloys is investigated using a variety of complimentary methods. The crystallisation behavior of the samples was investigated by differential scanning calorimetry. The changes in microstructure upon annealing were examined by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and the analysis of subsequent phase evolution was performed by X-ray diffraction. The soft magnetic behavior was investigated by quasi-static hysteresis loop measurements in temperature range from 300 K to 700 K.

articleTitle: Observation of ferromagnetic domain structures using scanning magnetoresistance microscope with a magnetoresistive cantilever
abstract: In this paper, we report on the fabrication process and characterization of the MR cantilever, and demonstrate that imaging domain structures of a various ferromagnetic materials using our SMRM.

articleTitle: Evidence of long-range dipolar interaction on CdFe/sub 2/O/sub 4/ magnetic fluids
abstract: In this paper, we study the effect of long-range dipolar interaction on the magnetic ordering of water-based cadmium ferrite fluids (MF).

articleTitle: Analytical and micromagnetic modeling for detection of a single magnetic microbead or nanobead by spin valve sensors
abstract: In this paper, we present an analytical analysis based on the Stoner-Wolhfarth model for the detection of a single magnetic microbead or nanobead by spin valve sensors. The analytical model is compared with micromagnetic simulations and experiments.

articleTitle: Flat top pole writer design
abstract: In this paper, the design and magnetic performance of a new writer design with flat top pole are discussed. In this study, flat top pole heads with throat height of 2.0 /spl mu/m and magnetic track width of 0.28/spl mu/m were made with conventional plating/milling process. Finite element modeling (FEM) was also used to calculate head field and field gradient at the media. Modeling data show that good writing performance can be achieved by optimising the head design and implementing high moment material.

articleTitle: Joint estimation of data and timing in the presence of inter-symbol interference
abstract: In this paper, joint estimation of data and timing in the presence of inter-symbol interference was analyzed. We describe a means of incorporating timing perturbation in to the hidden Markov model which describes the recording channel.

articleTitle: Modifying the nanostructure of Co[SiO2] samples by controlled annealing
abstract: In this article, on-line measurements of resistance were made on co-sputtered Co[SiO/sub 2/] /sub 0.65/ granular films during annealing. The aim was to control the thermal treatment parameters and map the microstructural changes in the sample, and the respective magnetotransport response.

articleTitle: Micro power supply using thin film magnetic core
abstract: In this paper, we will report the electronic characteristics of microinductors and evaluate the operating characteristics of a step-down dc/dc converter using thin film magnetic core.

articleTitle: A study on ECC for servo track identifiers
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method to characterize head instabilities and propose the use of Gray Hamming, Golay, and Reed Solomon(RS) codes to deal with Track ID errors in the servo sector during write and read operations.

articleTitle: Magnetostriction measurement using EXAFS
abstract: In this paper, we report the first measurements of magnetostrictive strain using X-ray absorption spectroscopy (EXAFS). When a magnetic field is applied to a magnetostrictive material, a strain is induced in the material indicating that the distance between atoms has changed. Therefore, an EXAFS spectrum will also change upon the application of a magnetic field, to reflect the change in atomic positions. If a magnetic field is applied to a sample in two orthogonal directions, the EXAFS signal will be modulated by the alternating stretching and compressing of the bonds in the direction of measurement. If the zero field signal is subtracted from the signals with the magnet in the two orthogonal directions and a characteristic eye pattern of anti-phase oscillations above the edge and no single below the edge occurs, then this indicates that a magnetostrictive change in bond lengths has been measured.

articleTitle: Optimum tooth-geometry for specific performance requirements of a hybrid stepper motor
abstract: In this paper, a detailed account of the results of 2-D and 3-D Finite Element (FE) analyses, conducted with different tooth-width/tooth-pitch ratios (t//spl lambda/) and also with various tooth/slot shapes such as rectangular, trapezoidal, triangular and circular, is presented.

articleTitle: Soft magnetic underlayer with multilayer structure for perpendicular magnetic recording media
abstract: In this study, multilayers with non-magnetic interlayers for the SUL were prepared in order to improve the soft magnetic properties and surface smoothness as well as reduce the media noise originated from the configuration.

articleTitle: Simultaneous magnetic force microscopy and magnetoresistance characterization of a magnetic tunnel junction with in-situ applied field
abstract: In this paper, both the magneto-electronic properties and the magnetic domain structure of a magnetic tunnel junction (MJT) have been characterized simultaneously.

articleTitle: Dependence of thermal decay on intergranular exchange stiffness of perpendicular magnetic recording media
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the dependence of magnetic properties on thermal fluctuation and the relationship between magnetic clusters size and thermal decay.

articleTitle: Magnetomechanical behavior of Co-ferrite composites for sensors and transducers
abstract: In this work described about the static and dynamic magnetic and magnetostrictive properties of polymer bonded Co-ferrite composites in order to optimize its behaviour as a stress sensor and fore transducer.

articleTitle: Experimental and modeling studies of the effects of shear stress on magnetization in nickel
abstract: In this paper, the responses of nickel to pure shear stresses were studied under various dc applied fields. A model description was developed as a generalization of the theory of magnetomechanical effect to shear stresses in order to aid interpretation of the experimental results.

articleTitle: The magnetic reversal study of permalloy micro domains
abstract: In this work we using e-beam lithography to define a sub micron magnetic cell with different shape one a metal line which can pass current through it, MFM was employed to observe the magnetization reversal at remanent state and the "writing" process. An array of nine cells were seated on the current line, and the uniformity and proximity of the field produced by current can also be studied.

articleTitle: High performance Ni-substituted Mn-Zn ferrites processed by soft chemical technique
abstract: In this paper, Ni/sub x/Mn/sub 0.4-x/Zn/sub 0.6/Fe/sub 2/O/sub 4/, with different compositions are synthesized by the citrate precursor method and their dc resistivity, dielectric relaxation intensity, complex initial permeability, Curie temperature, saturation magnetization and the B-H loop parameters have been studied. X-ray diffractions of all samples (calcined at 500/spl deg/C) show single-phase spinel structure.

articleTitle: Fabrication of NdFeB thick film magnets by high speed PLD method
abstract: In this paper, the targets with the compositions of Nd/sub x/Fe/sub 14/B (X=2.0-4.0) were prepared. Then, they were ablated with a pulse laser at the repetition rate of 30 Hz, and films were deposited on Ta substrates. The coercivity and remanence of the films were almost independent of the film thickness at approximately 1000 kA/m and 0.55 T within the thickness range of 10-80 /spl mu/m. Also the maximum energy product value of 77 kJ/m/sup 3/ as the best magnetic property was obtained by using the high speed PLD method.

articleTitle: Pulsed current switching of sub-micron MRAM cell
abstract: In this paper, we will report measurement and simulation of switching of sub-micron MRAM cells and also investigate the effect of temperature on the pulsed current switching of such devices. we will compare detailed micromagnetic simulation of MRAM switching using a stochastic Landau-Lifshitz equation.

articleTitle: Temperature control of SMA artificial anal sphincter
abstract: In this article we used artificial sphincter utilising shape memory alloy (SMA) which consists of Ni and Ti. The anal canal is placed in between two boards fabricated from SMA. Because the form of SMA changes towards temperature, the flexure of the SMA boards in response to being heated by flexible heaters stuck on these boards effects opening anal canal.

articleTitle: Unique angular dependence of the unusual first order transition temperature in Gd/sub 5/(Si/sub 0.5/Ge/sub 0.5/)/sub 4/
abstract: In this paper, we study the field dependence of the transition temperature (T/sub c/) leads to a transition temperature which changes as a function of angle of the magnetic field in Gd/sub 5/(Si/sub 0.5/Ge/sub 0.5/)/sub 4/.

articleTitle: Structural and magnetic properties of Rhombohedral Sm/sub 2/(Co,Fe,Cr)/sub 17/B/sub x/and Sm/sub 2/(Co,Fe,Mn)/sub 17/B/sub x/ compounds
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the structural and magnetic properties Sm/sub 2/Co/sub 17/ compounds with small boron addition and substitutions of Fe and Cr or Mn, in the form of arcmelted bulk samples, melt-spun ribbons and ball-milled powder samples.

articleTitle: Electrical resistivity and GHz permeability of (CoFeB)-(SiO/sub 1.9/) hetero-amorphous granular films
abstract: In this paper, we present experimental evidences about the very large critical thickness of our films that makes eddy current loss practically negligible in GHz range.

articleTitle: Exchange anisotropy in the PtMn/NiFe [110] quad-crystal films
abstract: In this paper, we report the exchange anisotropy of PtMn/NiFe bilayers grown on Mo [001] step surface at a relative higher deposition temperature (300 /spl deg/C).

articleTitle: Dependence of Co/Pd superlattice properties on Pd thickness
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the magnetized state of the Pd layer and the anisotropy in Co/Pd SL films with a practical bilayer period.

articleTitle: Bulk contribution to tunnel magnetoresistance in Co based magnetic tunnel junction
abstract: In this paper, we discuss about magnetic tunnel junction with Co electrode to show this bulk like contribution. Its tunneling properties length in ferromagnetic electrode is analyzed.

articleTitle: Patterned perpendicular and longitudinal media
abstract: In this paper, we present a study comparing the recording performance of perpendicular and longitudinal media. In particular the synchronization requirements of the two cases are compared. A model, which includes media properties, such as easy-axis orientation, switching field distribution (SFD), and head properties, such as head field gradient, is able to reproduce the observed result.

articleTitle: Improved thermal stability of ferromagnetic tunnel junctions with a CoFe/CoFeO/sub x//CoFe pinned layer
abstract: In this paper, we prepare spin-valve type MTJ with a CoFe/CoFeO/sub x//CoFe pinned layer and the thermal stability of the MTJs was investigated. It was found that MTJ with the pinned layer can bring marked enhancement of TMR effect for a moderate heat treatment up to 400 /spl deg/C.

articleTitle: A kinetic model of magnetic media corrosion
abstract: In this work, we examines the randomness of the deposition in terms of the probability of uncovered magnetic alloy surface sites, and compares model kinetic calculations of oxidation of the magnetic film as a function of carbon thickness to experimental data.

articleTitle: Annealing-induced properties of Al-N-M (M: Co, Fe) thin films
abstract: In this study, we focus on nanocrystalline granular films in which small metal particle of nanometer size are embedded in an insulator matrix. We present here annealing induced magnetic and electric properties for the films with different compositions. The structure and the microstructure of these films were examined by X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy. Magnetic and electrical properties were measured by a vibrating sample magnetometer and a four-probe method respectively.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of spontaneous magnetization using a continuous model
abstract: In this paper, we describe the temperature dependence of the spontaneous magnetisation and in particular, estimate the Curie temperature at which the ferromagnetic order is destroyed.

articleTitle: Neutron diffraction and Mossbauer studies of the La/sub 0.67/Ba/sub 0.33/Mn/sub 0.99//sup 57/Fe/sub 0.01/O/sub 3/
abstract: In this paper, we elucidate the role of the manganese ion in the colossal magnetoresistance(CMR) effects by replacing the manganese ion in the CMR material with a similar transition metal ion Fe. The similar ionic radii of Fe/sup 3+/ and Mn/sup 3+/ mean that lattice distortion effects of the substitution may be ignored, and the electronic structure can be studied. Polycrystalline samples of La/sub 0.67/Ba/sub 0.33/Mn/sub 0.99//sup 57/Fe/sub 0.01/O/sub 3/ have been prepared with the aim of investigating the influence of the presence of a metal, which favors an antiferromagnetic coupling in the Mn-O layer.

articleTitle: Morphological study of Saccharomyces cerevisiae cells treated with magnetic fluid
abstract: In this paper, we have investigated the interaction of Saccharomyces cerevisiae cells with perchloric acid stabilized, water-based magnetic fluid (MF).

articleTitle: Control of temperature response for a magnetoelastic sensor with magnetic field tuning
abstract: In this paper, temperature control response for a magnetoelastic sensor with magnetic field tuning were investigated. Frequency-temperature response of the magnetoelastic sensor, within the temperature range 20 /spl deg/- 60/spl deg/, can be controlled by varying the magnitude of the dc biasing field.

articleTitle: Evaluation of transition curvature in perpendicular magnetic recording
abstract: In this paper, we report a detailed experimental study on the effect of the transition curvature on the read-back signal and magnetic recording performance.

articleTitle: Performance of NPML system in helical scanning azimuth recording channel
abstract: In this paper, we reports that the application of an appropriate NPML (Noise-Predictive Maximum Likelihood) system to the read channel can effectively improve the error rate performance.

articleTitle: Spiral type transmission-line with a Mn-Zn ferrite core
abstract: In this article, we investigate the characteristics of spiral type transmission-line with a Mn-Zn ferrite core, a device was fabricated, and then an analysis was done on the basis of coupled distributed constant circuit. Spiral conductor line had an effect of mutual magnetic coupling between adjacent turns, hence its transmission property was very interesting.

articleTitle: A signal interpolated timing recovery system with frequency offset detector
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel method of cancelling the initial frequency offset based on the ITR scheme and the simulation results are analyzed.

articleTitle: An analytical model for the cross-track correlation length including finite grain size and inter-granular interactions
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the perpendicular recording system with finite-size grains an analytical model for the cross-track correlation length is presented including both the intergranular exchange and magnetostatic interaction.

articleTitle: Ultra thin amorphous Si seedlayer for Co-Cr-Ta perpendicular magnetic recording layer
abstract: In this paper, we propose an ultra thin amorphous Si layer as seedlayer for a Co-Cr-Ta recording layer and its properties are studied. It is characterized by AFM.

articleTitle: Analysis of spectra in reverse overwrite
abstract: When a new data pattern is written on top of the old information, the interferences induced by the old data pattern at /spl omega//sub 1/, could be present in the spectrum of the new data pattern. Usually an excellent overwrite (OVW) performance has to be guaranteed for two cases, namely, the case where a low linear density background pattern is overwritten by a high linear density data pattern, and the reverse case. Recently Philip Steiner has shown some interesting reverse overwrite (ROVW) phenomena on perpendicular recording scheme. Here, a general model is proposed for describing reverse overwrite spectra.

articleTitle: Magnetic domain structure in SmCo 2:17 permanent magnets
abstract: In this paper the authors explained the magnetic domain structure of Sm(CoCuFeZr) alloys. The magnetic hysteresis loops were measured by a vibrating sample magnetometer. To understand the magnetic hardening behaviour, the magnetic domain structure was investigated after magnetisingifizing with different fields. Here, domain structure was exposed by TEM.

articleTitle: Cadmium-ferrite-based magnetic fluid: birefringence and transmission electron microscopy investigation
abstract: In this paper, a new hydrocarbon based MF sample containing cadmium ferrite nanoparticles surface-coated with oleic acid is investigated using TEM and SMB. In contrast to all MF samples based on spinel ferrite nanoparticles this new MF sample is relatively transparent at particle concentration in the range of 10/sup 16/ to 10/sup 17/ particle/cm/sup 3/. Further, the saturation birefringence is one order of magnitude higher than any other MF sample ever reported. This two points are extremely interesting, making the cadmium ferrite based MF and exceptional candidate for applications in optical devices.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of SmCo/sub 7//Co and Sm(Co, Fe)/sub 7///spl alpha/-(Fe, Co) nanocomposite magnets prepared by magnetic anneal
abstract: In this paper the effect of applying a magnetic field during the crystallization process of mechanically milled SmCo/sub 9.5/ and Sm(Co/sub 0.88/Fe/sub 0.12/)/sub 9.5/ alloys on the nanostructure, exchange coupling, and magnetic properties has been studied. There was a noticeable improvement in the intrinsic coercivity /sub i/H/sub c/, the remanence B/sub r/, and the maximum magnetic energy product (BH)/sub max/ for SmCo/sub 9.5/ and Sm(Co/sub 0.88/Fe/sub 0.12/)/sub 9.5/ alloys annealed in a magnetic field of 10 kOe were obtained. Better rectangularity of demagnetization curves was also observed for SmCo/sub 9.5/ and Sm(Co/sub 0.88/Fe/sub 0.12/)/sub 9.5/ after the annealing treatment.

articleTitle: EEG responses evoked by transcranial magnetic stimulation to the cerebellum
abstract: In this paper focused an EEG measurement system enable us to eliminate the electromagnetic interaction emitted from TMS. The EEG activities 5 ms after TMS stimulation were successfully measured. Using this special amplifier, we investigated the intensity dependence of brain activation induced by TMS.

articleTitle: Generation of bright and dark envelope solitons from magnetostatic spin waves with attractive nonlinearity
abstract: In this paper, reports the first data on the generation of both bright and dark soliton trains in a medium with attractive nonlinearity. The success of the modified NLS equation model with nonlinear damping in matching the computed wave forms to the data indicates that, for cw excitation, the formation of nonlinear wave trains involves more than the competition between nonlinearity and dispersion. The match shows that nonlinear damping plays a crucial role in this process.

articleTitle: Atomic ordering and magnetic properties in the Nd/sub 50/Fe/sub 40/Al/sub 10/ melt-spun ribbons
abstract: In this paper, the effect of the structural disorder on the magnetic properties of Nd/sub 50/Fe/sub 40/Al/sub 10/ melt-spun ribbons with thicknesses varying between 20 and 120 /spl mu/m was investigated systematically in the temperature range 4-800 K. Possible mechanisms for the huge coercive field observed due to the presence of medium range ordered regions were discussed.

articleTitle: Increase of switching field from a word line by design optimization
abstract: In this work we introducing a soft magnetic keeper layer to a word line and optimizing the shape of the word line.

articleTitle: Magnetic behavior of electrodeposited CoP nanoparticle arrays
abstract: In this paper, we have investigated the behavior of particles made from amorphous magnetic materials, in which magnetocrystalline anisotropy is absent and the magnetic behavior is primarily determined by shape. The hysteresis loops and remanent states of the particles have been characterized using XRD, TEM, SEM, XPS, MFM, AGM and related to the behavior expected form a micromagnetic model.

articleTitle: Complex permeability (45 MHZ-3 GHZ) of 'Structured Flake-Polymer Composites'
abstract: In this paper, a micron thick sputtered film of a soft-magnetic alloy composition (FeCoSi) has been powdered into flake particles having well defined aspect ratio and dispersed in polymer with controlled orientations forming structured Flake-Polymer composites (SFPCs).

articleTitle: The effect of current annealing on giant magneto-impedance of Fe/sub 72/Al5Ga2P/sub 11/C6B4 amorphous ribbons
abstract: In this article, we present investigation of MI-effect as a function of the direct current Joule heating in Fe/sub 72/Al/sub 5/Ga/sub 2/P/sub 11/C/sub 6/B/sub 4/ amorphous ribbons.

articleTitle: Exchange bias in MnPd/Fe bilayers
abstract: In this paper, we present the MnPd/Fe exchange bias system. The growth as well as the magnetic properties of MnPd/Fe bilayers have been thoroughly investigated by means of X-ray diffraction (XRD), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and vibrating sample magnetometry (VSM). MnPd/Fe /MgO bilayers with high crystalline quality have been deposited at different temperatures on MgO [001] substrates using the ion-beam sputtering technique. Hysteresis loops from two different bilayers, one sample deposited at 600 /spl deg/C and the other deposited at 800 /spl deg/C.

articleTitle: FeRh/FePt antiferromagnet/ferromagnet exchange spring media for thermally assisted magnetic recording
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel media structure consisting of two exchange coupled films: a first layer consisting of a ferromagnetic high anisotropy alloy like, e.g., FePt, and a second layer consisting of FeRh.

articleTitle: Effects of Mg doping and sintering temperature on the magnetoresistance of sintered Fe/sub 3/O/sub 4/ ferrites
abstract: In this paper, we improve MR value of the sintered Fe/sub 3/O/sub 4/ ferrite at room temperature, and microstructure on its magnetoresistance at room temperatures were investigated.

articleTitle: Spreading characteristics of cyclotriphosphazine-terminated perfluoropolyether films on carbon surfaces
abstract: In this paper, we describe the spreading characteristics of novel cyclotriphosphazine-terminated PFPE lubricant films on carbon surfaces are investigated experimentally by scanning micro-ellipsometry.

articleTitle: Magnetization reversal under non-uniform magnetic fields
abstract: In this paper, we describe the effects of non-uniform field distribution on the magnetisation reversal process.

articleTitle: Landau energy functions and coefficients for patterned magnetic arrays
abstract: In this paper, we study the interactions in lattice of patterned permalloy elements by magnetic force microscopy . The switching in arrays of rhombic elements of varying spacing was studied in more detail in a transmission electron microscope in the Fresnel in the direction opposite to that of spontaneous magnetisation. The observed switching mechanism of each individual element was reproduced by micromagnetic simulations.

articleTitle: Fiber wobbling shear force measurement for nanotribology of molecular thin lubricant film
abstract: In this article, we developed a new method of measuring dynamic shear force at a high shear rate. We call this new method "fiber wobbling shear force measurement". Using this method we investigated the effect of confinement on the dynamic viscoelastic properties of perfluoropolyether (PFPE) lubricant film on a magnetic disk.

articleTitle: Stress controlled magnetic switching for GMR and TMR applications
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the use of stress and strain as dynamic parameter in the magnetisation process of magnetic materials. Through the anisotropy present in magnetic materials, stress contributes to the total energy in the material influencing the magnetisation vector.

articleTitle: Structural design of normalized slope of M-H loops and coercive force for perpendicular recording media
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the effect of aspect ratio of grains and inter-grain spacing on the M-H loops using micromagnetic simulation.

articleTitle: Nucleation, selective growth and magnetic induction in 3% Si-Fe strips
abstract: In this article, the 40 or 100/spl mu/m thick 3% Si-Fe strips with final cold rolling reduction of 30% that contain 90ppm sulphur were heated up to 1200/spl deg/C with various heating rates, prior to isothermal annealing at 1200/spl deg/C under a flowing hydrogen atmosphere. A prominent difference in final texture and magnetic induction was observed after final annealing, depending on heating rates and strip thickness.

articleTitle: Tb doped CoTaZr soft magnetic films for integrated inductors
abstract: In this paper, we developed a CoZrTa material with a ferromagnetic resonance frequency of 2 GHz. This was achieved by doping the films with 2 at % of Tb. Furthermore, the effect of patterning on the magnetic properties of the films was studied.

articleTitle: The role of SUL in readback and linear density limitations imposed
abstract: The role of SUL in readback is studied via a combined micromagnetics modeling and analytical investigation for obtaining a more complete understanding of the linear density limitation imposed.

articleTitle: Effect of surface resisitance of metal evaporated tape on discharging current
abstract: Summary form only given. The consumer VCR format “MICROMV” (MMV) using an MR head and metal evaporated iape wits developed in ZWI.

articleTitle: Experimental determination of demagnetization field in perpendicular media
abstract: In this paper, the demagnetization field is determined from a spin-stand technique. However, we have found that the theoretical models cannot be accurately applied to perpendicular media. Therefore a new analysis is introduced and the results are compared with analytical calculations. All experiments are performed on a Guzik spin-stand tester using a longitudinal head trimmed into a single-pole head and a multilayered medium with a soft underlayer.

articleTitle: Exact analytical expression for medium field from perpendicular medium
abstract: In this study, we obtain a simpler analytical expression for the perpendicular medium field without sacrificing accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of a preload device for PZT actuators using permanent magnets
abstract: In this paper, a preload device for PZT actuators using permanent magnets was designed. An analytical method was used to determine an optimal magnet geometry that produces required preloading force and stiffness characteristics. Then the analytical results were compared with numerical analysis using FEM. Finally experimental results were presented.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of a mini linear actuator for optical disk drive
abstract: In this paper, We suggest a VCM type mini linear actuator for optical disk derive. Here we propose the virtual path method that can be used to model the outer magnetic flux. The magnetic circuit of this actuator can be a closed circuit due to the virtual path model of the outer magnetic flux.

articleTitle: Exchange interactions and Curie temperature of Y-Co compounds
abstract: In this paper, we study the effect of concentration on the magnetic properties of R-T compounds as the changes in concentration produce change in the local environment, Such a study has been carried out for Y-Fe compounds where Y is a prototype R. We perform first principle calculation for Y-Co compounds to investigate how the magnetic properties of Co affected by the changes in its local environment.

articleTitle: Uptake of DMSA-coated magnetic nanoparticles by blood cells
abstract: In this paper, we investigated blood cells participation in the transfer of DMSA-coated MNPs from blood vessels to the lung parenchyma.

articleTitle: Reduction of FePt ordering temperature by Cu underlayer on Si
abstract: In this paper, we have investigated the diffusion effects of Cu and Si from underlayers and substrates, respectively, on the ordering temperature and magnetic properties of FePt films.

articleTitle: A novel low power VMRAM/MTJ design with robust magnetic switching
abstract: In this paper, we will present a new MRAM design, targeting ultra-low switching current and switching robustness.

articleTitle: Magnetic resonance imaging of fluid motion associated with electrodeposition processes
abstract: The visualization of spatial distribution of flow is important for the study of heat and mass transfer and other industrial applications. In the present study, magnetic resonance imaging of fluid motion associated with electrodeposition processes was proposed.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of nonlinear magnetostatic wave propagation by finite element method
abstract: In this paper, we have formulated and solved the nonlinear dispersion relation for magnetostatic surface wave modes propagating along a ferrite film with the help of FEM.

articleTitle: The effect of hydrogen on the thermal expansion and magnetostriction in rare-earth intermetallics with iron
abstract: In this paper, the effect of hydrogen on thermal expansion anomalies, magnetostriction and their anomalies in the vicinity of spin-reorientation phase transition in RFe/sub 11/Ti intermetallic (R = Sm,Y, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er and Lu) were investigated.

articleTitle: Submicron ferromagnetic logic AND/OR gates
abstract: In this paper, submicron ferromagnetic logic AND/OR gates were studied. Ferromagnetic structures suitable for AND/OR gates usage were demonstrated experimentally at room temperature. A metallic continuous Ni/sub 80/Fe/sub 20/ structure was described. SEM micrograph of AND/OR gates was showed.

articleTitle: Study of magnetic properties of nano Cu-Fe particles with hetero-structure
abstract: In this paper, the investigation of the structure and magnetism as a function of the synthesis and a mount of doping ratio of iron at immiscible Cu-Fe alloys, were performed.

articleTitle: Power-selective suppression of microwave pulses in nonlinear spin wave interferometer
abstract: The purpose of the present work is to experimentally investigate a possibility for power-selective suppression of microwave pulses in the NSWI. A typical transmission characteristic of the NSWI shape is presented. The NSWI consists of a spin wave phase shifter and a variable attenuator.

articleTitle: Effect of helicoidal magnetoelastic anisotropy in non-linear magnetoimpedance of Co/sub 80.89/Fe/sub 4.38/Si/sub 8.69/B/sub 1.52/Nb/sub 4.52/ fibers
abstract: In this paper, it is to employ the non-linear GMI analysis (in particular the V/sub 2f/ signal) as a research tool in the study of intrinsic magnetic anisotropies in a negative magnetostrictive amorphous Co/sub 80.89/Fe/sub 4.38/Si/sub 8.69/B/sub 1.52/Nb/sub 4.52/ fiber obtained by the so-called "melt-extraction technique". The fabrication technique, characterized by a radial solidification with respect to the contact line between the wheel and the melt, induces a particular internal stress distribution, which, in the case of negative magnetostriction fibers gives rise to the occurrence of an off center axial inner core with axially oriented magnetization.

articleTitle: Influence of high-current-density pulsing annealing on giant magneto-impedance effect in Fe/sub 73.5/Cu1Nb3Si/sub 13.5/B/sub 9/ ribbons
abstract: In this paper, we report giant magneto-impedance (GMI) effect in the Fe/sub 73.5/Cu/sub 1/Nb/sub 3/Si/sub 13.5/B/sub 9/ ribbons annealed by high-current-density pulsing annealing that different from above two methods. In addition, the contrast of brittleness between pulse annealing and conventional annealing has also been reported.

articleTitle: Use of room temperature bias sputtering to decrease intergranular coupling in magnetic media deposited on polymeric substrates
abstract: In this paper, the reduction of intergranular coupling in CoCrPt thin films on polymeric substrates through bias sputtering close to room temperature has been investigated.

articleTitle: Influence of tooth-geometry on the torque performance of a hybrid stepper motor
abstract: In this paper, a detailed account of the results of 2-D and 3-D Finite Element (FE) analyses, conducted with different tooth-width/tooth-pitch ratios (t//spl lambda/) and also with various tooth/slot shapes such as rectangular, trapezoidal, triangular and circular, is presented.

articleTitle: Source modeling of the P300 event related response using MEG and EEG measurements
abstract: In this paper focuses on the differences between the source localization of multiple dipoles estimated by EEG and MEG by means of visual and somatosensory stimuli. Source modeling of P300 responses is proposed using MEG and EEG source estimations.

articleTitle: Self-biased circulator/isolator at millimeter wavelength using magnetically oriented polycrystalline strontium M-type hexaferrite (SrFe/sub 12/O/sub 19/)
abstract: In this paper, we report on the performance of a planar self-biased circulator/isolator using M-type hexaferrite, which is a significant step toward practical MMIC ferrite circulator/isolator at millimeter wavelength.

articleTitle: Field rate dependence study of magnetic viscosity in standard permanent magnets
abstract: The time dependence of the polarization J(t) was measured by using both vibrating sample and extraction magnetometers with external field strength up to 4.8 and 12 MA/m, respectively.

articleTitle: Oriented longitudinal media on glass substrates
abstract: This paper reports on the recent breakthrough of achieving high orientation ratio (OR) on directly textured glass substrates. We present a unique medium design combining seedlayer, underlayer, and an antiferromagnetically coupled (AFC) magnetic layer structure. Such a structure gives rise to a high OR and leads to significant improvement of recording performance. This technology has enabled the extension of glass disk media to ultra-high density longitudinal recording.

articleTitle: Development and relaxation of creep-induced anisotropy in nano-crystalline Fe-Cu-Nb-Si-B ribbons
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the development and relaxation processes of the creep-induced anisotropy. The creep induced anisotropy of a ribbon was relaxed by exposing the ribbon at 723 or 843 K without stress in a N/sub 2/atmosphere. In order to investigate relationship between the crystallisation process and the development of anisotropy, the electric resistivity /spl rho/ and the anisotropy field H/sub A/ were measured as a function of the annealing time, t/sub a/.

articleTitle: Preliminary investigation for cylindrical magnetic storage system
abstract: In this paper, we fabricate cylindrical magnetic storage media with cylindrical substrate, sputtering equipment and read/write tester.

articleTitle: The effect of torsion and tensile stress on the circumferential permeability of CoFeBSi amorphous wires
abstract: In this paper, a domain model for the magnetoimpedance (MI) of ferromagnetic wires and complex inductance formalism are used to study both the effect of torsion and tensile stress on the low frequency MI response of CoFeBSi amorphous wires (60/spl mu/m of diameter). In particular, the calculated /spl mu//sub /spl phi// dependence on these kind of stresses is found to be very sensitive to the wire's anisotropy constant K/sub a/ variations, exhibiting reduced L/sub r/ for diminished K/sub a/ and increasing L/sub r/ for increasing K/sub a/ is shown.

articleTitle: Resonant and nonresonant phenomena in measurements of ferromagnetic resonance in Co/sub 66/Fe/sub 4/B/sub 12/Si/sub 13/Nb/sub 4/Cu/sub 1/ amorphous ribbons
abstract: Ferromagnetic resonance measurements were carried out on amorphous ribbons of composition Co/sub 66/Fe/sub 4/B/sub 12/Si/sub 13/Nb/sub 4/Cu/sub 1/ prepared by melt spinning. The field modulated power absorption (dP/dH) was measured as a function of DC magnetic field (H) on strips 2 mm long, in an Electron Paramagnetic Resonance (EPR) spectrometer at X band (9.4 GHz) and Q Band (35 GHz). All spectra were taken at room temperature, under DC magnetic fields up to 10 KG for band X and 20 KG for band Q.

articleTitle: Transverse susceptibility in high density recording media by using a torque method
abstract: The transverse susceptibility (TS) is a switching method for anisotropy field distribution in particulate media. In this paper proposed a DC method to measure the TS, which relies on torque measurements.

articleTitle: Magnetic anisotropy of HCP (FeCoNi)3Pt ordered alloy thin films
abstract: Describes a detailed result of the perpendicular magnetic anisotropy as the function of composition and lattice constant for the alloy systems (FeCoNi)/sub 3/Pt.

articleTitle: Testing damping formalisms with microwave permeability
abstract: In this paper, we report experimental evidence that this form of the dissipation requires additional damping mechanisms in order to explain well-known phenomena, based upon the observed difference between the peak /spl omega//sub p/ and zero-crossing /spl omega//sub 0/ frequencies of magnetic permeability data.

articleTitle: Topographic and magnetic structure of undulated permalloy films measured in UHV
abstract: In this article, we characterized the films by magnetic force microscopy (MFM), contact potential microscopy (CPM) as well as STM within the same UHV system.

articleTitle: Study of head-disk interference at low flying height
abstract: In this paper, the head degradation, which includes both lube pickup and head carbon overcoat wear, was studied as the flying height approaches zero.

articleTitle: Enhancement of signal to noise ratio by underlayer control in CoCr-based perpendicular magnetic recording media
abstract: In this paper, enhancement of signal to noise ratio by underlayer control in CoCr-based perpendicular magnetic recording media was discussed. Underlayer control for SNR, thermal stability, magnetic hysteresis, structure of the media also investigated.

articleTitle: Dynamic approximation of rectangular loops and aftereffect
abstract: In this paper, a new approach to model aftereffect phenomenon and employs a dynamic approximation of the rectangular hysteresis loop is presented.

articleTitle: Application of ECT technique for inspection of bare PCB
abstract: In this paper, we describe the probe structure and characteristics to apply the ECT approach to high-density PCB with narrow trace width.

articleTitle: Direct observation of magnetostatic coupling of permalloy chain arrays
abstract: In this paper, individual permalloy disk array and disk chain arrays, prepared by standard electron beam lithography and liftoff techniques, were studied by a custom built vacuum MFM.

articleTitle: Sensitivity analysis of simulations for magnetic particle inspection using finite element method
abstract: In this article, we report a sensitivity analysis of numerical simulations of MPI for defects with various sizes using the finite element analysis (FEM).

articleTitle: Magnet arrays for use in a 3-D MEMS mirror array for optical switching
abstract: In this paper, we present magnet array development as part of 3D electromagnetic MEMS mirror arrays for use in optical switching applications. An electromagnetic mirror array uses an external array of magnets positioned under the array of mirrors to provide a strong magnetic field at the mirrors. Each mirror contains multiple coils which interact with the external magnetic fields to produce two orthogonal torques.

articleTitle: Magnetic thin film modulator by magnetoresistance effect film
abstract: This paper reports on the principle of the device modulation function and the results of computer simulation of the modulation function. Those are the frequency characteristic of modulation, the size characteristic and the characteristic of new shape device.

articleTitle: Development of integral equation solution for 3D eddy current distribution in a conducting slab
abstract: Eddy current analysis finds wide application in electrical machinery and devices, in power system analysis, non destructive testing, continuous casting, ship board applications and others. Finite Element methods such as T-Omega, A-phi and A-V methods do provide solutions of acceptable accuracy for small problems where the element size is comparable to skin-depth. Even for this, a large number of elements are required to model the entire space of the conducting medium and the surrounding air region. Integral equations require modeling of only the conducting parts and therefore offer an alternative approach to the problem. This paper presents an integral equation analysis and its application to a conducting slab with and without a crack excited by a transmission line source, to a slab excited by a dipole source, to phase segregated bus bars and others.

articleTitle: Development of improved powder for bonded permanent magnets
abstract: In this paper, innovative permanent magnet alloy design and processing technology are being developed for production of improvement permanent magnet alloy powders for bonded PM magnets with tolerance for temperatures up to 200/spl deg/C. The magnetic properties were investigated for melt spun ribbon and gas atomized powder of the same magnet alloy.

articleTitle: A magnetic associative memory based on diagonal storage
abstract: In this report, a magnetic associated memory based on diagonal storage, which is of great flexibility in use since it is a mixture of RAM and magnetic core based content addressable memory.

articleTitle: Finite-temperature anisotropy of PtCo magnets
abstract: In this paper, the atomic composition distinguishes L1/sub o/ magnets from 3d-based permanent magnets, such as alnico and barium ferrite, and from rare-earth transition-metal intermetallics, where the 4f and 3d elements realize specific tasks. The zero-temperature properties of L1/sub o/-type layered structures are reasonably well understood.

articleTitle: Preparation of nanometric Cu/sub x/Fe/sub 1-x/OFe/sub 2/O/sub 3/ and design of a magnetic field system for treatment of tumor
abstract: The water-based magnetic fluids with nanometric Cu/sub x/Fe/sub 1-x/OFe/sub 2/O/sub 3/ particles were prepared by the two-step method, in which the x value varied 0.1 to 0.4. The magnetization decreased with increasing x values. Also, an external magnetic field system was designed for drug delivery, with which the spatial magnetic flux distribution was analyzed.

articleTitle: Magnetic domain walls in exchange-coupled DyFe/sub 2//YFe/sub 2/ superlattices
abstract: In this paper we study the reduction of the hard material thickness (DyFe/sub 2/) should modify the classic magnetization reversal process, where the exchange springs should develop in the soft part before the irreversible switch of the hard one. Various samples with DyFe/sub 2/ thicknesses ranging between 100 /spl Aring/ and 30 /spl Aring/ have been analyzed.

articleTitle: Relaxation studies at high temperatures of precipitation hardened Sm(Co/sub bal/Fe/sub 0.1/Cu/sub 0.12/Zr/sub 0.04/)/sub 7.5/ magnet
abstract: Permanent magnets for high temperature applications are based on Sm(Co,Fe,Cu,Zr) alloys. In this paper explained the relaxation of magnetization as a function of temperature, using magnetic relaxation measurements on precipitation hardened magnet.

articleTitle: Mo/spl uml/ssbauer studies and magnetic properties of BaFe/sub 12-x/Al/sub x/O/sub 19/ grown by a wet chemical process
abstract: In this paper, Al substituted barium ferrite nanoparticles have been prepared by a wet chemical process and investigated by X-ray diffraction (XRD), vibrating sample magnetometer (VSM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and Mo/spl uml/ssbauer spectroscopy. The site occupancies, as determined Mo/spl uml/ssbauer spectra, have been used to interpret the changes in the magnetisation and in the coercivity.

articleTitle: High density recording media with CrMoB underlayer
abstract: In this paper, we reports the media characteristics with CrMoB UL and the performance improvements compared with CrMo UL. Media with CrMoB UL has about 300 Oe lower remanent coercivity (H/sub er/) and about 0.4 dB higher isolated signal-to-noise ratio (S/sub o//N/sub m/). It can be concluded that CrMoB has better performance than CrMo as media UL.

articleTitle: Design and preparation of new Fe-based bulk amorphous alloys torroids for applications
abstract: In this paper, we present results on the preparation and magnetic characterization over a wide frequency range of (Fe,Co,Ni)/sub 90-x/M/sub 10/B/sub x/ (x = 5-30 at%) (M= Zr, Ti) bulk amorphous alloys. The materials were prepared by Cu mould casting method. Ac magnetic permeability (/spl mu//sub e/), electrical resistivity (/spl rho//sub RT/), as well as the temperature dependence of saturation induction (B/sub s/) and coercive field (H/sub c/) were determined by using an AC fluxmetric method in fields no larger than 1000A/m.

articleTitle: Synchronization free dibit response extraction from PRBS waveforms
abstract: In this paper, we describe two different dipulse techniques both based on PRBS read-back wave forms. The first method, which requires computation in the discrete time Fourier transform domain, uses two different PRBS sequences with certain properties to obtain the phase and magnitude information. The second method is time domain correlation base and it requires the PRBS sequences the corresponding the readback waveform.

articleTitle: Relaxation processes in the lower layer of antiferromagnetically coupled media
abstract: In this paper we study the antiferromagnetically coupled recording media with different LL thicknesses, AF coupling, and LL intergranular exchange were investigated. The spinstand measurements are complemented by magnetometry measurements.

articleTitle: TEM characterization for magnetic nano structure processing
abstract: In this article, we discuss practical factors in the application of TEM as part of development of processing of magnetic nanostructures.

articleTitle: Enhancement of grain insolation by interdiffusion in AFC media with CrMo spacer layer
abstract: In this paper, studied that the media noise of the antiferromagnetic coupling (AFC) media with a CrMo spacer layer may be improved by a reduction in the magnetic cluster size, due to the decrease of the intergranular exchange coupling between magnetic grains. Magnetic force microscopy (MFM) images were compared for two different spacer layer Ru spacer and CrMo spacer layer.

articleTitle: Two Curie temperatures in a single iron thin film
abstract: In this paper, the Curie temperature was assumed to only depend on the quantity of deposited material. We have shown that in the particular case of thin Fe films grown on Ir(001) by MBE, two magnetic transitions are observed in a thin Fe film with a fractional number of deposited monolayers (ml). The Curie temperatures (T/sub c/) were determined by both Mossbauer spectroscopy and ac susceptometry.

articleTitle: Limits of the Preisach model for strongly correlated particulate magnetic media
abstract: In this paper, we describe the interactions in magnetic recording media due to media noise. Preisach type models usually consider the particulate magnetic media as a statical assemble of particles described by a coercive force and an interaction field distribution that shifts during the magnetisation process with an amount proportional to the magnetic moment of the sample.

articleTitle: Influence of stress and microstructure on the domain distribution in sputtered high moment Fe/sub 50/Co/sub 50/ films
abstract: In this paper, we report on the film texture, microstructure and stress on the magnetic domain structure in Fe/sub 50/Co/sub 50/ films.

articleTitle: Air-bearing design based on global approximation concepts
abstract: In this paper, air-bearing design based on global approximation concepts are described.

articleTitle: Ultra-thin intermediate template layer for perpendicular recording media
abstract: In this study, we investigated an ultra-thin intermediate template layer for use in low noise perpendicular recording media.

articleTitle: Ferroresonance circuit analysis exhibiting chaotic phenomenon by Chua-type magnetization model
abstract: In the present paper, the nonlinear calculation with Chua-type magnetization model carries out a ferroresonance circuit analysis. To clarify the ferroresonance system, the characteristic values based on the state variable representation are calculated in each of iteration steps. It is reveals that they have no hysteretic properties even though exhibiting chaotic behaviors.

articleTitle: Dynamic susceptibility investigation of magnetite nanoparticles in polymeric template
abstract: In this paper, we reports on magnetic investigation of magnetite-based composites using dynamical susceptibility(F/sub p/). The template used in the preparation of the composite samples was the mesoporous styrene-divinylbenzene copolymer.

articleTitle: The coercivity in Co-Zr system alloys
abstract: In this paper, Co-Zr melt-spun ribbons were prepared and characterized by X-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscope (SEM), and vibrating sample magnetometer (VSM). The Co-Zr ribbons showed a coercivity of 120 kA/m. This suggests that the hard magnetic phase in the Co-Zr alloys is not the Co/sub 11/Zr/sub 2/ phase but the Co/sub 5/Zr phase and the coercivity of the melt-spun ribbon increased and then decreased as the annealing temperature increases.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of FePt circular dots
abstract: In this paper, we present results of an investigation of zero field domain structures and magnetization reversal process of 2D arrays of submicron size circular elements made of a FePt film.

articleTitle: Measured electrical performance of V-groove inductors for microprocessor power delivery
abstract: In this paper, we measured electrical performance of V-groove inductors for microprocessor power delivery.

articleTitle: Essential of the moving coordinate method: a covert upwind method
abstract: In this article, we found that essential of the moving co-ordinate method is a covert upwind scheme. The advantage is that the method is more straight forward. However, the introduction of the time interval often causes additional troubles.

articleTitle: Laser-annealing effect on magnetization processes in Co-based amorphous microwires
abstract: In this paper we obtain a circumferential permeability spectra extracted from the magnetoimpedance spectra of Co-based amorphous microwire annealing by illuminating with a pulsed Nd;YAG laser, where a laser annealing has an advantage of short time over annealing on the magnetization processes is investigated by measuring the circumferential permeability spectra.

articleTitle: Analytical calculations of winding capacitances in transformers
abstract: In this paper, analytical calculations of winding capacitances in transformers was analyzed. Winding sections and equivalent circuit of the transformer were presented.

articleTitle: Combined MLS and RSM approach for HDD spindle motor robust design
abstract: In this paper, we describe combined MLS and RSM approach for HDD spindle motor robust design by using digital simulation technique.

articleTitle: Helical magnetic structures in epitaxial [110] Eu films
abstract: In this paper, we investigate how the symmetry breaking, the lattice clamping and eventually the epitaxial strains in a thin film may affects the magnetic arrangement.

articleTitle: TMA study of phase evolution in Nd-Fe-B material during mechanical milling and annealing
abstract: In this paper, phase evolution of the matrix Nd/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B magnetic phase in the Nd-Fe-B material during MM and annealing was investigated using TMA.

articleTitle: A permanent magnet based device for active magnetic regenerative refrigeration
abstract: In this paper, a permanent magnet based device for active magnetic regenerative refrigeration was described. Magnetic regenerative refrigeration is based on giant magnetocaloric effect. The active block of the refrigeration is a cylinder made of stacked gadolinium sheets and equipped with thermocouples.

articleTitle: Granular thin films with high RF permeability
abstract: In this article, we have studied high permeability films with the granular structure for use in the magnetic recording technologies. Also we discuss the advantages, drawbacks and some new development of the granular films.

articleTitle: Magnetic domain wall dynamics in a Permalloy planar nanowire
abstract: In this paper room temperature measurements of the propagation velocity of a domain wall in a Ni/sub 80/Fe/sub 20/ planar magnetic wire only 200 nm wide and 5 nm thick are reported.

articleTitle: Imaging, manipulation, and spectroscopic measurements of nanomagnets by magnetic force microscopy
abstract: In this paper, we study the various patterned arrays: permalloy rings, disks, empty squares, and pseudo spin valve (PSV) structures.

articleTitle: Geometric and electric optimization design of SR motor based on progressive quadratic response surface method
abstract: This paper presents an optimum design technique, which is able to determine optimal geometric and electric variables of switched reluctance motor (SRM).

articleTitle: Dynamical response on magnetic soft underlayers
abstract: In this paper, we have made the first direct dynamical measurements of both exchange coupled and non-exchange coupled magnetic soft underlayer (SUL) materials suitable for perpendicular recording. We have found that damping increased by a factor of 2 to 3 for the exchange coupled sample compared to the non-exchange coupled samples. The exchange coupled sample consisted were composed of 50 nm of FeCo with three different 2.5 nm thick seedlayers:Cu, NiFe, and Ru.

articleTitle: Optical and magnetic studies in Ni-Ti alloy thin films
abstract: In this paper, the optical and magnetic properties of Ni/sub 1-x/Ti/sub x/ alloy thin films with x=0.08,0.45,0.79 and 1.0 have been investigated. The thickness of the films was detected by a crystal thickness monitor. The optical transmittance and reflectance were measured by means of a spectrophotometer. The magnetic properties of the films was measured by a magneto-optical Kerr effect instrument.

articleTitle: Effects of Mn and Zr doped double underlayers on magnetic properties of CoCrPtB longitudinal media
abstract: In this paper, we used CrMoMn and CrMoZr double underlayer for CoCrPtB longitudinal media to manipulate the grain size and crystallographic texture. The dependence of magnetic properties, intergranular coupling and microstructure on the underlayer doping are discussed.

articleTitle: Magnetic lithography using flexible magnetic masks: applications to servowriting
abstract: In this paper, magnetic lithography using flexible magnetic masks and its application to servowriting were investigated. The mask consists of a flexible 127 /spl mu/m thick polyethylene teraphtalate (PET) plastic film patterned with 160-250 nm thick soft magnetic material (FeNiCo, FeCo) and the SEM and MFM images were also obtained in this experiment.

articleTitle: Relationship between layer thicknesses and recording properties in AFC media
abstract: In this paper, we show in this study that it is possible to vary PW/sub 50/ by up to 20% to values below 90 nm and have a thermally stable media that produce an SNR gain of /spl sim/3dB at 700 KFCI.

articleTitle: Processing of magnetic properties of nearly-zero magnetostrictive glass coated microwires by current annealing
abstract: In this paper, we have studied the influence of heat treatment performed by current annealing technique on the low field magnetic properties of nearly non-magnetostrictive glass coated amorphous Co/sub 55.7/Fe/sub 5.9/Ni/sub 9.9/B/sub 17.7/Si/sub 10.8/ and Co/sub 68.5/Mn/sub 6.5/Si/sub 10/B/sub 15/ microwires.

articleTitle: A silicon microactuator using integrated microfabrication technology
abstract: In this paper, a silicon electrostatic microactuator is developed using the proposed MEMS technologies with integrated head element fabrication processing in disk drive industry.

articleTitle: Effect of Ru interlayer on the crystallographic texture of AFC media
abstract: In this paper explained about the effect of the Ru interlayer on the quality of the crystallographic texture of the top magnetic layer in a series of AFC by comparing them to conventional single layer disks.

articleTitle: Spin-current magnetization switching in CPP GMR spin valves
abstract: In this paper, we report on transport measurements in current-perpendicular-to-plane (CCP) giant magnetoresistance (GMR) spin valves. Devices as small as 50 nm /spl times/ 100 nm were fabricated across 6" wafers. Spin-transfer switching was observed as well as the first measurement of the dependence of the switching current on the angle between the spin valve magnetizations.

articleTitle: Optimal (map) soft-output detector for channels with intersymbol interference and timing recovery errors
abstract: We address the issue of detecting transmitted symbols when there is a timing error in the sampled waveform, along with intersymbol interference (ISI) and additive channel noise. We built a special trellis to jointly characterize the timing uncertainty and the channel. The method derived here provides the joint maximum a posteriori probability detection for each input symbol and the quantized phase offset of each sample. It also generates 'soft' decisions, which are essential for soft-decision iterative decoding algorithms.

articleTitle: Study of Co-C system for magnetic nano-patterning via e-beam radiation induced nanoscale magnetic phase change
abstract: In this auricle, we studied systematically the microstructure and magnetic properties of Co-C system as function of C concentration and annealing temperatures, and finally the magnetic nano-dots array was produced based on the optimised Co-C thin films.

articleTitle: Precise calibration of the sub-10nm flying height of slider by using bump response method
abstract: In this paper, two kinds of commercial available glide sliders (two rails) are employed to conduct bump avalanche tests to further understand the complicated dynamic behavior of slider-bump interaction so as to provide basis for the metrology of head FH calibration by using bump with known height.

articleTitle: Fe-Co-B/Ni-Fe soft magnetic underlayer with high saturation magnetization for perpendicular magnetic recording media
abstract: In this study, we introduce Fe-Co-B/Ni-Fe double layer with high saturation magnetization, low coercivity, high anisotropy field and high resonance frequency for soft magnetic underlayer in perpendicular magnetic recording media.

articleTitle: Modeling stability of trapped ferromagnetic nanoparticle chains
abstract: This work deals with the stability of chains of single domain ferromagnetic particles (FP) inside pores that can be partially filled with material assumed to be a permanent magnet. The main motivation of this work is to understand the possibility of controlling self-assembly of ferromagnetic nanoparticles into nanopores by controlling external uniform magnetic field.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of a mixture of two nanosized Co-S powders produced by hydrothermal reduction
abstract: In this paper, we report the synthesis and morphology of mixture of nanosized of CoS and Co/sub 9/S/sub 8/, and discuss their ferromagnetic and superparamagnetic behavior with a blocking temperature of about 10 K.

articleTitle: The CSS performance for lightly textured disks
abstract: In this paper, the CSS performance for lightly textured disks with various topographical parameter was investigated. Four kinds of topography were textured on the disks with different texturing parameters on which high frequency surfaces were created.

articleTitle: Development of a DC brush motor with 50% weight reduction using magfine
abstract: The paper studies the development of 50% lighter MAGFINE motors compared to conventional sintered ferrite motors. The B-H curve and magnetic properties of MAGFINE compared with sintered ferrite are also investigated.

articleTitle: SP-SEM observation of circular permalloy disks
abstract: In this paper, we have observed magnetic vortex states in the permalloy thin film disks which diameter ranged from 2 /spl mu/m up to 25 /spl mu/m using spin-polarized scanning electron microscopy (SP-SEM or called Spin-SEM).

articleTitle: Magnetic means for the determination of torsional yield strength
abstract: In this paper, the yield strength of steels and other materials is typically limited to values determined from uniaxial tension tests. The torsional yield strength, required for the rational design of shafts is generally assumed to be 0.5-0.6 of the tensile value, based on one or another of the several theories of plasticity.

articleTitle: Development of thermomagnetic engine for exhaust heat recovery
abstract: In this report, the high output power thermomagnetic engine can be de designed. In order to decrease the eddy current braking loss, the disc type rotor is designed as piling up discs with 400 mm in diameter. 0.5 mm in thickness and 40 mm in width. The disc consists of the temperature sensitive magnetic material Fe-Ni (31.5 %) alloy which has the maximum value of temperature gradient of magnetic flux density in comparison with other Ni contents. The power per disc is found to be 1.48 W at the rotation speed of 0.4 rps in the optimized engine.

articleTitle: Prediction of the electromechanical faults in a single phase squirrel cage induction motor
abstract: In this paper, we characterizes how broken rotor bars and rotor eccentricity affect the electromechanical parameters such as input current, magnetic force and vibration of a rotor in order to effectively diagnose the faults of a single phase squirrel cage induction motor.

articleTitle: Effect of drive modes on the acoustic noise of FDB spindle motor
abstract: In this paper, we compare the results of the acoustic noise produced in FDB spindle motors driven by different modes, and present a mode that can reduce the acoustic noise of the FDB motor significantly.

articleTitle: Analysis and test of a electromagnetic linear position sensor
abstract: In this paper, we describe a new magnetic linear position sensor. It relies on change of magnetic flux distribution due to the linear displacement of an AC electromagnetic coil. The correlation between the measured induced voltage on the search coils and the linear displacement of the latter is found and analyzed.

articleTitle: Magnetic monitoring of the nitriding process in SmFeTa-based alloys
abstract: In this paper, magnetic monitoring of the nitriding process in SmFeTa-based alloys were investigated. SmFeTa powders were characterized by XRD and SEM.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of anisotropic iron-core material on switched reluctance motor
abstract: In this paper, the effectiveness of the proposed SRM model which has anisotropic iron-core material structure was investigated. The material of stator poles is the anisotropic steel sheets.

articleTitle: An analytical method to predict the static performance of a planar actuator
abstract: In this paper, an analytical method for predicting the 3D flux density distribution in the air gap of an electromagnetic planar actuator the propulsion planar force was developed. the planar actuator has a mover with two NdFeB-type permanent magnets and a stator covered by two multiphase orthogonal armature coils.

articleTitle: Magnetization configurations microstructured Permalloy networks
abstract: In this paper, we present a magnetic force microscopic study of magnetization configuration on the microstructured permalloy network having N-arms, where N ranges from 2, 3, 4, and 6. Various magnetization directions from each arm may lead to different domain configurations in the junctions, hence create multiple storage bits in each physical junction.

articleTitle: The application of three-dimensional atom probe analysis to GMR materials
abstract: We discuss the giant magnetoresistance (GMR) property of CoFe/Cu magnetic multilayers. TEM images of the Co/Pt multilayer film show the crystal structure in the layers.

articleTitle: Sensorless driving method of permanent magnet synchronous motors based on neural networks
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new sensorless driving method using neural networks and the effectiveness of the proposed method have been successfully improved by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Eigen modes and ferromagnetic resonance line width of inhomogeneous thin films
abstract: In this paper, we describe modeling of the effects of magnetic inhomogeneity on ferromagnetic resonance line width using eigen mode analyses of inhomogeneous thin magnetic films.

articleTitle: New development of integrated micro-speaker and dynamic receiver used for cellular phone
abstract: In this paper, a micro-speaker and a dynamic receiver are integrated within a structure and the sound pressure level is also calculated and compared with a micro-speaker alone.

articleTitle: Effect of tensile stress on the magnetic properties of very thin amorphous glass-coated microwires
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the magnetoelastic properties of microwires with a metallic core diameter of only 7/spl mu/m. A linear evolution of the magnetostriction coefficient with the applied stress is found, as already evidenced on thick wires.

articleTitle: Utilization of continuous pes signal for H/M component characterizations
abstract: Control of positioning cmr during compmcnt characterization is critical in head media evaluation and drive integration development. Rapid increase in areal density depends strongly on track dcnsity increase.

articleTitle: Media noise characteristics in high density recording in anti-ferromagnetically coupled media
abstract: In this paper we study about the antiferromagnetically coupled media (AFC) were developed as suitable for high density recording in terms of magnetic stability.

articleTitle: A high performance, compact shaker/sensor for HGA dynamics testing
abstract: Shear mode piezo transducers can be configured into high bandwidth shakers as well as highly sensitive force sensors. Being able to deliver good stroke/charge levels yet being compact makes them an excellent choice for Head Gymbal Assembly (HGA) dynamic testing. Here we will investigate some design and performance aspects of such devices.

articleTitle: Nano imprint technology with artificially assisted self-assembling patterns for recording media
abstract: In this paper, we have developed a new fabricating method of patterned media which includes nano-imprint lithography and fine nano-patterning using the self-assembly of diblock copolymer.

articleTitle: Adaptive PRML detection for improving offtrack BER
abstract: In this paper, we study about the adaptive PRML detection for improving offtrack BER. Here very simple adaptive PRML detector is used. Its targets adjust to the decrease in signal amplitude expected from the reader misalignment.

articleTitle: Spin engineering of ferromagnetic films via inverse piezoelectric effect
abstract: In this study, we report a voltage-controlled spin engineering in ferromagnetic (FM) films without applying magnetic field for future ultrahigh density MRAM devices.

articleTitle: A noise-predictive partial response decision-feedback equalizer for RLL(1,x) coded perpendicular magnetic recording channels
abstract: In this paper, a noise-predictive partial response decision-feedback equalizer for RLL(1,x) coded perpendicular magnetic recording channels has been investigated.

articleTitle: Thermally stable high moment FeCo/IrMn soft underlayers for perpendicular media
abstract: In this paper, it is shown that Ta/Cu underlayers significantly improve the crystallinity in [111] IrMn and [110] FeCo resulting in improved thermal stability of soft multilayers.

articleTitle: Contact noise in MR read sensors for ultra-high density flexible media applications
abstract: In this paper, flexible media systems, this approach is limited by the fact that the head is contact with the media and that the increase in sensor resistance and bias current can result in a significant rise in sensor temperature. Variation in the separation between the media and the read sensor then results in transient cooling of the MR sensor through contact with isolated and elevated regions of the media.

articleTitle: Domain wall pinning at F/AF interface defects
abstract: In this article, we discuss the nature of the domain wall nucleated in a single step defect in a F/AF bilayer. We have found that for ultra-thin F films the surface pattern is a replica of the interface pattern.

articleTitle: Dry etching of AlTiC with CF/sub 4/ and H/sub 2/ for slider fabrication
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the effects of etching rate, selectivity and surface roughness. Because the AlTiC substrate consists of 2 phases Al/sub 2/O/sub 3/ and TiC, some phenomenon observed is different from a single phase substrate. The results of the etching surface analyzed by AFM are also reported. Finally, a femto slider etched by CF/sub 4/ and H/sub 2/ and its fly height test results are presented.

articleTitle: Vertical GMR recording heads
abstract: A vertical head was proposed for various groups for AMR, spin valve and GMR.Vertical GMR readers for areal density from 50 to 100Gbits/in/sup 2/. The head has a vertical layout with two layers moving against the bit.

articleTitle: A study of electrostatic discharge on MR heads using metal powder tapes
