abstract: In this paper, electrostatic discharge on MR heads using metal powder tapes was studied.

articleTitle: Convergence analysis of iterative soft decoded partial response channels
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the convergence of iterative soft decoded PR channels and predict the BER performance of the system. The convergence analysis also provides an explanation for the block error statistics of the concatenated systems, and implications for system design are discussed.

articleTitle: A Schottky tunnel barrier contact for electrical spin injection from a magnetic metal into a semiconductor
abstract: In this paper, we report here that spin injection from an Fe Schottky contact produces a spin polarization of 32% in an AlGaAs/GaAs quantum well, demonstrate via the Rowell criteria that tunneling is the dominate transport process, and examine the atomic structure of the spin injecting interface with TEM.

articleTitle: Pt/C intermediate layer for Co-Cr perpendicular magnetic recording media with extremely high resolution
abstract: In this paper, Pt/C intermediate layer for Co-Cr perpendicular magnetic recording media was investigated. Magnetic and microstructure of the medium were analyzed. The coercivity on the storage layer thickness measured with Kerr effect magnetometer.

articleTitle: Lifetime predictions due to electromigration failure in tape heads
abstract: In this paper, we have analyzed accelerated testing on thin film AMR tape recording heads in order to estimate their mean-time-to-finite under operating conditions were far from the operating conditions. The datas were analyzed in different techniques. The results generally predicted a mean time to failure on the order of 10/sup 7/. However, it is clear electromigration not be measurable contributor to heads failure in this product.

articleTitle: Structure dependent stray fields from domain walls in permalloy films
abstract: In this article, we present magnitudes and distributions of stray magnetic fields from a single domain wall in a permalloy film are calculated for film thickness 10nm to 2.5 /spl mu/m, using direct integration of the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation in a Cartesian lattice.

articleTitle: Characteristics of dual lubricant layers
abstract: In this paper explained about the dual lubricant layers were investigated by measuring the characteristics, mobility, durability, and spin-migration characteristic. Compared with mono lubrication layer, dual lubricant layers have higher durability and lower spin-migration characteristics.

articleTitle: Analysis on giant magnetoresistive characteristics of synthetic antiferromagnet-based spin-valves with modified pinned layers
abstract: In this paper, we have demonstrated a new type of synthetic antiferromagnet based spin valves comprising CoFe/CoFe/Ro/CoFe pinned structures exhibits many advantages such as much larger H/sub ex.eff/ as well as better bias control over conventional synthetic antiferromagnet based spin valves.

articleTitle: Enhanced coercive-force of Al-substituted Bi-GdIG nanoparticles with magnetic compensation composition
abstract: In this article, we determined the magnetic compensation composition of Al-substituted Bi-GdIG (BiGd/sub 2/Al/sub x/Fe/sub 5-x/O/sub 12/) nanoparticles. the relation between the Al substitution and the magnetic properties of BiGd/sub 2/Al/sub x/Fe/sub 5-x/O/sub 12/ was also investigated.

articleTitle: Control of magnetic features in epitaxial micro-patterned (Ga,Mn)As wire structures
abstract: In this paper, a manipulation of the magnetic structure of micropatterned (Ga,Mn)As wires, in turn, its magnetotransport properties, relying on the magnetocrystalline anisotropy and shape induced anisotropy in the wire geometry were investigated.

articleTitle: Spin-wave spectra in nanometric elliptical dots array
abstract: In this work, we present the results of a detailed BLS investigation of the spin-wave frequency in elliptical permalloy (Ni/sub 81/Fe/sub 19/) dots with long and short axes of 450 and 150 nm, respectively, and thickness of 30 nm.

articleTitle: Measuring high magnetic fields with a U-shaped micro machined cantilever using an optical readout
abstract: In this paper, we describe cantilever sensor which should be used to improve the control of the thyristor rectifier of the power source to get constant magnetic fields during the pulse. Due to quasi-static conditions induction coils are not applicable because they mainly detect the higher harmonics and have zero sensitivity at DC-fields. For measuring the magnetic fields the bending of a U-shaped Si-cantilever is used.

articleTitle: Microstructural control of Nb addition in nanocrystalline hard magnets with different Nd content
abstract: In this paper, nanocrystalline alloys with Nd content near 10 at % are investigated, and their magnetic properties and microstructure are examined to obtain better understanding of the effect of Nb addition on microstructure control in the nanocrystalline magnets.

articleTitle: Reduced-basis finite element method for torque optimization of small spindle motors
abstract: In this paper, reduced-basis finite element method is used to accelerate computation of spindle motors by redefining the procedures of FEM.

articleTitle: Field-oriented control evaluations of a single-sided permanent magnet axial-flux motor for electrical vehicle applications
abstract: In this paper, a systematic evaluation of the optimal output torque trajectory of a SPMAM along with its operational constraints on both the winding currents and the speed induced voltage are presented.

articleTitle: Impact of stator integrated magnetic bearings on the behaviour of a squirrel-cage induction machine
abstract: In this paper, our aim is to replace the rolling bearings in an induction machine, by integrated magnetic bearings, there is many advantages using this kind of bearings: no more friction, then reduction of the friction and windage losses, higher running speed, improve lifetime etc,. However, the magnetic bearings need a complex electronic driver to be developed. Actually, those problems should be taken into account: reduce mechanical vibrations, compensate unbalances and shaft misalignments and fault control and detection.

articleTitle: Bulk fully dense nanocomposite (Nd,Pr,Dy)/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B/Fe magnets
abstract: In this paper, cylinders with diameter of /spl sim/0.5" (11-15 mm) were made. Full densities of the hot pressed nanocomposite magnets were achieved even when hot pressed at a low temperature of 700/spl deg/C. The highest density obtained was 7.68 g/cm/sup 3/ for a Nd/sub 2.4/Pr/sub 5.6/Dy/sub 1/Fe/sub 85/B/sub 6/ magnet hot pressed at 700/spl deg/C with a pressure of 25 kpsi. The coercivity of the hot-pressed magnets was ranging from 0.5 kOe to 6 kOe, depending on the hotness temperature. the highest maximum energy product obtained is 10 MGOe. Comparing with the magnetic properties of the ribbons, the hot pressed magnets demonstrate a relatively low remanence. After the hot press, the density and magnetic properties were characterized and microstructures were observed by transmission electron microscopy (TEM).

articleTitle: CVD synthesis and CEMS study of Fe sulphide and oxide thin films
abstract: In this paper explained about the preparation of ferrous sulphide thin films by CVD. Their characterization was studied by conversion electron Mossbauer spectra (CEMS).

articleTitle: A comparison of SOST and HVDC transient simulation algorithms
abstract: In this paper, detailed simulation of HVDC converter behavior has been modified to include automatic selection of optimal integration steps, frequency-dependent effects of AC system, AC system phase and magnitude dynamics of voltage (particularly weak systems), control assessment and temporary over voltage consequences and root-matching techniques (for eliminates the truncation error).

articleTitle: Computer simulation of coercive force and thermal viscosity in perpendicular recording media
abstract: In this study, H/sub c/ and the temporal change of H/sub c/ have been analyzed by using micro-magnetic simulation including incoherent magnetization rotation in a grain.

articleTitle: GHz frequency band inductors with magnetic films and GHz circuit analysis including inductance
abstract: In this paper, we describe the implementation of both LCRG lumped circuit based time domain methods and the frequency domain harmonic balance method. To determine accuracy, results obtained for typical circuit consisting of non-linear active elements and linear distributed transmission lines are compared with measurements.

articleTitle: The microstructure and magneto-optical properties of pulsed laser deposited Magnetite films
abstract: In this paper, the microstructure and magneto-optical properties of pulsed laser deposited magnetite films were investigated. The films crystalline structure is identified to be magnetite by XRD and EBSD. Hysteresis loop of the film was measured by vibrating sample magnetometer.

articleTitle: Performance comparison between circular and elliptical type micro-speakers for cellular phones
abstract: In this paper, an elliptical speaker is analyzed using electromagnetic, mechanical and acoustic analysis, and is compared with circular one. It also shows that the elliptical type has a size merit when it is mounted with a bigger window, compared to the circular type with equivalent performance.

articleTitle: Flying height modulation estimation from pseudo-random readback signal in disk drives
abstract: In this paper, we present a method that can be used to measure FHM from a pseudo-random readback signal, and apply it to measure a lube induced FHM during read.

articleTitle: Spin-valves with a hard/Ru/soft synthetic longitudinal bias
abstract: In this paper, an alternative longitudinal bias scheme called overaid hard/Ru/soft synthetic biasing is investigated using micromagnetic modelling. The performance of this type of biasing scheme is compared with overlaid structure using a hard magnet alone.

articleTitle: Analysis of unbalance force for high speed slotless permanent magnet machine with Halbach array
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the unbalance force according to rotor eccentricity using finite element analysis.

articleTitle: Nickel nanowire arrays based on imprint lithography
abstract: In this paper, the fabrication of Ni nanowire arrays based on imprint lithography will be presented, which show a perfect hexagonal arrangement on a cm/sup 2/-scale. Additionally, we will analyze experimentally as well as theoretically the influence of the degree of order of the Ni nanowire arrays on its magnetic properties.

articleTitle: Antiferromagnetically coupled spin valves with spacer layer thickness down to 1 nm
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate that in well grown trilayers of the type NiFe-Co/Cu/Co/IrMn the RKKY-like antiferromagnetic coupling is dominating the ferromagnetic coupling down to a spacer layer thickness of about 1nm.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic investigations of mesoscopic magnetic rings via magnetic force and magnetoresistive microscopy
abstract: We have examined the magnetic and structural behavior of micron-size cobalt rings using magnetic force microscopy (MFM), scanning magnetoresistance microscopy (SMRM) with an external applied field, and micromagnetic simulations. In addition, we have studied physical changes in the films occurring during thermal annealing using atomic force microscopy (AFM). Finally, micromagnetic simulations have been utilized to assist in understanding of the experimental results. We will compare results obtained from each magnetic imaging method and discuss their relative strengths and weaknesses. We believe that the combination of several characterization techniques aids the overall understanding of the micromagnetic behavior.

articleTitle: 3d-magnetic structure and GMR behavior of (FeCo)Ag granular films
abstract: In this paper, room temperature magnetoresistance (MR) was measured in magnetic fields up to 8.2 kOe in the current in plane configuration (CIP). The microstructural origin of changes in the magnetic properties that resulted from the addition of silver, as probed by Mossbauer spectroscopy, has been related to the magnetoresistive behavior.

articleTitle: Room temperature spin injection in a semiconductor in a conventional MIS heterostructure: bias voltage dependence
abstract: In this paper, we discuss about the creation of spin polarized carriers inside a semiconductor at room temperature.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of soft-output post-processing detection for data-dependent media noise channels
abstract: In this paper, by focusing on correcting only a few specified most-likely error-events in conventional ML detection, this media-noise soft-output (MNS) detection scheme can provide an excellent compromise between detection performance and computation complexity.

articleTitle: High B/sub s/CoFe thin films prepared by electrodeposition
abstract: In this paper, preparation of high magnetic flux density CoFe thin films by electrodeposition was investigated. The film composition was analyzed by the X-ray fluorescence and glow discharge optical emission spectroscopy. The crystal structure was examined by X-ray diffraction.

articleTitle: Degradation in magnetoresistive sensors by short pulse zapping
abstract: In this paper, we discuss about the degradation in magnetoresistive properties by short pulse zapping has been investigated for both spin valve (SV) and tunnelling giant magnetoresistive (GMR) heads of about 80 Gb/spl bsol/in/sup 2/ areal density. Simulated ESD transients with pulse from 0.1 nsec to 10 nsec were applied to both spin valve and tunneling GMR devices, and GMR properties of the devices were measure.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of Co/sub 2/Y-type hexaferrite particles oriented in a rotating field
abstract: In this article, we apply our orientation technique to Y-type hexaferrites exhibiting very high uniaxial anisotropy field, such as Co/sub 2/Y ferrites.

articleTitle: Effect of disjoining pressure on disk-to-head lube transfer
abstract: The lower fly heights in today's disk drives have increased the sensitivity of the slider air-bearing surface (ABS) to lubricant and contamination accumulation. Such accumulation can cause a variety of data errors. The disjoining pressure has been shown to affect the wetting of lube on the disk and is suspected to also play a role in mogul formation. The purpose of this work is to study the effect of the disjoining pressure on lubricant transfer from the disk to head.

articleTitle: Effect of Sn addition on the magnetic aftereffects of yttrium iron garnets
abstract: The magnetic aftereffect (MAE) phenomena in yttrium iron garnets (YIG) with Sn substitutions is presented. These studies provide very useful information about lattice symmetry and domain wall dynamics. This is specially interesting for a material as YIG, whose properties change significantly through the addition of a wide variety of dopants. The analysis of MAE is usually carried out by means of magnetic disaccommodation techniques, i.e., a time variation of domain wall mobility after a magnetic shock.

articleTitle: Optical and magnetic properties of laser-deposited semiconducting Zn/sub 1-x/Co/sub x/O thin films
abstract: Magnetisation and optical properties of Zn/sub 1-x/Co/sub x/O films were reported. The nature of magnetism and exchange coupling in this diluted magnetic semiconductors were discussed.

articleTitle: Electrical spin injection and band offsets in an n-type ferromagnetic semiconductor heterostructure: n-CdCr/sub 2/Se/sub 4//AlGaAs/GaAs
abstract: Electrical spin injection and band offsets in an n-type ferromagnetic semiconductor heterostructure of CdCr/sub 2/Se/sub 4/-AlGaAs-GaAs are studied. Epitaxially grown CdCr/sub 2/Se/sub 4/ films exhibit hysteresis behavior with significant remanence, an in- plane easy axis with a coercive field of 125 Oe. The cross section of the LED and the band alignment were shown.

articleTitle: A bipolar-starting and unipolar-running method to drive a brushless DC motor in high speed with large starting torque
abstract: In this paper, we have discussed a bipolar-starting and unipolar-running method to drive a brushless DC motor in high speed with large starting torque and verified the proposed algorithm experimentally by developing a DSP-based controller to drive a BLDC motor with various driving methods.

articleTitle: Hardening and application of FePt buffer layers
abstract: In this paper we focus on the use of FePt as a ferromagnetic biasing buffer layer to GMR sensors in the form of Co/Cu/Co trilayers prepared with Cu spacer layer thickness corresponding to the second antiferromagnetic coupling maximum as to bias magnetic properties of thin FePt films.

articleTitle: Domain wall resonance effects on high-frequency permeability of ferrites
abstract: In this paper, domain-wall resonance is analyzed and its influence on permeability contrasted with the effects of single-domain rotation and gyromagnetic resonance.

articleTitle: Geometrical analysis of precessional switching
abstract: In this paper we present a magnetization switching in magnetic particles and films. It is one of the fundamental issues in spin dynamics studies due to its relevance in magnetic recording and data storage technology. In this area it has been recently recognized the potential convenience of realizing the switching of magnetization in particles and film by means of precessional motion of magnetization. In the typical precessional switching process the magnetization is initially along the easy axis of the body and the external magnetic field is approximately orthogonal to the easy axis. If the field is strong enough and applied for a sufficiently long time, the magnetization can be reversed. We will study this process by using the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation.

articleTitle: Effect of atomic ordering on magnetization decay and activation volume of FePt nanoparticles
abstract: In this paper, we report the magnetization stability of FePt nanoparticles with different order parameters.

articleTitle: Faraday rotation in quaternary CdMnCoTe thick films deposited on transparent quartz glass substrates
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the Faraday rotation of thick diluted magnetic semiconductor CdMnCoTe films deposited on relatively thin quartz glass substrate from the viewpoint of practical application. Magnetization curve for CdMnCoTe film measured using vibrating sample magnetometer at room temperature.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic calculation of bias field and coercivity of exchange biased IrMn/NiFe bilayers
abstract: Domain processes associated with exchange bias in IrMn/NiFe are investigated using a micromagnetic approach. The model give quantitative estimates of the bias field and the coercivity for antiferromagnetic/ferromagnetic bilayers with fully compensated interfaces. The numerically calculated domain processes are compared with those observed in transmission electron microcopy studies of exchange biased bilayers.

articleTitle: Optimal suspension design for femto sliders
abstract: In this paper, to meet the performance of femto sliders, an optimal design of the head suspension assembly has been carried out by using multi-objective topology optimization.

articleTitle: Etching of spin valve capping layers for sensor stabilization applications
abstract: In this paper, we discuss ion beam etching (IBE) and reactive ion etching (RIE) of the Tantalum sensor capping layer. Limitations of physical etching are presented. A RIE approach that exhibits excellent selectivity between Ta and NiFe or CoFe is presented. Finally, the fabrication of exchange tabs for GMR sensor stabilization using this method is shown.

articleTitle: Study of MR in Fe/sub 3/O/sub 4/ tunnel junctions
abstract: In this paper, we examined the magnetic and structural properties of Fe/sub 3/O/sub 4/ films fabricated by using reactive sputtering as an electrode in a MTJ. We investigated the interface of the MTJ using high resolution transmission electron microscopy.

articleTitle: Charge generation and bleed-off in spindle motors with ceramic ball bearings
abstract: In this paper, the negative voltage between the rotor and stator of the spindle motor is determined by the equilibrium between the charge generation in the bearings and the charge bleed-off in the ferro-fluid seal of the motor.

articleTitle: CoB/Pd multilayer with PtB/Pd/MgO intermediate layer for perpendicular magnetic recording
abstract: In this study, we investigated the effects of PtB/Pd/MgO intermediate layers on the magnetic and recording characteristics of CoB/Pd multilayer media.

articleTitle: Comparison of different measuring methods for the characterization of permanent magnet properties
abstract: In this paper, we show, by experimental investigation on a typical permanent magnet, that the intrinsic J(H) rate dependence may play a relevant role and cannot be neglected. We studied experimentally the field rate dependence of hysteresis loops on a sintered NdFeB sample.

articleTitle: Giant magnetoresistance effect of L1/sub 0/Fe/sub 50/Pt/sub 50/ grains
abstract: In this paper, the occurrence of giant magnetoresistance effect (GMR) in some metallic granular films and intimate relationship between GMR ratio and film microstructure, we tried to detect the microstructure of FePt-Ag composite granular films via GMR effect measurement. The film microstructure change with annealing temperature by TEM and X-ray reveals that the FePt grain size tends to increase. The increase in FePt grain size decreases the specific FePt grain surface area deteriorating GMR ratio.

articleTitle: Noise characteristics of Co-based amorphous tapes-to seek low-noise magnetic shell for magnetic shaking
abstract: In this paper, in order to seek better material or better combination of materials for magnetic shells to which the magnetic shaking is applied, low-frequency magnetic noise is characterized under similar condition where magnetic materials are subjected to the magnetic shaking. Energy of the Barkhausen noise is compared to the fluctuation noise which appears in the low-frequency band when the magnetic material is excited with higher is excited with higher frequency such as 1 KHz.

articleTitle: Magnetization configurations in current-induced tunnel junction switching
abstract: In this paper, micromagnetic analysis including the spin-transfer torque and the vortex field is used to simulate the magnetisation orientation during the CIMS loop. The nonlinear characteristic of the I-V curve is also taken into account to explain the pronounced curvature of the R vs I loop. Junctions used in this work have a bottom-pinned structure, and typically show TMR=20% with RXA=16/spl Omega//spl times//spl mu/m/sup 2/ and a breakdown voltage of 0.32V.

articleTitle: Spin injection in an FeCo/Si/FeCo structure: a spin transistor
abstract: In this article, we report the spin-valve effect in a lateral spin-injection device with an FM/Si/FM structure.

articleTitle: High frequency behavior of electrodeposited FeCoNi alloys
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the high frequency behavior and damping of the FeCoNi films as a function of their composition and microstructure.FeCoNi alloys have been demonstrated to have a low coercivity and high saturation magnetisation.

articleTitle: Iterative decoding of greater than 100 Gb/IN/sup 2/ recordings
abstract: In this paper real head/media waveforms were captured from spinstand and BER performance was analyzed using turbo product code with single parity check (TPC/SPC).

articleTitle: FePt nanoparticles with tailored microstructure
abstract: In this study, we have tried to fabricate FePt nanoparticles with controlled microstructure and magnetic properties by adjusting the sample preparation conditions. The formation of the microstructure is briefly discussed and correlated to magnetic properties of the particles.

articleTitle: Three dimensional characteristic analysis of micro BLDC motor according to slotless winding shape
abstract: A distributed current model of various shapes with a finite length in axial direction by Fast Fourier Transform is developed and a new calculation numerical method based on the model is presented to analyze the performance due to winding shape in the SLBLDC motor.

articleTitle: Asymmetric focused-ion-beam trimming of longitudinal and perpendicular write heads
abstract: In this paper, we focus on head trimming techniques based on a asymmetric trimming process, whereby only one side of a write pole is FIB trimmed to achieve the target width. We use this technique for longitudinal and perpendicular HGA-level head trimming.

articleTitle: Microstructure and magnetic properties of Co-doped NiZn ferrites
abstract: The present work is aimed at showing the influence of sintering condition and doping level on the microstructure and magnetic properties of some NiZn ferrites doped with Co.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of nanophase Mn-doped PbSe
abstract: In this paper, magnetic properties of Mn-doped nanometer sized PbSe were investigated. Magnetisation of different Mn-doped PbSe nanocrystals as function of measuring temperature was studied by EPR spectroscopy. Mn/sup 2+/ acting as a paramagnetic center (S=5/2) should be an ideal dopant in semiconductor system.

articleTitle: Ferromagnetic shape memory alloys: where might they be useful?
abstract: In this paper, ferromagnetic shape memory alloys, most notably NiMnGa have received considerable attention because of the remarkable 6% to 10% field induced strains they have exhibited at room temperature in the magnetic fields of order 0.5 T. In order to address this question, the important technical properties that these materials exhibit will be reviewed and compared with those of competing active materials.

articleTitle: Studies on the magnetic field canceling system used for the open ends of cylindrical magnetic shields
abstract: In this paper, we have studied how ac magnetic field extends into the bore of the axial magnetic shell experimentally in the frequency range 2-50 Hz, and then propose a simple feed-forward canceling system.

articleTitle: A Mossbauer study of spring magnets
abstract: In this paper, seven compositions of the Nd/sub x/Fe/sub 100-x-y/B/sub y/ ribbons were prepared by melt spinning method with Nd and B content increasing from 7.3 and 3.6 to 11 and 6, respectively. The alloys were annealed under optimised conditions to obtain a composite material consisting of the hard magnetic Nd/sub 2/Fe/sub 14/B and soft magnetic /spl alpha/-Fe phases. Phase analysis was performed by Mossbauer spectroscopy, complemented by standard X-ray diffraction and hysteresis loop measurements. The influence of alloy composition and annealing conditions of the hyperfine parameters and relative abundance of the phases is studied.

articleTitle: Magnetization and Curie temperature of MnZn ferrite thin films deposited by sputtering
abstract: The magnetisation and the Curie temperature of as-deposited MnZn ferrite thin films by sputtering were examined compared to those of heat-treated films.

articleTitle: Cole-Cole impedance analysis on spin sprayed Ni-Zn-Co ferrite films exhibiting strong magnetic loss in GHz range
abstract: To elucidate the origin of the strong magnetic absorption extended to the wide high-frequency range, we performed in this study Cole-Cole impedance analysis in order to examine the homogeneity in the films.

articleTitle: Separable cylindrical magnetic shield with magnetic shaking enhancement
abstract: In this paper, we present a new concept of cylindrical magnetic shield with magnetic shaking enhancement. The shield is separable, and consists of C-shaped building blocks made of METGLAS2705M amorphous ribbons. It will easily produce a magnetically shielded space according to needs.

articleTitle: Detection of biomolecular recognition using nanometer-sized magnetic labels and spin-valve sensors
abstract: In this paper, we report about the findings on the study of the detection of biomolecules labelled with nanometer sized magnetic particles (250, 100 and 50 nm) using spin value sensors.

articleTitle: Numerical evaluation of slow thermally induced magnetization reversal in granular magnetic materials
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the numerical algorithm which we use to evaluate the thermally induced magnetization reversal in granular magnetic materials.

articleTitle: Agglomeration effects in FePt nanoparticles on Si substrates studied by small angle neutron scattering and magnetometry
abstract: In this paper, we investigate particle sizes and magnetic properties of FePt nanoparticles to determine if annealing at high temperatures for short times leads to the desired magnetic properties with reduced agglomeration. We used small angle neutron scattering and vibrating sample magnetometry for investigation.

articleTitle: Anisotropy dispersion effects in CoFe/IrMn and NiFe/IrMn bilayer systems
abstract: In this paper, anisotropy dispersion effects in CoFe/IrMn and NiFe/IrMn bilayer systems were investigated. We report on the magnetic domains and anisotropy distribution in exchange biased structures deposited by dc magnetron sputtering.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of effective exchange coupling in NiCu/IrMn bilayer
abstract: In this paper, temperature dependence of effective exchange coupling in NiCu/IrMn bilayer was studied.

articleTitle: Shock modeling of the head-media interface in an operational hard disk drive
abstract: In this paper, two finite element models are incorporated in the simulation of the operating HDD head-media interface. The first model is a structural model of the mechanical components of the interface. The second model is a finite element solution of the time dependent Reynolds equation.

articleTitle: Free layer uniaxial anisotropy angular dispersion measurement of spin valve films
abstract: In this paper, a new method for evaluating the free layer uniaxial anisotropy angular dispersion of spin valve films is proposed, and measurement results are obtained for different film structures.

articleTitle: Spin dependent tunneling junctions with ferromagnetic triple-barrier resonant-tunneling spin filter
abstract: In this paper, spin dependent tunneling junctions with SPM sensing layer have been made using standard microelectronic fabrication techniques. The SPM-SDT junction have zero hysteresis without biasing and a reasonable sensitivity. A typical SDT junction has a vertical structure of Si(100)-Si/sub 3/N/sub 4/-Ru-NiFeCo-Al/sub 2/O/sub 3/-FeCo-CrMnPt.

articleTitle: A new spin on electronics
abstract: In this paper we discuss the spin on electronics on various magnetic devices are discussed. The author gives a brief historical review and a discussion of future prospects for spintronic devices, including magnetic sensors, random access magnetic memories (MRAM) and quantum computing.

articleTitle: Angle dependent switching of granular and multilayer perpendicular media
abstract: In this paper we extend our study to include the external field angle dependence of the time independent switching field, H/sub swo(/spl theta/)/, for granular and multilayer perpendicular media. Comparison of H/sub swo(/spl theta/)/ with a calculated head field provides further insight to the technologically important issues of transition definition and side-writing of adjacent tracks for these two classes of perpendicular recording media.

articleTitle: A new sinusoidal-wave inverter utilizing magnetic oscillation
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new sinusoidal-wave inverter utilizing magnetic oscillation circuit.

articleTitle: Magnetization vector measurement by wideband high spatial resolution kerr microscope
abstract: In this article, we describe an improvement in spatial resolution and a simple method for measuring the three components of a magnetization vector.

articleTitle: Model for the effect of ramping rate on ferrofluid aggregates
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the impact of field ramping rate on the spacing between the aggregates. The focus of this paper is to present a model that explains the experimental results.

articleTitle: Concatenated low density parity check (LDPC) codes for magnetic recording channels
abstract: In this paper discussed for magnetic recording channels, a concatenated LDPC coding scheme which employs a column weight LDPC inner code and an outer LDPC code with large column weight to handle the residual errors.

articleTitle: Microstructure of soft magnetic FeCoZrO films with high saturation magnetization
abstract: In this paper, we present our detailed work of the microstructural characterization, using transmission electron microscopy (TEM), high resolution TEM and small angle X-ray scattering (SAXS). The effect of oxygen on the microstructure and the relationship between the microstructure and magnetic properties are clarified. The effect of annealing on the magnetic properties and microstructure has also been studied.

articleTitle: New high rate low density parity check codes for multi-track recording
abstract: In this paper, we report a new high rate low density parity check codes for multi-track recording. A new decoding method has been found that improves the performance of codes with cycles of length 4.

articleTitle: Magnetic studies on spherical monodispersed Co nanoparticles
abstract: In this paper, we report a detailed investigation of temperature dependences of magnetization of powders of monodispersed /spl epsi/-Co particles. In the zero-field-cooled and field-cooled low field magnetization measurements, we observe two size-dependent and one size-independent features, corresponding to (I) blocking of moments of nanoparticles, (II) a second phase peak, and (III) a feature which may be associated with freezing of surface moments. For small particles, field-induced interaction effects on the blocking temperature (I) has also been observed.

articleTitle: Micromagnetics of hysteresis loops in CGC perpendicular media
abstract: In this paper, we have investigated the micromagnetics processes that underlie hysteresis loops in CGC media using a computational micromagnetic model. Magnetisation reversal dynamics at the surface of CGC media in recording simulation indicates bits reverse in two stages: a domain nucleates and then expands by wall motion.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties and Mossbauer studies of Y/sub 3-x/Ce/sub x/Fe/sub 5/O/sub 12/ (x=0.0, 0.1, 0.3) fabricated using a sol-gel method
abstract: In this paper, we report exchange integrals, J/sub a-d/, J/sub a-a/ and J/sub d-d/ of superexchange interaction on the garnet-related structures of composition Y/sub 3-x/Ce/sub x/Fe/sub 5/O/sub 12/ (x=0.0, 0.1, 0.3) and their examination by Mossbauer spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Development of magnetic attachments for dental implants
abstract: In this paper, development of magnetic attachments for dental implants was studied. The performance of the magnetic attachment measured in attractive force per volume was improved.

articleTitle: 3-D write field and imaging from multilayered soft films in perpendicular recording media
abstract: In this paper, we describe the effects obtained from three-dimensional modelling of the write field of a single pole head in the presence of a soft or semi-soft magnetic multilayer structure.

articleTitle: Method for read width determination at high track densities by imaging the magnetic field emitted by narrow Cu waveguides
abstract: In this paper, we have characterized the magnetic field from waveguides with widths ranging from 1 /spl mu/m to < 100 nm, in both single and dual wire geometrics. Our Cu waveguides are fabricated by a combination of conventional optical lithography and electron beam lithography. The magnetic field of the wire is detected using giant magnetoresistance (GMR) read sensors, and the measurements are performed.

articleTitle: Modeling of temperature dependent magnetic and mechanical properties of Ni/sub 2/MnGa single crystals
abstract: In this paper explained about the modeling of temperature dependent magnetization curves of Ni/sub 2/MnGa single crystals were obtained. And stress-strain curves obtained on an oriented single crystal at different temperature.

articleTitle: Active shielding suitable for electron beam lithography systems
abstract: In this paper, experimental investigations using a model of the EBLS and 3-D magnetic field computations were carried out to find out the optimal position of an reference sensor outside the EBLS that can attenuate the magnetic disturbances inside the EBLS effectively and the degree of disturbance of the EB.

articleTitle: Gelled vs non-gelled phantom material for measurement of temperature rise by the MRI RF-magnetic field
abstract: In this paper we study the magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), eddy currents are induced in the body of the patient by the RF magnetic field. The precession rate of the proton magnetization determines the frequency, which is 64 MHz for 1.5 T static field. The RF-induced currents in the body are concentrated near medical implants, resulting in a localized additional temperature rise.

articleTitle: Interplay of microstructure and magnetic properties in epitaxially grown Co/sub 35/Pd/sub 65/ films on Cu/Si(100)
abstract: In this paper, we have investigate the correlation between magnetic properties, growth structure, and internal stress of epitaxially grown Co/sub 35/Pd/sub 65/ alloys films on Cu/Si(100).

articleTitle: RF noise suppression on thin-film coplanar transmission line by electroplated ferrite magnetic films
abstract: In this paper we demonstrated the RF electromagnetic noise attenuation using the newly developed high resistivity electroplated Ni-Zn(-Co) soft ferrite films and compared the performance on the transmission line with the metallic (CoNbZr) films.

articleTitle: A permeable spheroidal shield of an almost uniform thickness
abstract: In this paper, we describe the approximation of the shell by two spheroidal boundaries S/sub i/ and S/sub e/ which are concentric, coaxial but are non-confocal, providing a better approximation of significantly elongated shields of uniform thickness.

articleTitle: Temperature distribution of excitation from the outside the body utilizing hybrid heaters for hyperthermia
abstract: Hyperthermia is one of the well-known treatments against cancer. When the tumor volume is large in some degree, temperature difference between a tumor core and near edge occurs. A high-temperature hyperthermia is proposed to keep the high temperature of heaters. Soft-heating method that excites a thermosensitive magnetic heater in the high frequency magnetic field is used. When two or more heaters were used, the temperature distribution was measured for the hybrid heater composed of the thermosensitive magnetic material and the metal ring. And an effective area for hyperthermia was examined.

articleTitle: Micromagnetic calculation of the transverse susceptibility of patterned media
abstract: In this paper, we present a generalized model of the transverse susceptibility (TS) for realistic fine particle systems that may have any type of anisotropy (uniaxial,cubic,or unidirectional), distribution of easy axes orientation, particles positions and volumes and different strength of magnetostatic interactions between particles. The field dependence of TS is obtained using a micromagnetic algorithm based on the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation. For the uniaxial particles, where the critical curve approach can also be used, we have compared the results of the micromagnetic algorithm and those obtained by integration of Aharoni's formula over the orientation distribution. Tests were also made on the calculation of the TS for single particles with various orientation of the easy axis with respect to the AC/DC applied fields.

articleTitle: Influence of the spin structure for the exchange bias of antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic bilayer
abstract: In this paper, the exchange bias phenomenon in the antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic bilayer plays an important role to suppress the magnetic domain structure in the ferromagnetic thin film.
